name: Design products, structures and circuits
definition: Authoring the definition of a physical thing before it exists: geometry, drawings, building and plant models, circuit schematics and layouts, and the management of that design data.

name: Mechanical solid and surface modeling
definition: Given design intent as requirements, sketches or reference geometry, produce exact boundary-representation or implicit models of parts, tooling and assemblies.

name: Constrained sketch solving
definition: Given 2D sketch entities with geometric and dimensional constraints, compute a consistent solution and report remaining degrees of freedom or conflicts.
inputs: points, lines, arcs, splines; coincidence, tangency, parallel, distance, angle and other constraints
outputs: solved entity positions; degrees-of-freedom status; over- or under-constrained diagnosis
benchmark_note: the SketchGraphs dataset gives millions of real constraint graphs whose solutions can be checked exactly
state_of_art: Siemens D-Cubed 2D DCM; Dassault Systemes CGM constraint solver

name: Feature-based parametric part modeling
definition: Given design intent and dimensions, build a history of sketches and features (extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, hole, pattern, fillet) that evaluates to a valid solid.
inputs: requirements, dimensions, reference geometry, material
outputs: editable feature tree and the boundary-representation solid it evaluates to
benchmark_note: target solids from the DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery reconstruction datasets allow geometric comparison (volume overlap, surface distance) of a rebuilt part
state_of_art: Dassault Systemes SolidWorks; Dassault Systemes CATIA; PTC Creo; Siemens NX; Onshape

name: Model generation from text, images or drawings
definition: Given a natural-language description, image, sketch or 2D engineering drawing of a part, produce an editable parametric model that matches it.
inputs: text description, photograph or render, hand sketch, or multi-view dimensioned drawing
outputs: parametric part model or modeling program; deviation from the specified geometry
benchmark_note: Text2CAD, DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery provide paired inputs and ground-truth models; drawing-to-model can be scored by rebuilding the drawing views
state_of_art: Autodesk Fusion 360 (AI-assisted features); Zoo Text-to-CAD

name: Boundary representation modeling operations
definition: Given one or more boundary-representation solids and an operation, compute the resulting valid solid for Booleans, fillets and chamfers, shelling, offsets and drafts.
inputs: B-rep solids; operation type and parameters; tolerances
outputs: valid closed B-rep solid, or a located failure
benchmark_note: validity and success rate of operations on ABC dataset models are measurable, but no standard kernel robustness suite exists
state_of_art: Siemens Parasolid; Spatial ACIS; Dassault Systemes CGM

name: Assembly modeling with mating constraints
definition: Given part models and mating relations or joints, position the parts, solve the assembly constraints and report remaining motion and interferences.
inputs: part models; mates, joints and reference skeletons; assembly structure
outputs: positioned assembly; degrees of freedom; interference and clearance report; assembly structure
benchmark_note: the Fusion 360 Gallery Assembly dataset gives ground-truth joints between parts; interference detection is deterministic
state_of_art: Dassault Systemes CATIA; Siemens NX; PTC Creo; Dassault Systemes SolidWorks

name: Sheet metal design and unfolding
definition: Given material thickness, bend rules and flange geometry, model a formed sheet metal part and compute its flat pattern and bend data.
inputs: thickness, bend radius, bend allowance or K-factor, flanges, reliefs, forming features
outputs: folded model; flat pattern; bend table and sequence
benchmark_note: flat-pattern dimensions follow from bend-allowance formulas and can be checked exactly
state_of_art: Dassault Systemes SolidWorks; Siemens Solid Edge; Autodesk Inventor; data M COPRA

name: Freeform and class-A surface modeling
definition: Given styling sketches, character lines or scans and continuity targets, build a fair NURBS surface set that closes into a manufacturable body.
inputs: sketches, curves, reference scans, continuity requirements (G1 to G3), hull or styling constraints
outputs: trimmed NURBS surface set; curvature and continuity analysis; closed solid
benchmark_note: continuity, deviation from reference and curvature fairness are measurable, but class-A aesthetic quality is judged by people
state_of_art: Autodesk Alias; ICEM Surf; McNeel Rhinoceros 3D; Dassault Systemes CATIA

name: Implicit and lattice modeling
definition: Given a design envelope, field functions and lattice or infill specifications, produce implicit or voxel geometry with graded lattices and smooth blends for additive manufacture.
inputs: design space, keep-out regions, lattice cell type, density or thickness fields
outputs: implicit or voxel model; exported mesh; volume fraction and minimum-feature report
benchmark_note: volume fraction, minimum feature size and watertightness are measurable; fitness for purpose needs a physics solve
state_of_art: nTop; Materialise 3-matic

name: Mold and die tooling design
definition: Given a part model and process parameters, design the mold or die: parting surfaces, core and cavity split, draft, strip layout and die set.
inputs: part model; shrinkage; pull direction; press and stock parameters; standard component catalogs
outputs: core and cavity or punch and die geometry; parting surfaces; progressive die strip layout; tooling bill of materials
benchmark_note: draft, undercut and parting-line validity and strip material utilization are measurable; tool quality is not
state_of_art: Cimatron; Vero VISI; Siemens NX Mold Design; Logopress

name: Geometry exchange, repair and reverse engineering
definition: Given geometry in one representation or format, possibly damaged or measured rather than modeled, produce a valid model in the representation and format a downstream user needs.

name: Neutral format model translation
definition: Given a model in a native or neutral format, write it to a target format preserving geometry, topology, assembly structure, attributes and product manufacturing information.
inputs: native CAD file or STEP, IGES, JT or Parasolid file
outputs: translated file; validation properties (volume, area, centroid, PMI counts) compared before and after
benchmark_note: CAx Implementor Forum round-robin test models carry validation properties that a translation must preserve
state_of_art: CAD Exchanger; Datakit CrossManager; Spatial 3D InterOp; Theorem Solutions; ITI CADfix

name: Geometry healing and defeaturing
definition: Given an imported or damaged boundary-representation model, close gaps, remove slivers and self-intersections, and optionally remove small features, yielding a valid watertight solid.
inputs: B-rep model with defects; tolerances; feature-size thresholds
outputs: valid closed solid; log of repairs; simplified model for analysis
benchmark_note: validity after repair is objectively checkable; faithfulness to the intended shape needs a reference model
state_of_art: ITI CADfix; Ansys Discovery (SpaceClaim); Spatial 3D InterOp

name: Tessellation and mesh repair
definition: Given an exact model or a defective triangle mesh, produce a watertight, manifold mesh within a stated chordal and angular tolerance.
inputs: B-rep model or triangle mesh; tolerances; target format (STL, 3MF, glTF)
outputs: manifold, watertight mesh; deviation report
benchmark_note: Thingi10K provides thousands of defective meshes; manifoldness and deviation are measurable
state_of_art: Materialise Magics; Autodesk Netfabb
open_tools: MeshLab; Manifold; Open CASCADE Technology (BRepMesh); ADMesh

name: Feature recognition from boundary representations
definition: Given a boundary-representation model without history, identify and parameterize its features such as holes, pockets, slots, bosses and fillets.
inputs: B-rep model
outputs: labeled faces; feature list with types and parameters
benchmark_note: the MFCAD and MFCAD++ datasets give face-level feature labels
state_of_art: HCL CAMWorks automatic feature recognition; Spatial CGM; Siemens NX feature recognition

name: Scan-to-CAD surface reconstruction
definition: Given a point cloud or scan mesh of a physical object, segment it into surface primitives and fit an exact, editable model within a deviation tolerance.
inputs: point cloud or scan mesh; tolerance; optional design intent (symmetry, standard features)
outputs: fitted primitives and NURBS surfaces; solid or parametric model; deviation map
benchmark_note: point clouds sampled from ABC dataset models give ground-truth primitives and surfaces; real scans lack ground truth
state_of_art: 3D Systems Geomagic Design X; InnovMetric PolyWorks Modeler; Siemens NX Reverse Engineering

name: Drawings, tolerancing and manufacturability
definition: Given part and assembly geometry, produce the authoritative definition for making it, as drawings or annotated models with dimensions and tolerances, and check that it can be made and assembled within them.

name: Two-dimensional drafting
definition: Given a design to document, create precise 2D geometry, hatches, blocks, layers and text forming a scaled technical drawing.
inputs: dimensions, sketches, standards, title block and layer conventions
outputs: 2D drawing file (DWG, DGN, DXF) and plotted sheets
benchmark_note: drawn geometry can be compared exactly with a reference DXF, but no standard drafting suite exists
state_of_art: Autodesk AutoCAD; Bentley MicroStation; Bricsys BricsCAD; Dassault Systemes DraftSight

name: Drawing view generation from models
definition: Given a 3D part or assembly, generate associative orthographic, section, detail and pictorial views with correct hidden lines and a parts list.
inputs: part or assembly model; sheet format; view and section specifications
outputs: drawing sheet with projected views, sections, balloons and bill of materials table
benchmark_note: projected and sectioned view geometry is deterministic and can be compared with reference drawings
state_of_art: Siemens NX; PTC Creo; Dassault Systemes SolidWorks; Autodesk Inventor

name: Dimensioning and annotation
definition: Given drawing views and design intent, place a complete, non-redundant set of dimensions, notes and symbols that conforms to the governing drafting standard.
inputs: drawing views; functional requirements; drafting standard
outputs: dimensioned and annotated drawing; completeness check
benchmark_note: whether the geometry is fully and not over-dimensioned is checkable; the choice of dimensioning scheme is judgment
state_of_art: Siemens NX; PTC Creo; Dassault Systemes SolidWorks

name: Geometric tolerancing and model-based definition
definition: Given a part model and its function, assign datums and geometric tolerances and encode them as semantic product manufacturing information on the 3D model.
inputs: part model; mating and functional requirements; tolerancing standard
outputs: datum reference frames; feature control frames; semantic PMI exportable to STEP AP242
benchmark_note: the NIST MBE PMI validation and conformance test models specify the expected annotations; standard syntax rules are checkable
state_of_art: Sigmetrix GD&T Advisor; Dassault Systemes CATIA 3D Master; Siemens NX PMI

name: Tolerance stack-up and variation analysis
definition: Given an assembly, its tolerances and assembly sequence, compute the predicted variation of critical dimensions by worst-case, statistical or Monte Carlo methods and rank contributors.
inputs: assembly geometry or loop diagram; dimensional and geometric tolerances; distributions; assembly process
outputs: worst-case and statistical ranges; percent out of spec; contributor ranking
benchmark_note: one-dimensional stack-ups have closed-form answers and textbook worked examples; 3D cases can be checked against Monte Carlo references
state_of_art: Sigmetrix CETOL 6 Sigma; DCS 3DCS Variation Analyst; Siemens Teamcenter Variation Analysis; CETOL 6 Sigma; 3DCS Variation Analyst; Siemens VSA

name: Drawing digitization and recognition
definition: Given a scanned or raster drawing, recover vector geometry, text, dimensions and symbols as an editable, structured drawing.
inputs: raster or PDF drawing
outputs: vector entities; recognized dimensions, notes and symbols; layer assignment
benchmark_note: FloorPlanCAD (symbol spotting) and CubiCasa5K cover floor plans; mechanical drawing datasets are scarce
state_of_art: GTX RasterCAD; Scan2CAD

name: Design for manufacture and assembly review
definition: Given a part or assembly model and a target process, find features that violate process rules and estimate assembly difficulty.
inputs: part or assembly model; process (machining, molding, casting, sheet metal, additive); rule set
outputs: rule violations (wall thickness, draft, undercuts, hole depth, bend relief); assembly efficiency score
benchmark_note: rule violations are objectively checkable for a fixed rule set; there is no public labeled dataset
state_of_art: HCL DFMPro; Boothroyd Dewhurst DFMA; Siemens NX Check-Mate; aPriori; DFMPro

name: Product data and lifecycle management
definition: Given the design files and structures of a product, keep their versions, bills of materials, configurations and changes consistent and traceable through release.

name: Design data vaulting and revision control
definition: Given CAD files with their references, check them in and out, version and revise them, and answer where-used queries without breaking references.
inputs: CAD files and their reference graph; lifecycle states; access rules
outputs: versioned vault; resolved references; where-used and history reports
benchmark_note: correctness is integration behavior over a repository, not a computed answer
state_of_art: Siemens Teamcenter; PTC Windchill; Dassault Systemes ENOVIA; Autodesk Vault; Bentley ProjectWise

name: Bill of materials management
definition: Given a product structure from CAD and part master data, build the engineering bill of materials and transform it into manufacturing and service views with effectivity.
inputs: CAD assembly structure; part master; plant and process information; effectivity
outputs: engineering and manufacturing bills of materials; roll-ups of mass and cost; reconciliation report
benchmark_note: roll-ups and engineering-to-manufacturing restructuring have checkable answers under stated rules
state_of_art: Siemens Teamcenter; PTC Windchill; Dassault Systemes ENOVIA; Arena PLM

name: Engineering change management
definition: Given a proposed change to released items, determine affected parts, documents and assemblies, route the change for approval and release the new revisions.
inputs: change request; product structure; where-used relations; approval rules
outputs: impact analysis; change order; released revisions; audit trail
benchmark_note: impact sets over a given product structure are checkable; workflow behavior is not
state_of_art: PTC Windchill; Siemens Teamcenter; Arena PLM; Oracle Agile PLM

name: Product configuration and variant management
definition: Given a product family's options, rules and overloaded structure, validate the rule set and resolve any valid option selection to a configured product structure.
inputs: feature or option model; compatibility rules; overloaded (150 percent) structure
outputs: valid or invalid verdict; configured bill of materials; rule conflicts
benchmark_note: rule-based configuration has determinate answers, and industrial instances such as the Renault vehicle configuration benchmark are public
state_of_art: Siemens Teamcenter Product Configurator; pure-systems pure::variants; Tacton CPQ

name: Part classification and similarity search
definition: Given a part model or description and a part library, classify the part and retrieve existing parts that are geometrically or functionally similar.
inputs: query part model or attributes; classified part library
outputs: classification; ranked similar or duplicate parts
benchmark_note: shape retrieval can be scored on labeled CAD collections such as the ABC dataset; real libraries are private
state_of_art: Siemens Teamcenter Classification; CADENAS PARTsolutions; Physna

name: Material and substance compliance roll-up
definition: Given a bill of materials and supplier material declarations, roll up substance content and test it against restricted-substance lists.
inputs: bill of materials; supplier full material declarations; regulatory substance lists
outputs: substance roll-up per part and product; compliance status and declarations
benchmark_note: the roll-up is arithmetic over declared masses against published thresholds
state_of_art: International Material Data System; Assent Compliance; PTC Windchill

name: Architectural design and building modeling
definition: Given a building program, site and codes, author the building's spaces, elements and documents as a coordinated information model.

name: Space planning and floor plan layout
definition: Given a room program with areas and adjacencies and a building footprint, generate floor plan layouts that satisfy them.
inputs: space program; adjacency matrix; footprint or site; circulation and code constraints
outputs: floor plan layouts; area schedule; constraint satisfaction report
benchmark_note: RPLAN and similar datasets give real plans, and areas and adjacencies are checkable; plan quality is judged by people
state_of_art: Autodesk Forma; TestFit; Finch

name: Conceptual massing and form modeling
definition: Given a site, zoning envelope and program, model building masses and report floor area, ratios and envelope compliance.
inputs: site boundary and terrain; zoning setbacks, heights and floor-area limits; program areas
outputs: 3D massing model; gross floor area and floor-area ratio; envelope check
benchmark_note: zoning-envelope compliance and area metrics are exact; design merit is not
state_of_art: Trimble SketchUp; McNeel Rhinoceros 3D with Grasshopper; Autodesk Forma

name: Building information model authoring
definition: Given a design, model the building as typed parametric elements with properties and derive plans, sections, elevations and schedules from that model.
inputs: design layout; element types; levels and grids; project standards
outputs: building information model (native and IFC); drawings and schedules derived from it
benchmark_note: model validity against information delivery specifications is checkable; whether the model is the intended building needs a reference
state_of_art: Autodesk Revit; Graphisoft Archicad; Vectorworks Architect; Nemetschek Allplan

name: Steel and reinforcement detailing
definition: Given member sizes, connection designs and reinforcement requirements, model the fabrication detail and produce shop drawings, bar schedules and fabrication files.
inputs: analysis model results; member sizes; connection types; concrete outlines; reinforcement rules
outputs: detailed steel and rebar model; shop drawings; bar bending schedules; numerical-control files
benchmark_note: bar schedules and bending dimensions follow from detailing standards and can be checked; connection design checks belong to simulate
state_of_art: Trimble Tekla Structures; Autodesk Advance Steel; SDS2; Allplan Reinforcement

name: Interior, kitchen and fixture layout
definition: Given a room and a product catalog, lay out cabinets, furniture, fixtures and finishes that meet clearance rules, and produce elevations and order lists.
inputs: room geometry; product catalogs; clearance and accessibility rules
outputs: furnished plan and elevations; finish and tile layout; order list
benchmark_note: clearance and accessibility rules are checkable; layout quality is judged by people
state_of_art: 2020 Design Live; Chief Architect; Vectorworks Spotlight

name: Landscape and hardscape design
definition: Given a site plan, design planting, hardscape patterns and irrigation layout and produce plans and quantities.
inputs: site plan and grades; plant palette; paver and wall systems; irrigation sources
outputs: planting and hardscape plans; irrigation layout; plant and material schedules
benchmark_note: coverage, spacing and quantity takeoffs are computable; design quality is not
state_of_art: Vectorworks Landmark; Land F/X; DynaSCAPE

name: Model coordination and clash detection
definition: Given federated discipline models, detect hard and clearance clashes and track them as coordination issues.
inputs: architectural, structural and services models (native or IFC); clash rules and tolerances
outputs: clash list with locations and grouping; issues in BIM Collaboration Format
benchmark_note: geometric clashes between given models are deterministic
state_of_art: Autodesk Navisworks; Solibri Office; Revizto

name: Automated building model checking
definition: Given a building model and a rule set derived from codes or information requirements, report each rule's pass or fail with the offending elements.
inputs: IFC model; rule set (information delivery specification, code clauses)
outputs: pass and fail results per rule and element
benchmark_note: rule execution is deterministic; turning code text into executable rules is an open problem with no shared test set
state_of_art: Solibri Office; Autodesk Revit Model Checker

name: Construction specification authoring
definition: Given the project scope and a master guide specification, edit and assemble the project manual sections that state materials, products and execution requirements.
inputs: project scope and model; master guide specifications; owner standards
outputs: project manual organized by MasterFormat sections; coordination report against drawings
benchmark_note: section completeness and consistency with the model are checkable; specification prose is not
state_of_art: SpecsIntact; Deltek Specpoint; NBS Chorus; BSD SpecLink

name: Civil site, road and corridor design
definition: Given survey data and design criteria, author the geometry of roads, rail, sites and earthworks as alignments, corridors and design surfaces.

name: Terrain and design surface modeling
definition: Given survey points, breaklines and boundaries, build existing and proposed terrain surfaces and derive contours, slopes and spot elevations.
inputs: survey points; breaklines; boundaries; design feature lines
outputs: triangulated surfaces; contours; slope and elevation analysis
benchmark_note: surfaces, contours and volumes from given points and breaklines are deterministic
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; Bentley OpenRoads Designer; 12d Model

name: Horizontal and vertical alignment design
definition: Given control points, design speed and geometric criteria, lay out tangents, curves, spirals and vertical curves that satisfy sight distance, superelevation and grade limits.
inputs: corridor control points; design speed; geometric design criteria (road or rail)
outputs: horizontal alignment; profile; superelevation; criteria compliance report
benchmark_note: geometric design criteria are explicit formulas, and alignments exchanged in LandXML or IFC can be compared exactly
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; Bentley OpenRoads Designer; Bentley OpenRail Designer; 12d Model

name: Corridor and cross-section modeling
definition: Given an alignment, profile and typical sections, build a 3D corridor model with cross sections, intersections and finished-grade surfaces.
inputs: alignment and profile; typical section assemblies; targets and transitions; existing surface
outputs: corridor model; cross sections; finished surfaces; intersection and roundabout geometry
benchmark_note: cross-section geometry is deterministic for a given template; template choice is design judgment
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; Bentley OpenRoads Designer; Trimble Quantm

name: Earthwork volumes and mass haul
definition: Given existing and design surfaces, compute cut and fill volumes by station and a mass haul diagram, and balance the earthwork.
inputs: existing and design surfaces or cross sections; shrink and swell factors; haul constraints
outputs: cut and fill volumes; mass haul diagram; balance points and haul plan
benchmark_note: average-end-area and surface-to-surface volumes are deterministic
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; Trimble Business Center; Carlson Civil

name: Site grading and drainage layout
definition: Given a site plan and drainage requirements, grade pads, slopes and paved areas and lay out inlets and pipe networks for later hydraulic analysis.
inputs: site plan; existing surface; grading criteria; outfalls
outputs: grading plan and design surface; drainage structure and pipe layout
benchmark_note: slope and cover criteria are checkable; layout optimality is not
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; Bentley OpenSite Designer

name: Subdivision lot and parcel layout
definition: Given a boundary, zoning rules and a street layout, subdivide land into lots meeting area and frontage minimums and produce plat geometry.
inputs: boundary; zoning minimums; street rights of way; easements
outputs: lot layout; areas and frontages; plat geometry and legal-description data
benchmark_note: areas and frontages are exact and lot yield is measurable; plat review is not
state_of_art: Autodesk Civil 3D; TestFit

name: Vehicle swept path analysis
definition: Given a design vehicle and a path through a layout, compute the swept envelope and report encroachments.
inputs: design vehicle dimensions and steering; path; curb and lane geometry
outputs: swept envelopes; encroachment locations
benchmark_note: the kinematic vehicle model gives determinate envelopes for a given path
state_of_art: Transoft AutoTURN; Autodesk Vehicle Tracking

name: Bridge geometric layout
definition: Given a roadway alignment and superstructure type, lay out piers, bearings and girder lines and compute deck and seat elevations.
inputs: alignment and profile; superelevation; span arrangement; girder type
outputs: girder and bearing layout; deck, haunch and seat elevations
benchmark_note: elevations follow deterministically from alignment, profile and girder geometry
state_of_art: Bentley OpenBridge Modeler; Autodesk InfraWorks

name: Plant and building services layout
definition: Given process or building service requirements and a spatial model, author the system schematics and route pipes, ducts and supports through 3D space, producing fabrication drawings and lists.

name: Piping and instrumentation diagram authoring
definition: Given a process flow scheme, author an intelligent piping and instrumentation diagram with tagged equipment, lines, valves and instruments and their data, or recover one from a drawing.
inputs: process flow diagram; equipment and line lists; instrument and valve specifications; or a raster P&ID
outputs: data-rich P&ID; line, equipment and instrument lists; loop diagrams; DEXPI export
benchmark_note: P&ID digitization datasets (Dataset-P&ID) and DEXPI consistency rules allow scoring; design correctness needs process review
state_of_art: Hexagon Smart P&ID; AVEVA Diagrams; Autodesk AutoCAD Plant 3D P&ID

name: Plant equipment arrangement
definition: Given equipment, process connectivity and site constraints, place equipment, structures and platforms in a 3D plant or ship model meeting spacing, access and safety rules.
inputs: equipment list and dimensions; P&ID connectivity; plot or hull; spacing and access rules
outputs: 3D plant arrangement; plot plan; clearance and access report
benchmark_note: spacing and access rules are checkable, but plant layout is a multi-objective design problem with no reference answers
state_of_art: AVEVA E3D Design; Hexagon Smart 3D; Autodesk AutoCAD Plant 3D

name: Specification-driven pipe routing
definition: Given nozzle locations, line list and piping specifications, route pipes with spec-correct fittings, valves and supports around obstacles.
inputs: equipment nozzles; line list; piping class specifications; obstacles; support standards
outputs: 3D piping model with components and supports; clash and spec-compliance report
benchmark_note: spec compliance and clashes are checkable and route length and fittings count are measurable; there is no standard instance set
state_of_art: AVEVA E3D Design; Hexagon Smart 3D; Hexagon CADWorx Plant

name: Piping isometric and spool generation
definition: Given a 3D piping model, generate dimensioned isometric drawings, fabrication spools, cut lists and material take-off.
inputs: 3D piping model; drawing and spool-break rules
outputs: isometric drawings; spool sheets; weld and cut lists; bill of materials
benchmark_note: dimensions and material lists are determinate from the model
state_of_art: Hexagon Isogen; Hexagon Spoolgen; AVEVA E3D Design

name: Duct layout and sizing
definition: Given air terminals with flows and a building model, route and size ductwork by a standard method and produce fabrication fittings.
inputs: terminal airflows; air handler locations; building model; sizing method (equal friction, static regain)
outputs: duct layout and sizes; fitting list; fabrication drawings and patterns
benchmark_note: equal-friction and static-regain sizing give determinate sizes from the ASHRAE duct design method
state_of_art: Autodesk Revit (MEP); Trimble SysQue; Trimble QuickPen DuctDesigner 3D

name: Plumbing and fire sprinkler layout
definition: Given fixtures or hazard classification and a building model, lay out and size plumbing or sprinkler piping to code.
inputs: fixture schedule or occupancy hazard; building model; water supply; plumbing or sprinkler code
outputs: pipe layout and sizes; head spacing; fixture-unit or hydraulic design basis
benchmark_note: fixture-unit sizing and sprinkler spacing rules are determinate; the hydraulic calculation is simulate
state_of_art: M.E.P. CAD AutoSPRINK; HydraCAD; Autodesk Revit (MEP)

name: Electrical wiring and harness design
definition: Given a machine's, vehicle's or installation's electrical functions, author wiring schematics, panel layouts, cable routes and harnesses with consistent connectivity and manufacturing documents.

name: Control schematics and panel layout
definition: Given control functions, input and output lists and device catalogs, draw wiring schematics with cross-references and wire numbers and lay out the enclosure and terminals.
inputs: control narrative; input and output list; device catalog; reference designation rules
outputs: wiring diagrams; terminal and wire lists; panel layout; device bill of materials
benchmark_note: connectivity, cross-reference and designation consistency are checkable; the control design itself is judged by review
state_of_art: EPLAN Electric P8; Autodesk AutoCAD Electrical; Zuken E3.series; SEE Electrical

name: Cable tray, raceway and cable routing
definition: Given a cable list and a tray and conduit network, route each cable, compute fill and lengths, and produce cable schedules.
inputs: cable list with sizes and endpoints; tray and conduit network; segregation and fill rules
outputs: cable routes and lengths; tray and conduit fill; cable and pull schedules
benchmark_note: shortest feasible routes and fill percentages are determinate under stated rules
state_of_art: Hexagon Smart Electrical; AVEVA Electrical

name: Wire harness design
definition: Given logical connectivity and a 3D routing path, define the harness topology, wires, connectors and protection and produce lengths, formboard drawings and a bill of materials.
inputs: logical wiring connectivity; 3D bundle paths; connector and terminal libraries; wire rules
outputs: harness topology; wire cut lengths; formboard drawing; harness bill of materials
benchmark_note: lengths and bills of materials are determinate from topology; routing quality is not
state_of_art: Siemens Capital; Zuken E3.series; Dassault Systemes CATIA Electrical

name: Printed circuit board design
definition: Given a circuit's function and component choices, capture its schematic and lay out a manufacturable board with placed parts and routed interconnect.

name: Schematic capture and netlisting
definition: Given a circuit's function and selected components, draw a hierarchical schematic, pass electrical rule checks and export a netlist.
inputs: block diagram or specification; component library; design rules for connectivity
outputs: schematic; netlist; electrical rule check report
benchmark_note: netlist equivalence with a reference and electrical rule checks are exact; producing a working schematic from a specification can be scored by simulation
state_of_art: Altium Designer; Cadence OrCAD Capture; Siemens Xpedition Designer

name: Symbol and footprint creation
definition: Given a component datasheet, create its schematic symbol, land pattern and 3D body to the governing land-pattern standard.
inputs: datasheet package drawing and pinout; land-pattern standard and density level
outputs: schematic symbol; footprint with pads, courtyard and silkscreen; 3D model
benchmark_note: IPC-7351 formulas give reference pad geometry, and pinouts can be checked against datasheets
state_of_art: Altium Designer; Siemens PADS Professional; SnapMagic; Ultra Librarian

name: Stackup and controlled impedance design
definition: Given target impedances, layer count and materials, choose a layer stackup and trace geometries that meet impedance and manufacturing limits.
inputs: target single-ended and differential impedances; material properties; fabricator limits
outputs: layer stackup; trace widths and spacings per layer; impedance tables
benchmark_note: impedances can be checked against 2D field-solver references
state_of_art: Polar Instruments Si9000; Altium Designer Layer Stack Manager

name: Board component placement
definition: Given a netlist, board outline and placement constraints, position components to minimize wirelength and meet keep-outs, thermal and grouping rules.
inputs: netlist; footprints; board outline; keep-outs; placement rooms and constraints
outputs: placed board; ratsnest wirelength and congestion estimates
benchmark_note: wirelength and rule compliance are measurable on open-hardware boards, but there is no standard placement suite
state_of_art: Cadence Allegro X; Siemens Xpedition; Altium Designer; Zuken CR-8000

name: Board interconnect routing
definition: Given a placed board and net classes, route all connections with traces and vias meeting width, clearance, differential-pair and length-matching rules.
inputs: placed board; net classes; clearance, width, via and length rules; layer stackup
outputs: routed board; completion rate; via count; length-matching report
benchmark_note: completion, rule violations, via count and wirelength are measurable on open designs; no standard instance set exists
state_of_art: Cadence Allegro PCB Router; Siemens Xpedition; Altium Designer

name: Board design rule checking
definition: Given a laid-out board and a rule deck covering electrical, fabrication and assembly limits, report every violation with its location.
inputs: board layout; design rules; fabricator capabilities
outputs: violation list; manufacturability report
benchmark_note: rule checking is deterministic against a given deck
state_of_art: Siemens Valor NPI; Cadence Allegro Constraint Manager; Altium Designer

name: Fabrication and assembly outputs
definition: Given a finished board, generate the fabrication and assembly data set and verify it against the design netlist.
inputs: finished board design; output conventions
outputs: Gerber, ODB++ or IPC-2581 data; drill files; pick-and-place file; assembly bill of materials; test netlist
benchmark_note: outputs can be checked against the design netlist and geometry
state_of_art: Altium Designer; Siemens Valor; DownStream CAM350

name: Circuit and interconnect simulation
definition: Given a circuit or interconnect netlist with device models and stimuli, compute its electrical behavior in time or frequency.

name: Analog circuit simulation
definition: Given a transistor- or component-level netlist with device models and sources, compute operating points, AC response, transients and noise.
inputs: SPICE netlist; device models; sources and analysis commands
outputs: node voltages and branch currents over time or frequency; noise; measurements
benchmark_note: analytic circuits and cross-simulator references give exact or agreed answers; designing a circuit to a specification can be scored by simulating it
state_of_art: Cadence Spectre; Synopsys HSPICE; Siemens Eldo; Analog Devices LTspice

name: Fast transistor-level simulation
definition: Given a large transistor-level netlist, simulate it with table, switch-level or partitioned methods trading bounded accuracy for speed.
inputs: full-block or full-chip transistor netlist; models; stimuli; accuracy settings
outputs: waveforms and measurements; error against a reference simulation
benchmark_note: accuracy against SPICE references and runtime are measurable; large open netlists are few
state_of_art: Synopsys PrimeSim; Cadence Spectre FX; Siemens Analog FastSPICE

name: Mixed-signal and behavioral simulation
definition: Given a design mixing analog, digital and behavioral models, co-simulate the parts at their own levels of abstraction.
inputs: SPICE netlists; HDL blocks; Verilog-A or VHDL-AMS behavioral models; stimuli
outputs: mixed analog and digital waveforms; system-level measurements
benchmark_note: results can be compared with full transistor-level references; few public mixed-signal test cases exist
state_of_art: Cadence Spectre AMS Designer; Siemens Symphony; Synopsys Saber

name: Radio frequency circuit simulation
definition: Given an RF or microwave circuit with distributed elements and nonlinear devices, compute S-parameters, harmonic balance and envelope responses.
inputs: RF schematic; transmission-line and S-parameter models; nonlinear device models; tones
outputs: S-parameters; gain, noise figure, compression and intermodulation; matching networks
benchmark_note: S-parameters of standard networks have analytic references, and filter and matching syntheses are checkable
state_of_art: Keysight ADS; Cadence AWR Microwave Office; Cadence Spectre RF

name: Signal integrity and channel analysis
definition: Given driver and receiver models and interconnect S-parameters, compute reflections, crosstalk, eye diagrams and channel margins.
inputs: IBIS or IBIS-AMI models; interconnect S-parameters or extracted traces; data patterns
outputs: waveforms; eye diagrams; crosstalk; bit error rate and channel operating margin
benchmark_note: the IEEE 802.3 channel operating margin reference code and public channel files give a shared metric; other interfaces lack one
state_of_art: Siemens HyperLynx; Cadence Sigrity; Keysight ADS SIPro and ChannelSim; Ansys SIwave

name: Board and package power integrity
definition: Given a board or package power distribution network and its decoupling, compute impedance against target, DC voltage drop and an optimized decoupling set.
inputs: board or package layout; decoupling capacitor models; current demands; target impedance
outputs: network impedance versus frequency; DC drop and current density; decoupling selection
benchmark_note: target-impedance compliance and capacitor count are measurable; there is no public instance set
state_of_art: Cadence Sigrity PowerSI and PowerDC; Siemens HyperLynx PI; Ansys SIwave

name: Device model parameter extraction
definition: Given measured current-voltage and capacitance-voltage data, fit compact device model parameters for circuit simulation.
inputs: device measurements across bias, geometry and temperature; compact model choice
outputs: fitted model card; fit error per characteristic
benchmark_note: fit error against measured data is computable
state_of_art: Keysight IC-CAP; Keysight Model Builder Program

name: Digital logic design and verification
definition: Given a functional specification, produce register-transfer-level hardware descriptions and demonstrate by simulation and formal methods that they meet it, including mapping to programmable logic.

name: Register-transfer-level design
definition: Given a functional and interface specification, write synthesizable hardware description code that implements it.
inputs: specification; interface protocols and timing diagrams; target clocking and reset scheme
outputs: synthesizable Verilog, VHDL or SystemVerilog; interface timing description
benchmark_note: VerilogEval, RTLLM and the Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems set score functional correctness by simulation against reference testbenches
state_of_art: Siemens HDL Designer; Sigasi Visual HDL

name: High-level synthesis
definition: Given an algorithm in C, C++ or SystemC with throughput and resource constraints, schedule and bind it into register-transfer-level hardware.
inputs: untimed algorithm source; clock target; directives for pipelining, unrolling and interfaces
outputs: RTL; schedule; latency, throughput and area estimates
benchmark_note: CHStone, MachSuite and PolyBench give functional checks and comparable latency and area results
state_of_art: Siemens Catapult HLS; Cadence Stratus HLS; AMD Vitis HLS

name: Hardware description language simulation
definition: Given RTL or gate-level code and a testbench, simulate it event-driven or cycle-based and produce waveforms and check results.
inputs: RTL or gate-level netlist; testbench; timing annotations
outputs: waveforms; assertion and check results; simulation logs
benchmark_note: language conformance suites such as sv-tests and throughput on open designs are measurable
state_of_art: Synopsys VCS; Cadence Xcelium; Siemens Questa

name: Testbench and coverage-driven verification
definition: Given a design and its specification, build a self-checking testbench with stimulus, reference model and functional coverage, and drive coverage to closure while finding bugs.
inputs: design under test; specification; verification plan
outputs: testbench; coverage model and results; bug reports
benchmark_note: coverage reached and seeded bugs found are measurable, and the Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems set includes verification tasks
state_of_art: Cadence Xcelium with vManager; Synopsys VCS with Verdi; Siemens Questa

name: Formal property and equivalence checking
definition: Given a design with temporal properties, or two designs, prove the properties or their equivalence or return a counterexample trace.
inputs: RTL or netlist; assertions and assumptions; or a reference and a revised design
outputs: proofs, bounded results or counterexample traces; equivalence verdict
benchmark_note: the Hardware Model Checking Competition supplies instances with known results; equivalence is exact
state_of_art: Cadence Jasper; Synopsys VC Formal; Synopsys Formality; Cadence Conformal

name: Design linting and clock-domain crossing
definition: Given RTL with its clock and reset structure, report coding-rule violations and unsafe clock- and reset-domain crossings.
inputs: RTL; clock and reset definitions; rule set
outputs: lint violations; crossing report with synchronizer analysis
benchmark_note: designs with seeded violations can be scored; there is no standard public suite
state_of_art: Synopsys SpyGlass; Siemens Questa CDC; Real Intent Meridian CDC

name: Programmable logic implementation
definition: Given RTL, timing constraints and a target field-programmable gate array, synthesize, place and route the design and produce a configuration bitstream.
inputs: RTL; constraints; device and package
outputs: bitstream; utilization and timing reports
benchmark_note: the VTR and Titan benchmark suites and the ISPD 2016 and 2017 FPGA placement contests give comparable quality-of-result measures
state_of_art: AMD Vivado; Intel Quartus Prime; Synopsys Synplify Pro

name: Microarchitecture performance modeling
definition: Given an instruction set, microarchitectural parameters and workloads, simulate or model the design to predict cycles, throughput and power before implementation.
inputs: instruction set; pipeline, cache and memory parameters; workload binaries or traces
outputs: cycle counts and instructions per cycle; cache and branch statistics; power estimates
benchmark_note: ChampSim trace sets and SPEC CPU workloads give shared inputs; accuracy can be checked against hardware counters
state_of_art: Synopsys Platform Architect; Arm Fast Models

name: Digital integrated circuit implementation
definition: Given verified RTL, a cell library and constraints, synthesize, insert test structures, place, clock and route the design and close timing and power to produce a layout.

name: Logic synthesis and technology mapping
definition: Given RTL, a standard-cell library and timing constraints, produce an optimized gate-level netlist that meets timing at minimum area and power.
inputs: RTL; Liberty cell library; design constraints
outputs: gate-level netlist; area, timing and power reports
benchmark_note: the EPFL combinational benchmark suite keeps best-known results, and IWLS and ISCAS circuits are standard
state_of_art: Synopsys Fusion Compiler; Cadence Genus

name: Design for test and pattern generation
definition: Given a gate-level netlist, insert scan chains, built-in self-test and boundary scan and generate test patterns that maximize fault coverage with few patterns.
inputs: gate-level netlist; fault models; test architecture constraints
outputs: test-ready netlist; test patterns; fault coverage; boundary-scan description
benchmark_note: ISCAS'85, ISCAS'89 and ITC'99 circuits give comparable fault coverage and pattern counts
state_of_art: Siemens Tessent; Synopsys TestMAX; Cadence Modus

name: Floorplanning and power planning
definition: Given a netlist with macros, a die outline and input-output requirements, place macros and pins and build the power grid.
inputs: netlist; macro abstracts; die and core size; pin constraints; power budget
outputs: floorplan; macro and pin placement; power grid
benchmark_note: MCNC and GSRC floorplanning benchmarks, and macro placement test cases on open designs, have published results
state_of_art: Cadence Innovus; Synopsys IC Compiler II; Synopsys Fusion Compiler

name: Standard cell placement
definition: Given a floorplanned netlist, place standard cells legally to minimize wirelength, congestion and timing violations.
inputs: floorplanned netlist; cell library abstracts; timing constraints
outputs: legal placement; wirelength, density and timing metrics
benchmark_note: ISPD 2005 and 2006 placement contests and the ICCAD 2015 timing-driven placement contest supply instances and scores
state_of_art: Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Fusion Compiler

name: Clock tree synthesis
definition: Given placed clock sinks and skew, latency and slew targets, build a buffered clock distribution network.
inputs: placed design; clock definitions; buffer library; skew and slew targets
outputs: clock tree; skew, latency and power report
benchmark_note: the ISPD 2009 and 2010 clock network synthesis contests provide instances and evaluation
state_of_art: Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Fusion Compiler

name: Global and detailed routing
definition: Given a placed and clocked design and routing rules, route all nets on the metal layers without design rule violations.
inputs: placed design; technology routing rules; layer stack
outputs: routed layout; wirelength, via count and rule violations
benchmark_note: ISPD 2007 and 2008 global routing and ISPD 2018 and 2019 detailed routing contests provide instances and evaluators
state_of_art: Cadence Innovus; Synopsys Fusion Compiler

name: Static timing analysis and closure
definition: Given a netlist, parasitics, cell timing models and constraints, compute arrival times and slacks and resize or restructure gates to close timing.
inputs: netlist; parasitics; Liberty timing models; design constraints; corners
outputs: slack and critical-path reports; timing fixes (sizing, buffering, engineering change orders)
benchmark_note: TAU timing analysis contests and ISPD 2012 and 2013 gate sizing contests provide instances and golden results
state_of_art: Synopsys PrimeTime; Cadence Tempus

name: Power analysis and low-power design
definition: Given a netlist, switching activity and power intent, estimate dynamic and leakage power and apply gating, multi-voltage and power-shutoff structures.
inputs: netlist; switching activity; power intent; library power models
outputs: power reports by block and mode; low-power structures; power-intent checks
benchmark_note: estimates can be checked against gate-level simulation references; there is no standard suite
state_of_art: Synopsys PrimePower; Cadence Joules; Ansys PowerArtist

name: Analog and custom IC design
definition: Given circuit specifications and a process design kit, design transistor-level circuits, size them, draw their layout and build the cell and memory libraries digital flows consume.

name: Transistor-level circuit design
definition: Given block specifications, choose a circuit topology and draw the transistor-level schematic with its test benches.
inputs: specifications (gain, bandwidth, noise, power, offset); process design kit
outputs: transistor-level schematic; simulation test benches
benchmark_note: whether a design meets its specification is checkable by simulation on open process kits such as SkyWater SKY130; topology choice is open-ended
state_of_art: Cadence Virtuoso Schematic Editor; Synopsys Custom Compiler; Siemens Tanner S-Edit

name: Analog circuit sizing
definition: Given a topology, specifications and process corners, choose device sizes and biases that meet all specifications with margin.
inputs: schematic topology; specifications; process corners and mismatch models
outputs: device sizes and biases; specification margins across corners and Monte Carlo
benchmark_note: specifications are verified by simulation on open process kits, and standard amplifier and regulator test benches recur in the literature
state_of_art: Siemens Solido Design Environment; Cadence Virtuoso ADE optimization; MunEDA WiCkeD

name: Custom and analog layout
definition: Given a transistor-level schematic and process rules, draw or generate a matched, rule-clean physical layout.
inputs: schematic; process design kit; matching and symmetry constraints; floorplan
outputs: polygon layout (GDSII or OASIS); rule-check and layout-versus-schematic results
benchmark_note: rule-cleanliness and post-layout performance are measurable, and ALIGN and MAGICAL publish test circuits; layout quality beyond that is judged
state_of_art: Cadence Virtuoso Layout Suite; Synopsys Custom Compiler

name: Cell library and memory generation
definition: Given a process and cell or memory specifications, generate standard cells or memory arrays and characterize their timing and power into library models.
inputs: process design kit; cell list or memory size and ports; characterization corners
outputs: cell or memory layouts and abstracts; Liberty timing and power tables; behavioral models
benchmark_note: characterized tables can be compared with SPICE references, and generated memories are checkable by simulation and layout verification
state_of_art: Cadence Liberate; Synopsys PrimeLib; foundry memory compilers

name: Microelectromechanical device design
definition: Given a MEMS device concept and fabrication process, create its parameterized layout and process-aware 3D model for downstream physics simulation.
inputs: device concept; process flow and layer stack; design rules
outputs: mask layout; 3D device model; component-level behavioral model
benchmark_note: layouts can be rule-checked; device performance needs physics simulation
state_of_art: Coventor CoventorWare; Coventor MEMS+; Siemens Tanner L-Edit MEMS

name: IC physical verification and signoff
definition: Given a completed IC layout, verify it against manufacturing rules and its netlist, extract parasitics, check power-grid integrity and prepare mask data.

name: Layout design rule checking
definition: Given a layout and a foundry rule deck, report every geometric rule violation with its location.
inputs: GDSII or OASIS layout; rule deck
outputs: violation database with markers
benchmark_note: rule checking is deterministic against a deck, and open process kits publish decks
state_of_art: Siemens Calibre; Synopsys IC Validator; Cadence Pegasus

name: Layout versus schematic checking
definition: Given a layout and its reference netlist, extract devices and connectivity from the layout and report any mismatch.
inputs: layout; reference netlist; extraction rules
outputs: extracted netlist; match or mismatch report with locations
benchmark_note: comparison results are exact for given inputs
state_of_art: Siemens Calibre; Synopsys IC Validator; Cadence Pegasus

name: Parasitic resistance and capacitance extraction
definition: Given a routed layout and process interconnect description, compute parasitic resistances and capacitances for post-layout timing and simulation.
inputs: routed layout; interconnect technology description; corners
outputs: parasitic netlist (SPEF or DSPF)
benchmark_note: accuracy against 3D field-solver references is measurable, but no open standard suite exists
state_of_art: Synopsys StarRC; Cadence Quantus; Siemens Calibre xACT

name: On-chip voltage drop and electromigration
definition: Given a power grid, current sources and process limits, compute static and dynamic voltage drop and electromigration violations.
inputs: power grid layout and parasitics; current maps or activity; electromigration rules
outputs: voltage-drop maps; electromigration violations
benchmark_note: the ICCAD 2023 contest on static voltage-drop prediction and the CircuitNet dataset provide cases with golden results
state_of_art: Ansys RedHawk-SC; Cadence Voltus

name: Optical proximity correction and hotspot detection
definition: Given drawn layout and a lithography model, modify mask shapes so that printed patterns match intent and flag hotspots that will not print reliably.
inputs: layout; lithography and resist models; process window
outputs: corrected mask data; printed-contour error; hotspot list
benchmark_note: the ICCAD 2012 hotspot detection and ICCAD 2013 mask optimization contests provide instances and scoring
state_of_art: Siemens Calibre nmOPC; Synopsys Proteus; ASML Brion Tachyon

name: Quantity takeoff and cost estimating
definition: Given drawings, models or design parameters, measure quantities and price them into a cost estimate for a building, structure or product.

name: Quantity takeoff from drawings
definition: Given drawing sheets as PDF, raster or CAD, measure counts, lengths, areas and volumes of each work item by trade.
inputs: drawing sheets; scale; item and assembly definitions
outputs: quantities by item, location and trade
benchmark_note: counts, lengths and areas on given drawings have exact answers; floor plan datasets such as CubiCasa5K support area checks
state_of_art: Bluebeam Revu; PlanSwift; On Center On-Screen Takeoff; Togal.AI

name: Model-based quantity takeoff
definition: Given a building or civil information model, extract quantities by classification for estimating.
inputs: building or civil model; classification system; measurement rules
outputs: quantities by element and classification
benchmark_note: quantities computed from model geometry under stated rules are deterministic
state_of_art: Autodesk Takeoff; RIB CostX; RIB iTWO

name: Roof measurement and layout
definition: Given a roof plan, aerial image or pitches, compute true roof areas, edge lengths and material quantities, including tapered insulation layouts.
inputs: roof outline; pitches; or aerial imagery; material systems
outputs: roof facets and true areas; ridge, hip, valley and eave lengths; material and taper layouts
benchmark_note: true areas and edge lengths follow from plan geometry and pitch
state_of_art: EagleView; AppliCad Roof Wizard; Hover

name: Construction cost estimating and bidding
definition: Given quantities, unit costs, crew productivity and markups, produce a priced construction estimate or bid.
inputs: quantities; cost database; labor rates and productivity; equipment; markups
outputs: itemized estimate; bid summary; cost breakdown by classification
benchmark_note: pricing arithmetic is checkable, but accuracy against actual cost needs bid and outcome data that are rarely public
state_of_art: Trimble WinEst; Sage Estimating; HCSS HeavyBid; Autodesk ProEst; RSMeans Data

name: Apparel, jewelry and craft design
definition: Given a style and fit or form requirements, author the patterns, models or stitch programs from which garments, jewelry, textiles and craft goods are made.

name: Garment pattern drafting
definition: Given body measurements and a style, draft the flat pattern pieces of a garment with seam allowances, notches and grain lines.
inputs: body measurements or size chart; style description or sketch; fabric properties
outputs: pattern pieces with annotations; tech pack data
benchmark_note: measurement-driven drafts can be checked against drafting systems, and sewing-pattern datasets such as GarmentCode exist; fit and style are judged
state_of_art: Lectra Modaris; Gerber AccuMark; Optitex PDS; CLO 3D

name: Pattern grading
definition: Given a base-size pattern, a size chart and grade rules, generate the pattern in every size.
inputs: base pattern; size chart; grade rules
outputs: graded nest of sizes
benchmark_note: rule-based grading is deterministic
state_of_art: Gerber AccuMark; Lectra Modaris

name: Virtual garment fitting
definition: Given pattern pieces, an avatar and fabric properties, sew and drape the garment virtually to evaluate fit and appearance before sampling.
inputs: pattern pieces and sewing instructions; avatar; fabric mechanical properties
outputs: draped garment; strain and pressure fit maps; renders
benchmark_note: drape can be compared with physical drape tests; fit judgment is human
state_of_art: CLO 3D; Browzwear VStitcher

name: Jewelry and gemstone design
definition: Given a design concept and stones, model rings, settings and stone layouts for casting or printing, or design gemstone facet diagrams.
inputs: concept; finger or chain sizes; stone sizes and shapes; metal; for gems, rough dimensions and refractive index
outputs: printable or castable jewelry model with metal weight; facet diagram and cutting instructions
benchmark_note: metal weight, stone fit and facet light return are computable; design is judged
state_of_art: Gemvision MatrixGold; RhinoGold; 3Design

name: Embroidery and quilt design
definition: Given artwork or a block layout, produce machine stitch programs or quilt layouts with yardage.
inputs: artwork; fabric and thread; stitch types; or quilt block and layout choices
outputs: machine embroidery stitch file; quilt layout and fabric yardage
benchmark_note: stitch count, density and yardage are measurable; visual fidelity needs judgment
state_of_art: Wilcom EmbroideryStudio; Hatch Embroidery; Electric Quilt

name: Textile print repeat design
definition: Given motifs and a repeat type, compose a seamless repeating print and its colorways for textile printing.
inputs: motifs; repeat type and size; color palette
outputs: seamless repeat tile; colorway separations
benchmark_note: seamlessness and color count are checkable; aesthetics are not
state_of_art: Lectra Kaledo; NedGraphics

name: Cabinet and millwork design
definition: Given a room layout and a construction standard, design cabinets and millwork and generate parts lists and cut lists.
inputs: room layout; cabinet construction standards; materials and hardware
outputs: cabinet models; parts and cut lists; shop drawings
benchmark_note: part dimensions follow from construction rules and are checkable
state_of_art: Hexagon Cabinet Vision; Microvellum; KCD

name: Simulate and analyze physical behavior
definition: Predicting how a designed or built system behaves by solving its physics: structures, fluids, heat, fields, mechanisms, chemical processes, engineered networks, and system dynamics and control design.

name: Structural finite element analysis
definition: Given a part or assembly idealized as solids, shells or beams with materials, loads and constraints, compute displacements, stresses, natural frequencies, dynamic response and stability limits.

name: Linear static stress analysis
definition: Given an elastic body under small-displacement loads and constraints, compute displacement, strain and stress fields.
inputs: geometry or mesh; linear elastic materials; loads; constraints
outputs: displacement, strain and stress fields; reaction forces
benchmark_note: NAFEMS LE1-LE11 linear elastic benchmarks have reference solutions
state_of_art: Ansys Mechanical; Abaqus/Standard; MSC Nastran; Simcenter Nastran; Altair OptiStruct

name: Normal modes analysis
definition: Given a structure's stiffness, mass and constraints, compute its natural frequencies and mode shapes.
inputs: mesh; materials with density; constraints; optional prestress
outputs: natural frequencies; mode shapes; modal effective mass
benchmark_note: NAFEMS free-vibration (FV) benchmarks have reference frequencies
state_of_art: MSC Nastran SOL 103; Ansys Mechanical; Abaqus/Standard

name: Harmonic, random and spectrum response
definition: Given a linear structure and frequency-domain or shock-spectrum excitation, compute steady-state response amplitudes, power spectral densities or peak responses.
inputs: mesh or modal model; damping; harmonic loads, base PSD or response spectrum
outputs: frequency response functions; RMS and peak stresses and displacements
benchmark_note: NAFEMS forced-vibration benchmarks have reference responses
state_of_art: MSC Nastran SOL 111/112; Ansys Mechanical; Abaqus/Standard

name: Implicit transient dynamic analysis
definition: Given a structure with time-varying loads and initial conditions, integrate the equations of motion in time to obtain the response history.
inputs: mesh; materials; damping; load histories; initial conditions
outputs: displacement, velocity, acceleration and stress histories
benchmark_note: NAFEMS transient dynamics benchmarks and closed-form single-degree-of-freedom solutions
state_of_art: Abaqus/Standard; ADINA; Ansys Mechanical; MSC Nastran SOL 129

name: Linear eigenvalue buckling
definition: Given a structure under a reference load, compute the critical load multipliers and buckled mode shapes.
inputs: mesh; materials; reference loads; constraints
outputs: buckling load factors; buckling mode shapes
benchmark_note: closed-form Euler column, plate and cylinder buckling solutions
state_of_art: MSC Nastran SOL 105; Ansys Mechanical; Abaqus/Standard

name: Thermal stress analysis
definition: Given a temperature field and thermo-elastic material properties, compute the resulting thermal strains, stresses and distortion.
inputs: mesh; temperature field or thermal loads; expansion coefficients; constraints
outputs: thermal displacement and stress fields
benchmark_note: NAFEMS thermo-mechanical benchmarks and closed-form thick-cylinder solutions
state_of_art: Ansys Mechanical; Abaqus/Standard; MSC Nastran

name: Large deformation and contact analysis
definition: Given a structure with large displacements, follower loads or contacting surfaces, solve the nonlinear equilibrium path including contact pressures and post-buckling.
inputs: mesh; materials; contact pairs and friction; load steps
outputs: load-displacement path; contact pressure and status; post-buckled shape
benchmark_note: NAFEMS geometric nonlinear and contact benchmarks (Hertz contact has a closed form)
state_of_art: Abaqus/Standard; Ansys Mechanical; MSC Marc; ADINA

name: Explicit impact and crash simulation
definition: Given a structure, impact or blast conditions and rate-dependent materials, integrate short-duration highly nonlinear dynamics to predict deformation, energy absorption and failure.
inputs: mesh; rate-dependent materials with failure; initial velocities, impacts or blast loads; contact definitions
outputs: deformation history; energy balance; accelerations; failed elements
benchmark_note: Taylor bar impact and public vehicle crash models with test data exist, but no shared scored suite
state_of_art: LS-DYNA; Abaqus/Explicit; Altair Radioss; ESI Virtual Performance Solution (PAM-CRASH)

name: Material nonlinearity and composites
definition: Given a structure and constitutive data for metals, polymers, elastomers or laminated composites, compute inelastic and anisotropic response, ply stresses and failure.

name: Elastic-plastic analysis
definition: Given a metallic structure and a plasticity model with hardening, compute plastic strains, residual stresses and collapse loads.
inputs: mesh; yield surface and hardening data; load history
outputs: plastic strain and residual stress fields; limit load
benchmark_note: NAFEMS plasticity benchmarks and closed-form thick-cylinder autofrettage solutions
state_of_art: Abaqus; Ansys Mechanical; MSC Marc

name: Elastomer and hyperelastic analysis
definition: Given a rubber or soft-material part and test-fitted hyperelastic parameters, compute large-strain deformation and stresses.
inputs: mesh; hyperelastic constants or test curves; loads and contact
outputs: deformed shape; stretch and stress fields; force-deflection curve
benchmark_note: homogeneous-deformation tests have closed forms, but part-level references are scarce
state_of_art: Abaqus; Ansys Mechanical; MSC Marc

name: Creep and viscoelastic analysis
definition: Given a structure at load and temperature over time and a creep or viscoelastic law, compute time-dependent strain, relaxation and rupture life.
inputs: mesh; creep law or Prony series; load and temperature history
outputs: creep strain and stress relaxation over time; creep damage
benchmark_note: NAFEMS creep benchmarks exist; component-level validation data are limited
state_of_art: Abaqus; Ansys Mechanical

name: Laminate stress and ply failure
definition: Given a layup, ply properties and in-plane and bending loads, compute ply stresses and first-ply and last-ply failure envelopes.
inputs: ply properties; stacking sequence; force and moment resultants
outputs: ply stresses and strains; failure indices; failure envelopes
benchmark_note: the World-Wide Failure Exercises (WWFE-I to III) give test data for blind prediction
state_of_art: Ansys Composite PrepPost; Abaqus; MSC Nastran; Altair ESAComp

name: Composite progressive damage
definition: Given a composite structure and damage-initiation and evolution laws, predict delamination, matrix cracking and residual strength.
inputs: mesh with plies and cohesive interfaces; damage parameters; loads
outputs: damage fields; delamination growth; strength and stiffness loss
benchmark_note: WWFE-III and open-hole coupon data exist, but scatter is large
state_of_art: Abaqus; LS-DYNA; Hexagon Digimat

name: Aerospace panel sizing
definition: Given internal loads on stiffened panels and allowables, choose layups and stiffener dimensions that satisfy all failure modes at least weight.
inputs: panel loads from a global model; material allowables; candidate concepts
outputs: panel sizes and layups; margins of safety by failure mode
benchmark_note: classical stiffened-panel test cases exist, but the sizing objective is design-specific
state_of_art: HyperSizer; Altair HyperWorks

name: Multiscale homogenization
definition: Given a representative volume of a heterogeneous material, compute its effective macroscopic properties.
inputs: unit cell geometry; constituent properties; periodic boundary conditions
outputs: effective stiffness, conductivity or strength
benchmark_note: Hashin-Shtrikman bounds and published unit-cell results give references
state_of_art: Hexagon Digimat; Abaqus Micromechanics Plugin

name: Fatigue and fracture analysis
definition: Given stress or strain histories and cracks or flaws in a component, predict fatigue life, crack growth and fracture or flaw acceptability.

name: Stress-life and strain-life fatigue
definition: Given stress or strain histories at critical locations and material S-N or strain-life curves, compute cumulative damage and fatigue life.
inputs: stress results or load histories; S-N or epsilon-N curves; surface factors
outputs: damage and life contours; critical locations
benchmark_note: SAE Fatigue Design and Evaluation keyhole specimen test programs give measured lives
state_of_art: Hottinger Bruel & Kjaer nCode DesignLife; Dassault fe-safe; Ansys Mechanical fatigue

name: Fatigue crack growth
definition: Given an initial crack, geometry, load spectrum and crack-growth law, compute crack length versus cycles and remaining life.
inputs: crack geometry; stress intensity solution; load spectrum; da/dN data
outputs: crack length versus cycles; inspection intervals
benchmark_note: published constant- and variable-amplitude test data exist; no maintained scored suite
state_of_art: NASGRO; AFGROW

name: Fracture parameter computation
definition: Given a cracked body, compute stress intensity factors, J-integral or energy release rate along the crack front.
inputs: mesh with crack front; materials; loads
outputs: K, J or G along the crack front; crack-tip fields
benchmark_note: handbook stress intensity solutions (Tada, Murakami) give references
state_of_art: Abaqus; Ansys Mechanical; FRANC3D; Zencrack

name: Fitness-for-service flaw assessment
definition: Given a detected flaw, component geometry, stresses and toughness, assess acceptability against a failure assessment diagram.
inputs: flaw dimensions; component geometry; primary and secondary stresses; toughness
outputs: failure assessment point; acceptability; critical flaw size
benchmark_note: API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 example problem manual gives worked results
state_of_art: TWI CrackWISE; Quest Integrity Signal FFS

name: Welded joint fatigue
definition: Given welded joint geometry and stresses, compute hot-spot or structural stresses and life against weld classification curves.
inputs: weld geometry; nominal or hot-spot stresses; detail category
outputs: weld fatigue damage and life
benchmark_note: IIW recommendations include worked examples; part-level data are sparse
state_of_art: nCode DesignLife; fe-safe/Verity; FEMFAT

name: Structural frame analysis and code checking
definition: Given a building, bridge, offshore or piping structure as members and connections with code-defined loads, compute member forces and check them against design codes.

name: Linear frame analysis
definition: Given a frame or truss of members, sections, supports and load cases, compute member forces, deflections and reactions.
inputs: member geometry; sections; releases; load cases and combinations
outputs: member forces and moments; deflections; reactions
benchmark_note: textbook and AISC design example frames have closed-form answers
state_of_art: STAAD.Pro; RISA-3D; SAP2000; ETABS; Dlubal RFEM

name: Member design code checking
definition: Given member forces and sections, check steel, concrete, timber or masonry members against a design code and report utilization.
inputs: member forces; section and material grades; design code and options
outputs: utilization ratios; governing clauses; required sizes
benchmark_note: AISC and ACI design example manuals give worked results
state_of_art: RISA-3D; STAAD.Pro; ENERCALC; Tekla Structural Designer

name: Concrete slab and post-tensioned floor analysis
definition: Given a slab layout, supports, tendons and loads, compute moments, deflections and reinforcement or tendon requirements.
inputs: slab geometry; columns and walls; tendon profiles; loads
outputs: moment and deflection fields; reinforcement and tendon design
benchmark_note: Post-Tensioning Institute and code design examples exist
state_of_art: ADAPT-Builder; RAM Concept; SAFE

name: Seismic structural analysis
definition: Given a structural model and ground motions or response spectra, compute seismic demands by spectrum, pushover or nonlinear time-history analysis.
inputs: structural model; mass; spectra or ground-motion records; hysteretic models
outputs: drifts, base shear, member demands; capacity curves
benchmark_note: FEMA P-751 design examples and shake-table blind-prediction contests give references
state_of_art: ETABS; SAP2000; PERFORM-3D; SeismoStruct

name: Bridge load analysis and rating
definition: Given a bridge model and design or rating vehicles, compute moving-load envelopes and load ratings.
inputs: girder or grillage model; lanes; vehicle loads; code factors
outputs: force envelopes; influence lines; rating factors
benchmark_note: FHWA steel and prestressed-concrete bridge design examples give worked results
state_of_art: CSiBridge; Midas Civil; AASHTOWare Bridge Rating; LEAP Bridge

name: Offshore structure analysis
definition: Given a fixed offshore structure and metocean conditions, compute wave and current loads, member stresses and joint code checks.
inputs: jacket or topside model; wave, current and wind data; soil springs
outputs: member and joint utilizations; in-place and fatigue results
benchmark_note: API RP 2A examples exist, but public full-structure references are scarce
state_of_art: SACS; Sesam GeniE; USFOS

name: Piping stress analysis
definition: Given a piping layout, supports, temperatures and pressures, compute pipe stresses, support loads and nozzle loads and check them against a piping code.
inputs: pipe routing; supports; operating conditions; piping code
outputs: code stress ratios; support and nozzle loads; displacements
benchmark_note: NRC piping benchmark problems (NUREG/CR-1677) give reference solutions
state_of_art: CAESAR II; AutoPIPE; ROHR2

name: Geotechnical analysis
definition: Given soil or rock stratigraphy, properties and an engineered structure such as a slope, foundation, pile, pavement or excavation, compute stability, seepage, settlement and soil-structure response.

name: Slope stability analysis
definition: Given a slope or embankment section, soil strengths and pore pressures, find the critical slip surface and factor of safety.
inputs: cross-section; soil strengths; pore pressures; loads
outputs: critical slip surface; factor of safety
benchmark_note: the ACADS slope stability verification problems have referee answers
state_of_art: GeoStudio SLOPE/W; Slide2; D-Stability

name: Seepage through earthworks
definition: Given a dam, levee or excavation section with permeabilities and water levels, compute pore pressures, flow rates and exit gradients.
inputs: section; hydraulic conductivity functions; boundary heads
outputs: pore pressure field; seepage flux; exit gradients
benchmark_note: analytical flow-net and Dupuit solutions give references
state_of_art: GeoStudio SEEP/W; SVFLUX; PLAXIS

name: Consolidation and settlement
definition: Given a foundation load on compressible soils, compute immediate and consolidation settlement over time.
inputs: soil profile; compressibility and consolidation parameters; loads
outputs: settlement versus time; excess pore pressure
benchmark_note: Terzaghi one-dimensional and Mandel consolidation problems have closed forms
state_of_art: GeoStudio SIGMA/W; Settle3; PLAXIS

name: Pile driving and capacity analysis
definition: Given a pile, hammer and soil model, or measured driving signals, predict drivability and stresses or back-calculate pile capacity by wave-equation analysis.
inputs: pile and hammer properties; soil resistance model; or force and velocity records
outputs: blow count versus capacity; driving stresses; capacity estimate
benchmark_note: dynamic predictions can be scored against static load tests, but data sets are proprietary
state_of_art: GRLWEAP; CAPWAP; AllWave

name: Finite element soil-structure interaction
definition: Given an excavation, tunnel, foundation or retaining structure in soil with constitutive models and construction stages, compute deformations and structural forces.
inputs: staged geometry; soil constitutive parameters; structural elements
outputs: ground deformation; wall or lining forces; stage-by-stage safety
benchmark_note: German Geotechnical Society numerical benchmark exercises show wide scatter between users
state_of_art: PLAXIS; FLAC; RS2; ZSoil

name: Rock mechanics for underground openings
definition: Given an underground opening or mine layout, rock-mass properties and in-situ stresses, compute stresses, pillar loads and support requirements.
inputs: mine or tunnel layout; rock-mass properties; in-situ stress
outputs: stress and convergence fields; pillar safety factors; support design
benchmark_note: Kirsch circular-opening solution is closed form; field cases are site-specific
state_of_art: LaModel; FLAC3D; RS3; Map3D

name: Pavement structural response
definition: Given pavement layers, materials, traffic and climate, compute layer stresses and strains and predict distress over the design life.
inputs: layer thicknesses and moduli; traffic spectra; climate
outputs: critical strains; predicted cracking, rutting and roughness
benchmark_note: layered-elastic solutions are closed form; distress models are calibrated empirically
state_of_art: AASHTOWare Pavement ME; HIPERPAV

name: Computational fluid dynamics
definition: Given a flow domain, fluid properties and boundary conditions, solve the flow equations for velocity, pressure, turbulence, species and phase fields and derived forces.

name: Internal incompressible flow
definition: Given a duct, valve, manifold or vessel geometry and inlet and outlet conditions, compute the velocity and pressure fields and pressure losses.
inputs: fluid domain; fluid properties; inlet and outlet conditions; turbulence model
outputs: velocity and pressure fields; pressure drop; flow distribution
benchmark_note: ERCOFTAC classic collection cases (backward-facing step, pipe flows) have measured data
state_of_art: Ansys Fluent; Simcenter STAR-CCM+; Ansys CFX; Autodesk CFD

name: External aerodynamics
definition: Given a vehicle or body shape and freestream conditions, compute the surrounding flow and the lift, drag and moments.
inputs: surface geometry; freestream Mach, Reynolds and attitude
outputs: force and moment coefficients; surface pressure; wake
benchmark_note: AIAA Drag Prediction and High Lift Prediction Workshops publish test cases and comparisons
state_of_art: Ansys Fluent; Simcenter STAR-CCM+; NASA FUN3D; Cadence Fidelity

name: High-speed compressible flow
definition: Given a geometry and transonic, supersonic or hypersonic conditions, compute shock structures, heating and loads.
inputs: geometry; freestream state; gas model
outputs: shock positions; pressure and heat-flux distributions; loads
benchmark_note: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource verification and validation cases
state_of_art: Ansys Fluent; Simcenter STAR-CCM+; NASA LAURA; US3D

name: Turbomachinery flow
definition: Given blade-row geometry, rotational speed and inlet and outlet conditions, compute stage performance and flow fields.
inputs: blade geometry; rotor speed; inlet total conditions; back pressure
outputs: pressure ratio; efficiency map; blade loading
benchmark_note: NASA Rotor 37 and Rotor 67 have measured data and blind-test histories
state_of_art: Ansys CFX; Cadence Fine/Turbo; Simcenter STAR-CCM+

name: Multiphase and free-surface flow
definition: Given a domain with two or more phases, compute interface motion, phase fractions and resulting loads.
inputs: domain; phase properties; initial interface or inlet fractions
outputs: phase distribution over time; interface position; loads
benchmark_note: SPHERIC benchmark cases and the dam-break experiments have measured data
state_of_art: Ansys Fluent; Simcenter STAR-CCM+; Flow Science FLOW-3D

name: Reacting flow and combustion
