benchmark_note: the CEDAR handwritten address database collected for USPS is a standard recognition benchmark
state_of_art: Parascript AddressScript; Siemens Logistics; Solystic

name: Vehicle routing and scheduling
definition: Given stops with demands and time constraints, vehicles and a travel-time network, plan the routes and schedules that serve the stops at least cost.

name: Capacitated vehicle routing
definition: Given a depot, customer demands, vehicle capacity and travel costs, find routes that serve every customer once at minimum total cost.
inputs: depot, customer locations and demands, vehicle capacity, distance matrix
outputs: routes and total cost
benchmark_note: CVRPLIB, especially the Uchoa et al. X instances, and the Augerat A, B and P sets have best-known solutions
state_of_art: ORTEC Routing; Descartes Route Planner; Omnitracs Roadnet; PTV Route Optimiser

name: Vehicle routing with time windows
definition: Given customers with demands, service times and delivery windows, find capacity- and time-feasible routes minimizing vehicles and distance.
inputs: customers, demands, time windows, service times, fleet, travel times
outputs: routes with arrival times; vehicles used and distance
benchmark_note: Solomon's 56 instances and the Gehring and Homberger 200 to 1000 customer sets; the DIMACS 2021 challenge used them
state_of_art: ORTEC Routing; Descartes Route Planner; Routific

name: Pickup and delivery routing
definition: Given paired pickup and delivery requests with time windows, build routes that visit each pickup before its delivery within capacity.
inputs: paired requests, time windows, loads, fleet, travel times
outputs: routes and schedules
benchmark_note: Li and Lim pickup-and-delivery with time windows instances
state_of_art: ORTEC Routing; Descartes Route Planner

name: Dial-a-ride passenger routing
definition: Given door-to-door passenger trip requests with time windows and maximum ride times, route and schedule shared vehicles.
inputs: trip requests, time windows, ride-time limits, vehicle capacity and depots
outputs: vehicle routes, pickup and drop-off times, ride times
benchmark_note: Cordeau (2006) dial-a-ride instances
state_of_art: Trapeze PASS; Via; Spare

name: Capacitated arc routing
definition: Given a street network where streets rather than points need service, such as refuse collection, plowing or meter reading, find vehicle routes covering every required street.
inputs: street network, required edges with demands, vehicle capacity, depot
outputs: routes over the network and total deadhead and service cost
benchmark_note: the gdb, val and egl capacitated arc routing instance sets
state_of_art: RouteSmart; Routeware

name: Multi-depot and periodic routing
definition: Given customers needing service on some days of a planning horizon from several depots, choose visit days, depot assignment and routes.
inputs: customers with visit frequencies and allowable patterns, depots, fleet, travel costs
outputs: visit calendar, depot assignment, daily routes
benchmark_note: Cordeau, Gendreau and Laporte (1997) multi-depot and periodic routing instances
state_of_art: ORTEC Routing; Descartes Route Planner

name: Driver-preferred route sequencing
definition: Given a route's stops and examples of how drivers actually sequenced past routes, produce the stop sequence a driver would follow.
inputs: stops with zones and time windows, travel times, historical driven sequences
outputs: stop sequence
benchmark_note: the 2021 Amazon Last Mile Routing Research Challenge released routes and a scoring function
state_of_art: Amazon in-house routing; ORTEC Routing

name: Fleet dispatch and tracking
definition: Given live requests, vehicle positions and driver status, assign work to vehicles as it arrives and keep track of where vehicles are and whether drivers are within their rules.

name: Taxi and ride-hail dispatch
definition: Given ride requests arriving in real time and the positions and states of vehicles, assign requests to vehicles and reposition idle ones.
inputs: request stream, vehicle positions and states, travel-time network
outputs: assignments, pickup estimates, repositioning moves
benchmark_note: replay of public NYC taxi trip records is the common testbed, but simulators and scoring differ
state_of_art: Autocab; iCabbi; Via

name: Truckload load and driver assignment
definition: Given loads to cover and drivers and tractors with positions, hours and home domiciles, assign loads, swaps and relays to maximize coverage and profit.
inputs: load tenders, driver and tractor states, hours available, rates
outputs: load-driver assignments, relay and swap plans
benchmark_note: dynamic assignment models are well studied but there is no public instance set
state_of_art: McLeod LoadMaster; Trimble TMW.Suite; Optimal Dynamics

name: Dynamic vehicle routing
definition: Given routes in progress and new requests revealed over the day, decide which requests to accept and how to re-plan routes in real time.
inputs: current routes and positions, request stream, time windows, travel times
outputs: updated routes and dispatch decisions at each epoch
benchmark_note: the EURO Meets NeurIPS 2022 Vehicle Routing Competition dynamic track has instances and a simulator
state_of_art: ORTEC Routing; Descartes Route Planner

name: Open-pit haul truck dispatch
definition: Given shovels, dumps, haul trucks and their positions and states, assign each truck its next destination to meet production and blend targets.
inputs: shovel and dump locations and rates, truck positions and states, haul road network, targets
outputs: truck assignments, shovel utilization and production
benchmark_note: evaluated in discrete-event mine simulators without a shared benchmark
state_of_art: Komatsu Modular Mining DISPATCH; Hexagon MineOperate; Wenco

name: Vehicle tracking and map matching
definition: Given noisy positioning fixes from a vehicle, infer the road path driven, its timing and geofence entries and exits.
inputs: positioning fixes, road network, geofences
outputs: matched path, trip segments, stop and geofence events
benchmark_note: the Newson and Krumm (2009) Seattle map-matching dataset with ground truth
state_of_art: Samsara; Geotab; Motive; Trimble

name: Hours-of-service logging
definition: Given a driver's duty-status changes and vehicle movement, keep the log and compute compliance and remaining available driving time under hours-of-service rules.
inputs: duty-status events, engine and movement data, rule set
outputs: record of duty status, violations, available hours
benchmark_note: the rules are deterministic and FMCSA publishes electronic logging device test procedures
state_of_art: Samsara; Motive; Omnitracs

name: Driver behavior and fuel performance scoring
definition: Given vehicle data on speed, braking, idling and fuel use, score drivers and vehicles and flag unsafe or wasteful behavior.
inputs: vehicle bus and telematics data, trip context
outputs: per-driver and per-trip scores and events
benchmark_note: public driving datasets exist but no agreed scoring target
state_of_art: Samsara; Lytx; Geotab

name: Fuel purchase planning
definition: Given a planned truck route, fuel prices at stations along it and tank and network-discount rules, choose where and how much to buy.
inputs: route, station prices and discounts, tank size, current fuel, fuel-tax rates
outputs: fuel stops and quantities; total fuel cost
benchmark_note: exact dynamic-programming solutions exist for the single-route case, but no public instances
state_of_art: ProMiles; Trimble

name: Trade compliance and shipping documents
definition: Given goods, parties and routes, determine how the shipment is classified, controlled, taxed and declared, and produce the documents and messages that carry it.

name: Tariff classification
definition: Given a product description and attributes, assign its Harmonized System heading and national tariff line.
inputs: product description, materials, function, images
outputs: tariff code with justification
benchmark_note: published customs rulings (US CROSS rulings, EU binding tariff information) supply labeled examples
state_of_art: Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Global Trade; E2open Global Trade Management; Descartes CustomsInfo

name: Restricted party screening
definition: Given the parties to a transaction, match them against sanctions and denied-party lists and report likely hits.
inputs: party names and addresses, screening lists
outputs: candidate matches with scores
benchmark_note: lists are public, but labeled match sets for scoring are not
state_of_art: Descartes Visual Compliance; SAP Global Trade Services; Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Global Trade

name: Customs declaration filing
definition: Given commercial invoice and shipment data, build and submit import or export declarations and handle the authority's responses.
inputs: invoice, packing list, classification, parties, transport data
outputs: declaration messages, filing status, release
benchmark_note: correctness is validation against each authority's schema, not a ranking
state_of_art: CargoWise; Descartes; SAP Global Trade Services

name: Duty, landed cost and origin determination
definition: Given a classified product, its bill of materials and the trade lane, determine preferential origin eligibility and compute duties, taxes and landed cost.
inputs: tariff code, value, bill of materials with origins, trade agreement rules
outputs: origin determination, duty and tax amounts, landed cost
benchmark_note: deterministic given tariff schedules and agreement texts; worked cases could be assembled
state_of_art: Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Global Trade; E2open Global Trade Management; Avalara Cross-Border

name: Dangerous goods classification and documentation
definition: Given a substance or article and the mode of transport, determine its dangerous goods class, packing, marking, segregation and paperwork.
inputs: substance data, quantity, packaging, mode
outputs: UN number, class, packing group, label and placard requirements, shipping declaration
benchmark_note: answers are determined by the regulations, so test cases can be built, but none are shared
state_of_art: Labelmaster DGIS; Hazmat T&T

name: Shipping document and message generation
definition: Given shipment data, produce bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists and the equivalent electronic messages.
inputs: shipment, parties, goods, terms
outputs: documents and electronic messages
benchmark_note: document assembly is deterministic
state_of_art: CargoWise; Descartes

name: Flight planning and airline operations
definition: Given an aircraft, crew, payload, schedule and the weather and airspace, plan each flight and assign aircraft and crews to the schedule.

name: Flight route and fuel planning
definition: Given origin, destination, aircraft performance, winds and airspace constraints, choose the route, altitudes and speeds and compute trip and reserve fuel.
inputs: aircraft performance data, payload, weather forecast, airways and restrictions
outputs: operational flight plan with route, profile, times and fuel
benchmark_note: fuel and time can be scored against recorded wind fields, but there is no standard instance set
state_of_art: Lufthansa Systems Lido Flight 4D; Jeppesen JetPlanner; ForeFlight; Garmin Pilot

name: Weight and balance
definition: Given an aircraft's empty weight and arm, and the loading of passengers, cargo and fuel, compute gross weight and center of gravity and check them against the envelope.
inputs: basic empty weight and moment, load by station, fuel
outputs: weights, center of gravity, trim setting, load sheet
benchmark_note: deterministic; handbook worked examples give reference answers
state_of_art: Amadeus Altea Departure Control Flight Management; SITA; ForeFlight

name: Takeoff and landing performance
definition: Given runway, weather, aircraft weight and configuration, compute takeoff and landing limits and speeds.
inputs: runway data and obstacles, wind, temperature, pressure, weight, configuration
outputs: maximum weights, V-speeds, flap and thrust settings, required distances
benchmark_note: answers are fixed by aircraft flight manual data, which is proprietary
state_of_art: Boeing Onboard Performance Tool; Airbus FlySmart; Aircraft Performance Group

name: Preflight briefing and notice filtering
definition: Given a route and time, gather notices to air missions, weather and aerodrome data and filter them to what matters for the flight.
inputs: route, times, notices, weather reports and forecasts, aerodrome data
outputs: briefing package with relevant notices ranked
benchmark_note: notice relevance could be labeled from public notice archives; no shared set yet
state_of_art: ForeFlight; Lufthansa Systems Lido mPilot

name: Flight time and duty logging
definition: Given flights flown and duty periods, keep the pilot or crew logbook and check currency and flight-duty limits.
inputs: flight records, duty start and end times, rule set
outputs: logbook totals, currency status, limit violations
benchmark_note: record keeping with deterministic rule checks
state_of_art: ForeFlight Logbook; LogTen

name: Airline crew pairing
definition: Given a flight schedule and labor rules, build multi-day crew trips from a base that cover every flight at least cost.
inputs: flight legs, bases, duty and rest rules, costs
outputs: pairings covering all legs; cost
benchmark_note: OR-Library set partitioning instances derived from airline crew scheduling
state_of_art: Jeppesen Crew Pairing; Sabre Crew Manager; Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Crew

name: Airline crew rostering
definition: Given pairings, crew members, their qualifications, requests and rules, assign pairings to individuals over a month.
inputs: pairings, crew qualifications and requests, rules
outputs: individual rosters; coverage and fairness
benchmark_note: formulations are standard but industrial instances are not public
state_of_art: Jeppesen Crew Rostering; Sabre Crew Manager; IBS iFlight Crew

name: Airline disruption recovery
definition: Given a disrupted day of operations, decide flight cancellations, delays and aircraft and passenger reassignments to restore the schedule at least cost.
inputs: schedule, aircraft rotations, passenger itineraries, disruption events
outputs: revised schedule, rotations and passenger reaccommodation
benchmark_note: the ROADEF/EURO Challenge 2009 instances on airline disruption management
state_of_art: Lufthansa Systems NetLine/Ops ++; Sabre Recovery Manager; Jeppesen Ops Control

name: Air traffic and airport operations
definition: Given surveillance data, flight plans and airspace and runway capacity, keep aircraft separated and flowing efficiently through airspace and airports.

name: Arrival sequencing and metering
definition: Given inbound aircraft with estimated times and runway capacity, assign landing sequence and times and the delays each aircraft must absorb.
inputs: inbound trajectories and estimates, runway configuration, separation minima
outputs: landing sequence, scheduled times at meter fixes and runway, delay advisories
benchmark_note: OR-Library aircraft landing problem instances (Beasley et al.)
state_of_art: FAA Time Based Flow Management; Thales TopSky-AMAN; Barco OSYRIS

name: Departure sequencing and management
definition: Given departing aircraft, taxi times, runway and airspace constraints, sequence takeoffs and assign departure times and paths.
inputs: departure demand, gate and taxi times, runway configuration, departure restrictions
outputs: takeoff sequence and times, departure routes
benchmark_note: scored in simulation on recorded surface data, without a shared instance set
state_of_art: FAA Terminal Flight Data Manager; Saab Departure Manager

name: Conflict detection and resolution
definition: Given current and intended trajectories of aircraft in a sector, predict losses of separation and propose resolving clearances.
inputs: surveillance tracks, flight plans and clearances, separation minima
outputs: predicted conflicts, resolution advisories, route amendments
benchmark_note: BlueSky scenario sets allow comparison but no agreed benchmark
state_of_art: FAA En Route Automation Modernization; Thales TopSky-ATC; Indra iTEC

name: Surveillance data processing
definition: Given radar and broadcast position reports, decode them, associate reports to aircraft and maintain smoothed tracks.
inputs: radar plots, ADS-B and Mode S messages, flight plans
outputs: aircraft tracks with identity, position, altitude and velocity
benchmark_note: OpenSky Network archives provide raw messages, but ground truth tracks are not curated
state_of_art: FAA STARS; Thales TopSky-ATC; Indra

name: Aircraft trajectory prediction
definition: Given a flight plan, aircraft performance and weather, predict the four-dimensional trajectory and arrival time.
inputs: flight plan, aircraft type and weight, winds and temperature, procedures
outputs: predicted positions, altitudes and times; arrival time
benchmark_note: arrival time and trajectory error can be scored on OpenSky recorded flights
state_of_art: EUROCONTROL BADA-based trajectory predictors; FAA TFMS

name: Air traffic flow management
definition: Given forecast demand and reduced airport or sector capacity, assign ground delays, reroutes and slots to balance demand and capacity.
inputs: scheduled flights, capacity forecasts, constraints
outputs: ground delay programs, slots, reroutes
benchmark_note: ground holding models have published test cases, but no current shared set
state_of_art: FAA Traffic Flow Management System; EUROCONTROL Network Manager

name: Airfield operations monitoring
definition: Given airfield inspections, aircraft noise and track data and ground vehicle access, record airport operating conditions and flag exceptions.
inputs: inspection records, noise monitor and flight track data, vehicle identification reads
outputs: airfield condition reports, noise events attributed to flights, access logs
benchmark_note: operational record keeping
state_of_art: Envirosuite ANOMS; Veoci

name: Maritime navigation and port operations
definition: Given charts, weather, traffic and cargo, plan and keep a ship's passage safe and economical, and plan how ships and containers are handled in port.

name: Passage planning and route monitoring
definition: Given electronic charts, the ship's draft and the voyage, lay out a route of waypoints clear of hazards and monitor the ship's track against it.
inputs: electronic navigational charts, ship particulars, waypoints, position fixes
outputs: checked route, cross-track and hazard alarms, steering orders
benchmark_note: route safety can be checked against public charts, but no scored route set exists
state_of_art: Kongsberg K-Bridge ECDIS; Wärtsilä Navi-Sailor; Furuno ECDIS

name: Ship weather routing
definition: Given departure, destination, the ship's speed and fuel response to waves and wind, and a forecast, find the route and speed profile minimizing time, fuel or risk.
inputs: forecast wind, waves and currents, ship performance model, constraints
outputs: route and speed schedule, predicted fuel and arrival time
benchmark_note: open forecast archives allow comparison, but there is no reference instance set
state_of_art: StormGeo s-Planner; DTN Ship Routing; Wärtsilä Fleet Optimisation Solution

name: Target tracking and collision avoidance
definition: Given radar, AIS and camera observations of nearby vessels and obstacles, track them, compute closest approach and propose rule-compliant maneuvers.
inputs: radar targets, AIS reports, camera images, own-ship state
outputs: tracked targets, closest point of approach and time, collision alarms and maneuver advice
benchmark_note: public AIS archives and maritime obstacle datasets (Singapore Maritime Dataset, MODS) score detection but not maneuver decisions
state_of_art: Orca AI; SEA.AI; Furuno ARPA radar

name: Voyage logbooks and reporting
definition: Given bridge and engine events, keep the official deck and engine logs and produce required voyage, emission and weather reports.
inputs: navigation events, engine data, observations
outputs: logbook entries and voyage reports
benchmark_note: record keeping
state_of_art: Kongsberg K-Log; Marlink

name: Ship routing and cargo scheduling
definition: Given cargoes with pickup and delivery ports and windows and a fleet of ships, decide which ship carries which cargo and in what port sequence.
inputs: cargoes, ports, time windows, fleet, sailing times and costs
outputs: ship schedules and cargo assignments; profit
benchmark_note: Hemmati et al. (2014) benchmark suite for industrial and tramp ship routing and scheduling
state_of_art: Veson IMOS; Dataloy

name: Berth and quay crane allocation
definition: Given arriving ships with handling volumes and windows, and a quay with cranes, assign berthing positions, times and cranes.
inputs: ship arrivals, lengths, workloads, quay layout, cranes
outputs: berth plan, crane assignments and schedules
benchmark_note: Cordeau et al. (2005) berth allocation instances and the Meisel and Bierwirth quay crane scheduling set
state_of_art: Navis N4; Tideworks; INFORM

name: Container stowage planning
definition: Given the containers to load at each port of a rotation and the ship's bay structure, assign slots that respect stability, strength, reefer and dangerous-goods rules and minimize restows.
inputs: container list with weights and destinations, vessel profile, rotation
outputs: bay plan and stowage message; stability and restow count
benchmark_note: published instances exist from academic work but no widely adopted set
state_of_art: Navis MACS3; Navis StowMan

name: Rail operations
definition: Given the track network, trains, cars and crews, plan and control train movements, enforce safe operation and manage yards and car supply.

name: Train dispatching and meet-pass planning
definition: Given trains on a network with positions, priorities and sidings, decide meets, passes and movement authorities to minimize delay.
inputs: track layout, train positions and schedules, priorities, maintenance windows
outputs: movement plan with meets and passes; authorities issued
benchmark_note: INFORMS Railway Applications Section competition instances exist for train dispatching
state_of_art: Wabtec Movement Planner; Hitachi Rail TMS

name: Train control enforcement
definition: Given a train's consist, position and speed and the track's limits and authorities, predict its braking curve and enforce stops and speed limits.
inputs: consist and braking data, track profile, speed restrictions, authorities, position
outputs: braking predictions, warnings, enforcement commands
benchmark_note: braking curve models (ETCS braking curves) are specified and can be tested, but not ranked
state_of_art: Wabtec I-ETMS; Siemens Trainguard; Alstom Atlas ETCS

name: Train running time calculation
definition: Given a train's consist and the line's gradients, curves and speed limits, compute the speed profile, running time and energy.
inputs: locomotive and car data, track profile, speed limits, stops
outputs: speed-distance profile, running time, energy use
benchmark_note: physics is well defined and results can be checked against measured runs, without a shared set
state_of_art: OpenTrack; RailSys; SNCF OSRD

name: Rail yard inventory and switching
definition: Given cars arriving, departing trains and equipment reads, track each car's location and build the switching and classification plan.
inputs: car inventory, equipment identification reads, train consists, yard tracks
outputs: car locations by track, switch lists, classification sequence
benchmark_note: hump yard sorting has published models and instances, but no shared benchmark
state_of_art: Wabtec Yard Planner; RailComm DOC

name: Freight car ordering and distribution
definition: Given customer car orders and empty car supply, allocate and route empty cars to loading points.
inputs: car orders, empty car locations, car types, transit times
outputs: car assignments and empty movements
benchmark_note: formulated as a transportation problem; no public instances
state_of_art: Railinc; Wabtec

name: Train crew assignment
definition: Given trains to operate, crew pools, rest rules and crew positions, assign crews to trains and plan deadheads.
inputs: train schedule, crew pools and positions, labor rules
outputs: crew assignments and deadheads; cost
benchmark_note: set-covering formulations as in airline crew scheduling, without public rail instances
state_of_art: DELMIA Quintiq; IVU.rail

name: Public transit planning and information
definition: Given a city's travel demand, streets and operating resources, design transit routes and timetables, schedule vehicles and crews, and tell riders how and when to travel.

name: Transit route network design
definition: Given a street network and an origin-destination demand matrix, choose a set of transit routes and frequencies that balances rider travel time and operating cost.
inputs: street network, demand matrix, fleet size, route constraints
outputs: route set and frequencies; rider and operator costs
benchmark_note: Mandl's Swiss network and Mumford's instance set for transit route network design
state_of_art: PTV Visum; Remix; Optibus

name: Periodic timetabling
definition: Given lines, frequencies and transfer and headway requirements, set departure times that minimize passenger travel and waiting time.
inputs: lines, frequencies, running and dwell times, transfers, headway constraints
outputs: periodic timetable
benchmark_note: PESPlib periodic event scheduling instances with best-known values
state_of_art: HASTUS; Trapeze; IVU.suite; Optibus

name: Transit vehicle scheduling
definition: Given timetabled trips and depots, chain trips into vehicle blocks that cover every trip with the fewest vehicles and least deadheading.
inputs: trips with times and terminals, depots, deadhead times, vehicle types
outputs: vehicle blocks; fleet size and deadhead cost
benchmark_note: multiple-depot vehicle scheduling instance generators are published, but no fixed standard set
state_of_art: HASTUS; Optibus; Trapeze

name: Transit crew scheduling
definition: Given vehicle blocks and labor rules, cut blocks into driver runs and assign runs to operators.
inputs: vehicle blocks, relief points, labor rules
outputs: runs and rosters; paid hours
benchmark_note: set-covering formulations; few public instances
state_of_art: HASTUS; Optibus; Trapeze

name: Transit journey planning
definition: Given a timetable, real-time updates and a traveler's origin, destination and time, find the fastest or Pareto-optimal itineraries including walking and transfers.
inputs: timetable feed, real-time updates, street network, query
outputs: itineraries with legs, times and transfers
benchmark_note: public timetable feeds (London, Switzerland, Germany) with random query sets are the standard benchmark for RAPTOR-family algorithms
state_of_art: Google Maps; HAFAS; Transit app; Moovit

name: Real-time arrival prediction
definition: Given vehicle positions and the schedule, predict when each vehicle will reach each downstream stop.
inputs: vehicle positions, schedule, historical running times
outputs: predicted arrival times by stop
benchmark_note: open vehicle-position archives allow scoring, but no shared split
state_of_art: Swiftly; Clever Devices; Trapeze

name: Travel reservation and distribution
definition: Given carriers' schedules, fares and seat inventory, find, price, book and ticket travel, and set how much inventory to sell at each fare.

name: Availability and fare shopping
definition: Given an origin, destination and dates, search schedules, seat availability and fares to return priced itineraries.
inputs: schedules, availability, fares and rules, query
outputs: priced itinerary options
benchmark_note: fare construction is deterministic given filed fares and rules, which are licensed
state_of_art: Amadeus; Sabre; Travelport; Google ITA Matrix

name: Reservation and ticketing
definition: Given a chosen itinerary and passengers, hold seats in carrier inventory, create the passenger record and issue tickets and documents.
inputs: itinerary, passenger data, payment, inventory
outputs: passenger name record, tickets, seat assignments
benchmark_note: transactional
state_of_art: Amadeus Altea; Sabre SabreSonic; Navitaire

name: Seat inventory revenue management
definition: Given demand forecasts by fare class and itinerary, set booking limits or bid prices that maximize expected revenue.
inputs: demand forecasts by fare and itinerary, capacity, fares
outputs: booking limits or bid prices; expected revenue
benchmark_note: textbook network revenue management instances exist (for example Topaloglu's), but no industry standard set
state_of_art: PROS Revenue Management; Sabre AirVision Revenue Optimizer; Amadeus Altea Revenue Management

name: Road navigation and traffic engineering
definition: Given a road network, traffic and travel demand, find routes for drivers, and analyse, time and forecast traffic on the network.

name: Road shortest path routing
definition: Given a road graph with travel times and an origin and destination, compute the fastest route, possibly at continental scale and with live travel times.
inputs: road graph, edge travel times, origin, destination, departure time
outputs: route geometry, travel time and distance
benchmark_note: the 9th DIMACS Implementation Challenge road networks are the standard shortest-path benchmark
state_of_art: Google Maps; HERE Routing; TomTom Routing

name: Truck routing and mileage
definition: Given vehicle dimensions, weight and hazardous load, and a road network with legal restrictions, find a legal route and compute billing mileage by jurisdiction.
inputs: vehicle profile, origin, stops, restriction data
outputs: legal route, distance by state or country, tolls
benchmark_note: legality is checkable against restriction data, which is mostly proprietary
state_of_art: Trimble PC*MILER; Trimble CoPilot; HERE Truck Routing

name: Traffic signal timing optimization
definition: Given intersection geometry, turning volumes and phasing, compute cycle lengths, splits and offsets that minimize delay along a corridor or network.
inputs: intersection lanes, turning movement counts, phasing, pedestrian needs
outputs: signal timing plans; delay, stops and progression measures
benchmark_note: scored by delay in simulation; open scenario sets exist for reinforcement-learning signal control but none is standard
state_of_art: Synchro; TRANSYT; PTV Vistro

name: Highway and intersection capacity analysis
definition: Given a road facility's geometry, control and traffic volumes, compute capacity, delay and level of service by the Highway Capacity Manual or equivalent methods.
inputs: facility geometry, control, volumes, heavy vehicles, peak factors
outputs: capacity, delay, queue and level of service
benchmark_note: the Highway Capacity Manual's example problems have published reference answers
state_of_art: McTrans HCS; SIDRA Intersection; Synchro

name: Traffic microsimulation
definition: Given a road network, control and demand, simulate individual vehicles' movements to estimate travel times, queues and emissions.
inputs: network, signal control, origin-destination demand, driver behavior parameters
outputs: vehicle trajectories, travel times, queues, performance measures
benchmark_note: calibration against the public NGSIM vehicle trajectory datasets is common, but there is no ranked benchmark
state_of_art: PTV Vissim; Aimsun Next; Paramics

name: Road safety analysis
definition: Given crash records and road and traffic data, locate high-crash sites, diagnose patterns and predict crash frequency for alternatives.
inputs: crash records, road inventory, traffic volumes
outputs: hot-spot rankings, collision diagrams, predicted crash frequencies
benchmark_note: Highway Safety Manual predictive models give reference values for worked examples
state_of_art: AASHTOWare Safety; FHWA Interactive Highway Safety Design Model

name: Travel demand forecasting and assignment
definition: Given zones, land use, networks and behavior models, forecast trips by origin, destination and mode and assign them to the network to equilibrium.
inputs: zone data, highway and transit networks, behavior model parameters
outputs: trip tables, mode shares, link volumes and travel times
benchmark_note: the Transportation Networks for Research repository (Sioux Falls, Chicago and others) has best-known equilibrium assignments
state_of_art: PTV Visum; TransCAD; Bentley Cube; Bentley Emme

name: Run the organization
definition: The internal administration of any organization: finance and accounting, people, purchasing, projects, documents, reporting, and everyday office work.

name: General accounting and financial close
definition: Given an organization's business transactions and chart of accounts, keep the double-entry ledger, reconcile it, close periods and produce financial statements.

name: Double-entry ledger bookkeeping
definition: Given business transactions and a chart of accounts, post balanced journal entries and maintain account balances and a trial balance.
inputs: chart of accounts, source transactions, journal entries, fiscal calendar
outputs: posted ledger, account balances, trial balance, audit trail
benchmark_note: given a transaction set and chart of accounts the correct balances and trial balance are deterministic
state_of_art: Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials; SAP S/4HANA Finance; NetSuite; QuickBooks Online; Xero; Sage Intacct
open_tools: GnuCash; ERPNext; Odoo Community; Ledger; hledger; Beancount; LedgerSMB; Akaunting

name: Account and bank reconciliation
definition: Given ledger entries and an external statement, match items, identify differences and propose adjusting entries.
inputs: ledger detail, bank or subledger statements, matching rules
outputs: matched and unmatched items, reconciling differences, adjusting entries
benchmark_note: synthetic ledger and statement pairs with known matches give precision and recall of matching
state_of_art: BlackLine; Trintech Cadency; Oracle Account Reconciliation; FloQast

name: Period close and consolidation
definition: Given ledgers of several legal entities, translate currencies, eliminate intercompany balances and produce consolidated balances for the period.
inputs: entity trial balances, ownership structure, exchange rates, intercompany transactions
outputs: consolidated trial balance, eliminations, minority interest, close task status
benchmark_note: consolidation rules (IFRS 10, ASC 810) applied to a synthetic group give a unique consolidated result
state_of_art: Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close; OneStream; SAP Group Reporting; Workiva

name: Financial statement preparation
definition: Given a closed trial balance and a reporting framework, produce the balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and notes.
inputs: closed trial balance, account mapping to statement lines, reporting framework
outputs: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, notes
benchmark_note: statements are deterministic from a mapped trial balance; the indirect cash-flow method is a good hard case
state_of_art: Workiva; Oracle Hyperion Financial Reporting; CaseWare Working Papers

name: Structured financial report tagging
definition: Given financial statements, tag each fact with elements of a published reporting taxonomy and produce a valid machine-readable filing.
inputs: financial statements and notes, reporting taxonomy (US GAAP, IFRS)
outputs: inline XBRL instance document, validation results
benchmark_note: SEC filings with their XBRL tags form a large labeled corpus; XBRL conformance suites exist for validation
state_of_art: Workiva Wdesk; Toppan Merrill Bridge; CoreFiling Seahorse

name: Fixed asset depreciation
definition: Given a fixed-asset register and depreciation conventions, compute periodic book depreciation, disposals and net book values.
inputs: asset register, acquisition cost, useful life, method and convention, disposals
outputs: depreciation schedule, journal entries, net book value roll-forward
benchmark_note: straight-line, declining-balance and conventions give exact expected schedules
state_of_art: Sage Fixed Assets; Oracle Fusion Assets; SAP Asset Accounting

name: Lease accounting
definition: Given lease contracts, compute right-of-use assets, lease liabilities and their amortization under the lease standard.
inputs: lease terms, payments, discount rate, options, modifications
outputs: right-of-use asset and liability schedules, journal entries, disclosures
benchmark_note: ASC 842 and IFRS 16 calculations are deterministic for given terms
state_of_art: Visual Lease; LeaseQuery; CoStar Real Estate Manager

name: Billing, receivables and payables
definition: Given sales, time, contracts and supplier invoices, issue bills, collect what customers owe and pay what suppliers are owed.

name: Invoice generation
definition: Given delivered goods or services, prices and tax rules, produce customer invoices and post them to receivables.
inputs: orders or delivery records, price lists, customer terms, tax rates
outputs: invoices, receivable postings
benchmark_note: given orders, prices and tax tables, invoice totals are deterministic; e-invoice formats (UBL, EN 16931) have validators
state_of_art: NetSuite; SAP S/4HANA Billing; QuickBooks Online; Xero; FreshBooks
open_tools: Invoice Ninja; Crater; Akaunting; ERPNext; Dolibarr

name: Time and expense billing
definition: Given recorded hours, rates and reimbursable expenses for professional work, produce client bills under the engagement's billing arrangement.
inputs: timesheets, rate tables, expenses, retainers, billing arrangements
outputs: pre-bills, client invoices, work-in-progress and realization reports
benchmark_note: billing rules over time entries give deterministic invoice amounts
state_of_art: BQE Core; Clio Manage; Deltek Vantagepoint; Elite 3E; Aderant Expert; Wolters Kluwer TyMetrix 360

name: Subscription and usage billing
definition: Given subscription plans and metered usage, rate usage, prorate plan changes and issue periodic invoices.
inputs: plans and price tiers, subscription events, usage records
outputs: rated charges, prorations, periodic invoices, revenue schedules
benchmark_note: rating and proration over a usage log are deterministic
state_of_art: Zuora; Stripe Billing; Chargebee; Oracle Revenue Management

name: Receivables and collections
definition: Given open invoices and customer payments, apply cash, age balances and prioritize collection actions.
inputs: open invoices, remittances and bank receipts, customer credit data
outputs: cash applications, aging report, dunning actions, collection worklist
benchmark_note: cash application matching is testable on synthetic remittances; collection prioritization needs payment-outcome data
state_of_art: HighRadius; Billtrust; SAP S/4HANA Collections Management; Esker

name: Supplier invoice matching and payment
definition: Given supplier invoices, purchase orders and receipts, match them, resolve exceptions and schedule payments.
inputs: supplier invoices, purchase orders, goods receipts, payment terms
outputs: matched invoices, exceptions, payment runs, payables postings
benchmark_note: three-way match outcomes are deterministic for given documents and tolerances
state_of_art: SAP S/4HANA; Coupa Pay; Tipalti; Bill.com; Basware

name: Employee expense reporting
definition: Given receipts and card transactions, build expense reports, check them against travel policy and reimburse employees.
inputs: receipts, card feeds, mileage, travel policy, approval chain
outputs: expense reports, policy exceptions, reimbursements, ledger postings
benchmark_note: policy checks are deterministic; receipt extraction has public datasets (SROIE, CORD)
state_of_art: SAP Concur; Emburse Chrome River; Expensify; Navan; Ramp

name: Budgeting, forecasting and cost accounting
definition: Given historical financials, operating drivers and cost data, produce budgets, forecasts and the cost of products, jobs and activities.

name: Operating budget preparation
definition: Given prior actuals, organizational structure and planning assumptions, collect and consolidate departmental budgets into an approved plan.
inputs: prior-year actuals, cost centers, headcount plans, assumptions, targets
outputs: budget by account, period and unit; versions; approval status
benchmark_note: consolidation of submitted budgets is deterministic; plan quality has no ground truth
state_of_art: Oracle EPM Planning; Anaplan; Workday Adaptive Planning; Planful; Pigment

name: Driver-based financial forecasting
definition: Given actuals to date and business drivers, project revenue, cost and balance-sheet lines for remaining and future periods.
inputs: actuals, driver series (volumes, prices, headcount), driver-to-account logic
outputs: rolling forecast by account and period, scenario comparisons
benchmark_note: forecast accuracy can be scored against held-out actuals of public companies
state_of_art: Anaplan; Oracle EPM Planning; Pigment; Board

name: Activity-based cost allocation
definition: Given general-ledger costs, activities and driver quantities, allocate overhead to activities, products, customers or services.
inputs: cost pools, activity definitions, driver volumes, allocation rules
outputs: unit costs, cost by product or customer, profitability
benchmark_note: allocation results are deterministic given rules and drivers
state_of_art: SAP Profitability and Performance Management; Oracle Profitability and Cost Management; CostPerform

name: Job and project costing
definition: Given labor, material, equipment and overhead charges coded to jobs, accumulate cost by job and phase and compare it with estimate.
inputs: cost transactions coded to job and phase, estimates, overhead rates
outputs: job cost reports, committed and actual cost, cost to complete, margin
benchmark_note: cost accumulation and overhead absorption are deterministic
state_of_art: Deltek Costpoint; Sage 300 CRE; Viewpoint Vista; Procore Financials

name: Cash flow forecasting
definition: Given bank balances, receivable and payable schedules and planned flows, project daily to monthly cash positions and funding needs.
inputs: bank balances, open receivables and payables, payroll and debt schedules
outputs: projected cash position by account and period, funding gaps
benchmark_note: deterministic roll-forward is testable; forecast accuracy needs held-out bank data
state_of_art: Kyriba; GTreasury; SAP Cash Management; Trovata

name: Tax preparation and compliance
definition: Given financial records and the applicable tax law, compute tax liabilities and produce the returns, filings and plans that law requires.

name: Individual income tax return
definition: Given a person's income, deduction and credit documents, compute federal and state income tax and produce an electronically fileable return.
inputs: wage and information statements, deductions, credits, filing status, prior-year data
outputs: completed return forms, tax due or refund, e-file transmission
benchmark_note: tax law is deterministic for complete facts; IRS e-file assurance test scenarios and NBER TAXSIM give reference results
state_of_art: Intuit TurboTax; Intuit Lacerte; Drake Tax; Thomson Reuters UltraTax CS; CCH Axcess Tax
open_tools: OpenTaxSolver; IRS Direct File; PolicyEngine US; Tax-Calculator (PSLmodels)

name: Business and fiduciary income tax return
definition: Given an entity's books, book-to-tax adjustments and depreciation, compute taxable income and produce corporate, partnership or trust returns.
inputs: trial balance, entity type, book-to-tax adjustments, asset register, ownership
outputs: business return forms, schedules for owners, tax depreciation
benchmark_note: deterministic given the facts; synthetic entities with hand-checked returns would form a test set
state_of_art: CCH Axcess Tax; Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE; Thomson Reuters GoSystem Tax RS

name: Wage and information returns
definition: Given payments to employees and payees, produce year-end wage and information statements and transmit them to the tax authority.
inputs: payee records, payment totals by type, withholding
outputs: information return forms, recipient copies, electronic transmission files
benchmark_note: file layouts are specified by the tax authority and can be validated
state_of_art: Track1099; Tax1099; Sovos 1099

name: Sales and use tax determination
definition: Given a transaction's parties, locations and items, determine taxing jurisdictions, rates and taxability and compute the tax.
inputs: ship-from and ship-to addresses, item tax codes, exemption certificates, date
outputs: jurisdictions, rates, tax amount, return data by jurisdiction
benchmark_note: published rate tables and taxability rules give reference answers for sample transactions
state_of_art: Avalara AvaTax; Vertex O Series; Sovos; Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Indirect Tax

name: Income tax provision
definition: Given pre-tax book income and temporary and permanent differences, compute current and deferred tax expense and the effective rate reconciliation.
inputs: book income by jurisdiction, book-to-tax differences, rates, valuation allowances
outputs: current and deferred tax, deferred tax assets and liabilities, rate reconciliation
benchmark_note: ASC 740 computations are deterministic for given inputs
state_of_art: Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Tax Provision; CorpTax Provision; Oracle Tax Reporting Cloud

name: Estate and gift tax returns
definition: Given a decedent's or donor's assets, transfers and deductions, compute transfer tax and produce estate or gift tax returns.
inputs: asset inventory and valuations, lifetime gifts, deductions, beneficiaries
outputs: estate or gift tax return, tax due, exemption used
benchmark_note: deterministic computation given facts
state_of_art: Thomson Reuters UltraTax CS (706/709); CCH ProSystem fx Estate and Gift

name: Tax planning projections
definition: Given current and projected income and alternative actions, project multi-year tax outcomes and compare scenarios.
inputs: projected income and deductions, candidate actions, future-law assumptions
outputs: scenario tax projections, recommended actions
benchmark_note: each scenario's tax is checkable; the recommendation is judgment
state_of_art: Holistiplan; CCH ProSystem fx Planning; BNA Income Tax Planner

name: Payroll, time and attendance
definition: Given employees, schedules, work time and pay rules, record time worked, compute pay and withholdings, and file payroll taxes.

name: Time and attendance capture
definition: Given clock punches and schedules, apply pay rules for rounding, overtime and premiums and produce approved hours by pay code.
inputs: clock punches, schedules, pay rules, holidays, approvals
outputs: approved hours by employee, pay code and period; exceptions
benchmark_note: pay-rule application (overtime under FLSA and state rules) is deterministic over punch data
state_of_art: UKG Pro Workforce Management; ADP Workforce Now; Workday Time Tracking; Dayforce

name: Project and activity timesheets
definition: Given work done against projects and tasks, record hours per activity and route them for approval and costing.
inputs: projects and task codes, worker entries, approval chain
outputs: approved timesheets by project and task, utilization reports
benchmark_note: recording is clerical; there is no computed output to score beyond rollups
state_of_art: Replicon; Harvest; Toggl Track; Clockify; Deltek Time and Expense

name: Gross-to-net payroll calculation
definition: Given approved hours, pay rates, deductions and tax elections, compute gross pay, statutory withholdings, deductions and net pay.
inputs: hours by pay code, rates, salaries, benefit deductions, garnishments, withholding elections
outputs: pay statements, net pay, direct-deposit files, payroll journal
benchmark_note: withholding tables (IRS Publication 15-T) and state rules give exact expected results for test employees
state_of_art: ADP Workforce Now; Workday Payroll; UKG Pro; Paychex Flex; Gusto; Rippling

name: Payroll tax deposits and filings
definition: Given payroll results by jurisdiction, compute employer tax liabilities, schedule deposits and produce quarterly and annual payroll tax returns.
inputs: payroll registers, employer tax rates, jurisdiction registrations
outputs: deposit schedule, quarterly and annual payroll returns, wage statements
benchmark_note: liabilities and form values are deterministic from payroll registers
state_of_art: ADP SmartCompliance; Paychex Flex; Gusto; Symmetry Tax Engine

name: Leave and absence accrual
definition: Given leave policies, service dates and absences, compute accrued, used and remaining leave and check statutory leave eligibility.
inputs: leave plans, hire and service dates, hours worked, absence requests
outputs: leave balances, eligibility decisions, absence records
benchmark_note: accrual and eligibility rules are deterministic
state_of_art: UKG Pro; Workday Absence Management; Reliance Matrix

name: Employee shift scheduling
definition: Given forecast staffing demand, employee skills, availability and labor rules, assign employees to shifts that cover demand at least cost.
inputs: demand by interval, employee skills and availability, contract and labor-law rules
outputs: shift roster, coverage gaps, labor cost
benchmark_note: the International Nurse Rostering Competition and Shift Scheduling Benchmark instances have known best solutions
state_of_art: UKG Dimensions Advanced Scheduling; Quinyx; Legion; Deputy; When I Work

name: Recruiting and selection
definition: Given open positions, attract applicants, track them through selection, check their eligibility and background, and check the process for adverse impact.

name: Job posting distribution
definition: Given a job requisition, generate a posting and publish it to job boards and career sites, tracking the source of each applicant.
inputs: approved requisition, job description, target boards
outputs: published postings, posting costs, applicant source tracking
benchmark_note: job-description generation can be rated; distribution itself is plumbing
state_of_art: LinkedIn Recruiter; Indeed; Broadbean; Appcast

name: Applicant tracking
definition: Given applications for open requisitions, move candidates through screening, interview and offer stages and keep the required records.
inputs: requisitions, applications, interview feedback, offer data
outputs: candidate pipeline, interview schedules, offers, applicant flow log
benchmark_note: workflow tracking; the scoreable parts are parsing and matching
state_of_art: Workday Recruiting; Greenhouse; Lever; iCIMS; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting

name: Resume parsing and candidate matching
