state_of_art: OpenText RightFax; eFax Corporate; Concord

name: Serve customers and sell
definition: The customer-facing side of commerce and services: selling, marketing, customer service, retail and restaurant operations, hospitality, and property.

name: Customer relationship management
definition: Given contacts, accounts and interactions, maintain a unified customer record and move prospects through a sales process to closed revenue.

name: Contact and account records
definition: Given contact details and logged interactions, keep one current record per person and organization with relationships and activity history.
inputs: contacts, organizations, emails, calls, meetings, notes
outputs: deduplicated contact and account records with activity timelines and relationships
benchmark_note: data-model and import conformance can be tested, record-keeping quality has no reference answer
state_of_art: Salesforce Sales Cloud; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales; HubSpot CRM

name: Lead and opportunity management
definition: Given inbound leads and sales activity, score and route leads and track opportunities through pipeline stages to won or lost.
inputs: leads with source and firmographic or behavioral attributes, rep assignments, stage rules
outputs: lead scores and assignments, opportunity stages, conversion rates
benchmark_note: lead-conversion prediction can be scored on public marketing datasets such as the UCI Bank Marketing set; routing has no reference answer
state_of_art: Salesforce Sales Cloud; HubSpot Sales Hub; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales

name: Sales pipeline forecasting
definition: Given open opportunities, their stages and history, forecast bookings by period with a range.
inputs: opportunity snapshots over time, stage history, rep commits, historical win rates
outputs: period revenue forecast with confidence range, at-risk deals
benchmark_note: backtests on historical pipeline snapshots work, but public pipeline datasets are scarce
state_of_art: Clari; Salesforce Sales Cloud forecasting; Gong Forecast

name: Territory and quota planning
definition: Given accounts, geography, potential and rep capacity, design balanced sales territories and set quotas.
inputs: accounts with location and potential, rep headcount and capacity, prior sales
outputs: territory assignments, workload and potential balance measures, quotas
benchmark_note: territory design is a districting optimization whose balance and compactness can be scored, though no standard instance set exists
state_of_art: Salesforce Maps territory planning; Anaplan sales planning; Varicent

name: Quote and proposal configuration
definition: Given a product catalog with configuration and pricing rules and a customer's needs, produce a valid configured, priced quote.
inputs: product options and compatibility rules, price lists, discount approvals, customer requirements
outputs: valid configuration, priced quote document, approval routing
benchmark_note: configuration is constraint satisfaction with checkable validity; price correctness can be tested against rule sets
state_of_art: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle CPQ; Conga CPQ; Tacton CPQ

name: Donor and fundraising management
definition: Given donors, gifts, pledges and prospect wealth data, record giving, target solicitations and produce acknowledgements.
inputs: donor records, gifts and pledges, campaign codes, wealth and philanthropy indicators
outputs: giving histories, receipts and acknowledgements, prospect ratings, solicitation lists
benchmark_note: record-keeping with no reference answer
state_of_art: Blackbaud Raiser's Edge NXT; Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud; Bloomerang

name: Marketing campaign automation
definition: Given audiences, content and rules, plan and execute marketing campaigns across owned channels and record responses.

name: Email campaign delivery
definition: Given a subscriber list, consent status and message content, send personalized email campaigns and record deliveries, opens, clicks and unsubscribes.
inputs: subscriber lists, consent flags, templates and personalization fields, send schedule
outputs: sent messages, bounce and complaint handling, engagement metrics, updated suppression lists
benchmark_note: deliverability and rendering can be measured against seed lists; campaign quality cannot
state_of_art: Salesforce Marketing Cloud; Braze; Mailchimp; Klaviyo

name: Customer journey automation
definition: Given behavioral triggers and branching rules, run multi-step, multi-channel nurture sequences per customer.
inputs: event streams, profile attributes, journey definitions with waits, branches and goals
outputs: per-customer message sequences, journey state, goal conversions
benchmark_note: correctness is rule execution; value depends on live customers
state_of_art: Adobe Journey Optimizer; Salesforce Marketing Cloud Journey Builder; Braze Canvas

name: Audience segmentation and targeting
definition: Given customer attributes and behavior, build segments and propensity or uplift scores that decide who receives which offer.
inputs: customer profiles, transaction and engagement history, past campaign responses
outputs: segments, propensity or uplift scores, target lists
benchmark_note: public uplift datasets such as the Criteo uplift set and Hillstrom email data have held-out treatment outcomes
state_of_art: Adobe Real-Time CDP; Salesforce Data Cloud; Segment (Twilio)

name: Loyalty program management
definition: Given member transactions and program rules, accrue and redeem points, assign tiers and issue rewards.
inputs: member enrollments, purchase transactions, earn and burn rules, tier thresholds
outputs: point balances, tier status, reward issuance, liability totals
benchmark_note: rule execution with no reference problem set
state_of_art: Salesforce Loyalty Management; Comarch Loyalty Management; Antavo

name: Marketing plan and budget management
definition: Given marketing objectives, budgets and planned activities, maintain a campaign calendar, allocate spend and track assets and approvals.
inputs: budgets, planned campaigns and channels, creative assets, approval workflows
outputs: marketing calendar, budget versus actual, approved asset library
benchmark_note: planning workflow with no reference answer
state_of_art: Planful for Marketing; Uptempo; Adobe Workfront

name: Advertising buying and serving
definition: Given campaign goals, budgets, audiences and creatives, buy paid media in ad auctions and decide which ad fills each impression.

name: Search advertising campaign management
definition: Given keywords, ad copy, budgets and conversion goals, set and adjust bids in search-engine ad auctions to maximize conversions within budget.
inputs: keyword lists and match types, ad copy, budgets, bid strategies, conversion data
outputs: keyword bids, budget pacing, impressions, clicks, cost and conversions
benchmark_note: bidding policies can be compared in auction simulators such as AuctionGym, but live auction data is proprietary
state_of_art: Google Ads Smart Bidding; Microsoft Advertising; Skai

name: Programmatic real-time bidding
definition: Given a bid request with impression and audience context, campaign budgets and targeting, decide within milliseconds whether to bid, at what price and with which creative.
inputs: OpenRTB bid requests, campaign targeting and budgets, audience segments, predicted response rates
outputs: bid responses with price and creative, spend pacing, win and delivery logs
benchmark_note: the iPinYou real-time bidding dataset supports offline replay of bid strategies under budget
state_of_art: The Trade Desk; Google Display & Video 360; Amazon DSP

name: Ad response prediction
definition: Given impression, user and ad features, predict the probability of a click or conversion.
inputs: impression logs with user, context and ad features; click and conversion labels
outputs: calibrated click-through and conversion probabilities
benchmark_note: Criteo and Avazu click logs are standard leaderboards scored by log loss and AUC
state_of_art: Google Ads prediction models; Meta ads ranking models

name: Publisher ad serving and yield
definition: Given a publisher's ad slots, sold line items and programmatic demand, choose the ad for each impression and pace delivery to contracts while maximizing revenue.
inputs: ad slot definitions, line items with goals and priorities, header-bidding and exchange bids
outputs: ad decisions per impression, delivery pacing, revenue and fill reports
benchmark_note: guaranteed-delivery allocation is an online matching problem with known optima on synthetic instances
state_of_art: Google Ad Manager; Magnite; Kevel

name: Marketing measurement and research
definition: Given behavioral, spend, survey and market data, measure what marketing caused and what customers and markets want.

name: Web and app traffic analytics
definition: Given clickstream events from sites and apps, compute sessions, traffic sources, funnels and conversions.
inputs: page-view and event logs, campaign tags, conversion definitions
outputs: sessions, users, source attribution, funnel and retention reports
benchmark_note: sessionization and attribution rules can be checked against reference logs, but definitions differ by vendor
state_of_art: Google Analytics 4; Adobe Analytics; Amplitude

name: Site tag management
definition: Given measurement and advertising tags and firing rules, deploy and govern them on a site under consent settings.
inputs: tag templates, triggers, data-layer variables, consent signals
outputs: deployed tag configuration, fired events, consent-compliant data collection
benchmark_note: configuration management with no reference problem
state_of_art: Google Tag Manager; Tealium iQ; Adobe Experience Platform Tags

name: Online controlled experiments
definition: Given variants, traffic allocation and metrics, run randomized tests and estimate treatment effects with valid inference.
inputs: variant definitions, assignment rules, metric events, guardrail metrics
outputs: effect estimates with intervals, sample-ratio checks, ship decisions
benchmark_note: inference methods can be checked on simulated A/A and A/B data with known effects
state_of_art: Optimizely; Statsig; Adobe Target

name: Attribution and media mix modeling
definition: Given spend and exposure by channel and business outcomes over time, estimate each channel's incremental contribution and recommend budget reallocation.
inputs: channel spend and impressions by period, sales or conversions, controls such as price and seasonality
outputs: channel contributions, return on spend, response curves, optimized budget split
benchmark_note: simulated marketing data with known ground-truth effects allows scoring, real data does not
state_of_art: Google Meridian; Analytic Partners; Nielsen marketing mix modeling

name: Search engine optimization auditing
definition: Given a site and target queries, crawl it, track ranking positions and report technical and content issues that limit organic search visibility.
inputs: site URLs, target keywords, search result pages, crawl data
outputs: rank positions, crawl and indexing issues, keyword opportunities
benchmark_note: technical audits are checkable against seeded test sites; ranking outcomes are not reproducible
state_of_art: Semrush; Ahrefs; Screaming Frog SEO Spider

name: Conjoint and choice modeling
definition: Given an experimental design of product profiles and respondents' choices, estimate attribute part-worths and simulate market shares.
inputs: attribute and level design, respondent choice or rating data
outputs: part-worth utilities, willingness to pay, share-of-preference simulations, perceptual maps
benchmark_note: designs simulated from known part-worths give recoverable ground truth
state_of_art: Sawtooth Lighthouse Studio; Conjoint.ly; Qualtrics conjoint

name: Trade area and site analysis
definition: Given store or candidate locations, demographics and competitors, delineate trade areas, profile segments and forecast site sales.
inputs: site coordinates, customer origins, geodemographic segment data, competitor locations
outputs: trade-area polygons, segment profiles, gravity-model sales forecasts, ranked sites
benchmark_note: sales forecasts can be backtested where store sales are public, which is rare
state_of_art: Esri Business Analyst; Placer.ai; Buxton SCOUT

name: Point of sale and payment acceptance
definition: Given items, prices, promotions and a customer's tender, complete the sale, take payment in person or online, and reconcile the money.

name: Checkout transaction processing
definition: Given scanned items, price and promotion rules, tax rules and tenders, compute the basket total and record the sale, return or exchange.
inputs: item identifiers, price book, promotion and coupon rules, tax tables, tenders
outputs: receipts, transaction log records, tax and discount breakdown
benchmark_note: basket pricing with stacked promotions and tax has deterministic correct answers that test cases can fix
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Service; Square for Retail; Lightspeed Retail; Shopify POS
open_tools: Open Source Point of Sale; uniCenta oPOS; Chromis POS; Odoo Point of Sale

name: In-person card payment acceptance
definition: Given a card or wallet presented at a terminal and an amount, obtain authorization, capture and settle the payment securely.
inputs: chip, contactless or swipe card data, amount, merchant credentials
outputs: authorization responses, captured transactions, settlement batches
benchmark_note: certification test-card suites define pass or fail, not a ranking
state_of_art: Adyen terminals; Stripe Terminal; Clover

name: Online payment processing
definition: Given a checkout amount and a remote payment method, authorize, capture, refund and handle chargebacks through a gateway.
inputs: payment method tokens, amounts and currency, order references, dispute notices
outputs: authorizations, captures, refunds, payouts, dispute responses
benchmark_note: integration and reliability, not a problem with a reference answer
state_of_art: Stripe; Adyen; Braintree

name: Gift card and stored value
definition: Given gift-card issuance and redemption events, maintain balances and produce outstanding-liability totals.
inputs: card issuances, reloads, redemptions, expiry rules
outputs: card balances, transaction history, outstanding liability
benchmark_note: ledger keeping
state_of_art: Givex; Blackhawk Network

name: Till and cash office reconciliation
definition: Given POS tender totals and counted drawer contents, compute over and short by register and shift and prepare deposits.
inputs: register tender totals, drawer counts, pickups and loans, safe counts
outputs: over and short by cashier, deposit slips, store daily sales audit
benchmark_note: arithmetic bookkeeping
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Sales Audit; Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Service

name: Exception-based loss prevention
definition: Given POS transaction logs, flag cashiers, returns and voids whose patterns suggest theft or fraud and build investigation cases.
inputs: transaction logs, returns, voids, discounts, employee identifiers, video references
outputs: exception reports, risk-ranked employees and transactions, case files
benchmark_note: anomaly detectors can be scored on synthetic logs with seeded fraud; no labeled public data
state_of_art: Appriss Retail; Agilence

name: Merchandise planning, pricing and store inventory
definition: Given sales history, costs, space and inventory, decide what each store carries, at what price, in what quantity and where on the shelf.

name: Assortment planning
definition: Given item sales history, store clusters and space limits, choose which items each store or cluster carries.
inputs: item-store sales, store attributes and clusters, space capacity, item attributes
outputs: item-by-store assortment, expected sales and margin
benchmark_note: assortment optimization under a choice model has standard formulations but no public reference instances
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Assortment Planning; Blue Yonder Assortment Planning; RELEX Solutions

name: Merchandise financial planning
definition: Given sales, margin and inventory targets by category and period, produce merchandise plans and open-to-buy budgets.
inputs: historical sales and margins, targets, on-hand and on-order inventory
outputs: category plans by period, open-to-buy amounts
benchmark_note: planning arithmetic with no reference answer
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Merchandise Financial Planning; Anaplan; Board

name: Price and markdown optimization
definition: Given demand response to price, inventory and season end, set regular prices and markdown schedules that maximize margin or sell-through.
inputs: price and sales history, elasticity estimates, inventory, season calendar, pricing rules
outputs: recommended prices and markdown dates, projected sell-through and margin
benchmark_note: policies can be scored in simulators with known demand curves; real outcomes are proprietary
state_of_art: Revionics; Oracle Retail Offer Optimization; Blue Yonder Markdown Optimization

name: Promotion lift forecasting
definition: Given a promotion calendar and history, forecast incremental lift, cannibalization and halo for proposed promotions.
inputs: past promotions with mechanics, item sales, prices, calendar events
outputs: forecast lift by item and store, cannibalization estimates, promotion ROI
benchmark_note: public retail panels such as the M5 Walmart data and dunnhumby The Complete Journey include promotions and support backtests
state_of_art: RELEX Solutions; Blue Yonder; Revionics

name: Planogram and shelf space planning
definition: Given fixtures, item dimensions and sales, place items on shelves to meet facing, adjacency and capacity rules.
inputs: fixture geometry, item dimensions, sales velocity, adjacency rules
outputs: planograms, facings per item, days of supply on shelf
benchmark_note: shelf-space allocation is a knapsack-like optimization scorable on synthetic instances
state_of_art: Blue Yonder Space Planning; DotActiv; Symphony RetailAI

name: Store inventory counts and shrink
definition: Given receipts, sales, transfers and physical counts at a store, reconcile book to actual inventory and report shrink.
inputs: store receipts, sales, transfers, cycle and physical counts
outputs: perpetual inventory, count variances, shrink by category
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: Oracle Retail Store Inventory Operations; Lightspeed Retail; RGIS count services software

name: Online storefront and order management
definition: Given a catalog, prices and inventory, let customers find and buy products online and route each order to fulfillment.

name: Product catalog enrichment
definition: Given raw supplier product data, normalize attributes, classify each item into a category taxonomy and produce publishable product content.
inputs: supplier feeds, item attributes, images, category taxonomy such as GS1 GPC
outputs: classified, attribute-complete product records and channel-ready content
benchmark_note: product categorization and attribute extraction have public datasets such as the Rakuten Data Challenge and Amazon product data
state_of_art: Salsify; Akeneo; inriver

name: Storefront cart and checkout
definition: Given a catalog, prices, shipping and tax rules, let a shopper browse, build a cart and place a paid order.
inputs: catalog, prices and promotions, shipping and tax rules, shopper session
outputs: placed orders with totals, customer accounts, abandoned-cart events
benchmark_note: the WebShop and WebArena shopping environments test agents buying on a storefront, not the storefront itself
state_of_art: Shopify; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Adobe Commerce
open_tools: Magento Open Source; WooCommerce; PrestaShop; Saleor; Medusa; Sylius

name: Product search ranking
definition: Given a shopper's query and a product catalog, return products ranked by relevance and likelihood of purchase.
inputs: query text, catalog with titles and attributes, behavioral signals
outputs: ranked product list, facets, query corrections
benchmark_note: the Amazon Shopping Queries (ESCI) dataset gives graded relevance labels and a fixed metric
state_of_art: Algolia; Bloomreach Discovery; Coveo

name: Product recommendation
definition: Given shopper interaction histories and item data, rank items each shopper is most likely to buy next.
inputs: views, carts, purchases, item attributes
outputs: ranked item lists per shopper or per item context
benchmark_note: public retail interaction sets such as RetailRocket, Amazon reviews and the H&M Kaggle data support ranked-metric leaderboards
state_of_art: Amazon Personalize; Dynamic Yield; Bloomreach

name: Order orchestration and sourcing
definition: Given customer orders and inventory across stores and warehouses, choose fulfillment locations, split orders and track them through delivery and return.
inputs: orders, inventory by node, node capacities, shipping costs, service promises
outputs: sourcing assignments, order splits, status updates, return authorizations
benchmark_note: sourcing is a cost-minimizing assignment scorable on synthetic order streams
state_of_art: Manhattan Active Omni; IBM Sterling Order Management; Fluent Commerce

name: Marketplace and channel listing
definition: Given a catalog, prices and stock, publish and synchronize listings across third-party marketplaces and shopping feeds.
inputs: catalog records, channel category mappings, prices, stock levels
outputs: channel listings and product feeds, synchronized stock and prices, imported orders
benchmark_note: integration work
state_of_art: Rithum (ChannelAdvisor); Feedonomics; Sellbrite

name: Customer service and contact centers
definition: Given customer requests arriving by phone, email, chat or web, route, answer and resolve them while staffing and measuring the service operation.

name: Service case tracking and routing
definition: Given inbound customer requests, create cases, classify and prioritize them, assign them to agents and track them to resolution under service-level targets.
inputs: emails, web forms, chats and calls; customer and product records; routing and SLA rules
outputs: cases with category, priority, owner, SLA timers, resolution history
benchmark_note: automatic ticket classification and routing can be scored on labeled ticket sets; workflow cannot
state_of_art: Zendesk; Salesforce Service Cloud; ServiceNow Customer Service Management; Freshdesk

name: Self-service answers and virtual agents
definition: Given a customer's question, a knowledge base, policies and back-end actions, answer or complete the request automatically or hand off to a person.
inputs: customer messages, knowledge articles, policies, order and account APIs
outputs: answers, completed account actions, escalations with context, deflection rates
benchmark_note: tau-bench retail and airline tasks score policy-following agents; Banking77 and CLINC150 score intent detection
state_of_art: Sierra; Decagon; Intercom Fin; Google Dialogflow CX

name: Complaint and feedback management
definition: Given complaints and satisfaction responses, categorize them, investigate root causes and report satisfaction measures.
inputs: complaints, survey responses, investigation notes
outputs: categorized complaint cases, root-cause codes, CSAT and NPS trends, regulatory complaint reports
benchmark_note: complaint classification can be scored on the public CFPB consumer complaint database; investigation cannot
state_of_art: Qualtrics XM; Medallia

name: Automatic contact distribution
definition: Given arriving calls, chats and emails with attributes and agents with skills and states, queue each contact and deliver it to the best available agent.
inputs: contact attributes, queues, agent skills and states, routing strategies
outputs: agent assignments, queue wait times, abandonment and service-level statistics
benchmark_note: routing policies can be compared in queueing simulations with fixed arrival and skill mixes
state_of_art: Genesys Cloud CX; NICE CXone; Amazon Connect; Five9

name: Interactive voice response
definition: Given a call flow and caller speech or keypad input, identify the caller's need, complete self-service steps and route the remainder.
inputs: call-flow definitions, prompts, grammars or language models, back-end lookups
outputs: completed self-service transactions, captured intents, routed calls, containment rate
benchmark_note: spoken intent and slot recognition can be scored on public spoken-language datasets; call flows cannot
state_of_art: Nuance (Microsoft) conversational IVR; Genesys Cloud CX; Amazon Connect with Lex

name: Outbound and predictive dialing
definition: Given call lists, agent availability and do-not-call rules, pace outbound dials to keep agents busy without exceeding abandonment limits.
inputs: contact lists, calling windows, do-not-call and consent lists, agent states
outputs: dial pacing, connected calls, abandonment rate, compliance logs
benchmark_note: pacing algorithms can be scored in simulation on utilization against an abandonment cap
state_of_art: NICE CXone; Five9; Genesys Cloud CX

name: Contact center workforce management
definition: Given historical contact volumes, handle times and service targets, forecast workload by interval, compute required staff and build agent schedules.
inputs: interval contact volumes, average handle times, service-level targets, agent availability and rules
outputs: interval forecasts, staffing requirements, agent schedules, adherence reports
benchmark_note: Erlang C and Erlang A give reference staffing answers, and public call-center logs (Technion SEELab) support forecast backtests
state_of_art: NICE Workforce Management; Verint Workforce Management; Calabrio ONE

name: Interaction quality and speech analytics
definition: Given recorded calls and chat transcripts, score agent quality, detect topics, sentiment and compliance breaches.
inputs: call recordings or transcripts, chat logs, quality forms, compliance phrases
outputs: quality scores, topic and sentiment trends, compliance flags, coaching items
benchmark_note: transcription and sentiment have public benchmarks, quality scoring does not
state_of_art: NICE Nexidia; Verint Speech Analytics; CallMiner Eureka

name: Restaurant and food service operations
definition: Given recipes, menus, ingredient costs and guest orders, plan what to cook, control food cost and take and route orders through the kitchen.

name: Recipe scaling and costing
definition: Given standardized recipes, ingredient purchase prices, units and yields, scale recipes and compute portion cost and food-cost percentage.
inputs: recipes with quantities and units, purchase pack sizes and prices, trim and cooking yields, menu prices
outputs: scaled recipes, cost per portion, food-cost percentage
benchmark_note: unit conversion, yield and cost roll-ups have deterministic answers that test recipes can fix
state_of_art: Galley; meez; MarketMan

name: Menu planning and engineering
definition: Given recipes, costs, sales mix and cycle or nutrition constraints, build menus and classify items by popularity and contribution margin.
inputs: recipes and costs, item sales counts, menu cycle rules, nutrition targets
outputs: menu cycles, item profitability classes, production quantities
benchmark_note: constrained menu planning is a diet-problem optimization scorable on fixed instances
state_of_art: CBORD Foodservice Suite; Galley; Computrition

name: Kitchen inventory and food cost control
definition: Given purchases, counts and sales, compute theoretical versus actual ingredient usage and generate order guides.
inputs: invoices, inventory counts, item sales, recipe bills of materials, par levels
outputs: actual versus theoretical food cost, variance by item, purchase orders
benchmark_note: variance arithmetic is deterministic; demand-driven ordering can be backtested only on private data
state_of_art: MarketMan; Restaurant365; CrunchTime

name: Restaurant order and kitchen routing
definition: Given guest orders with modifiers, tables, seats and courses, send items to the right kitchen stations, fire courses and settle split checks.
inputs: menu with modifiers and station routing, table layout, orders by seat and course, tenders and tips
outputs: kitchen tickets or display items, course timing, guest checks and splits, server sales
benchmark_note: check and split arithmetic is testable; kitchen pacing has no reference data
state_of_art: Toast; Oracle Simphony; NCR Voyix Aloha

name: Takeout and delivery order management
definition: Given phone and online orders with addresses and kitchen load, quote ready times, queue production and assign drivers.
inputs: orders with addresses and promised times, kitchen capacity, driver availability
outputs: quoted times, production queue, driver assignments, delivery status
benchmark_note: the Grubhub meal delivery routing problem instances (Reyes and colleagues) give fixed scenarios with published results
state_of_art: Olo; Toast Delivery Services; Otter

name: Cafeteria meal accounting
definition: Given patron accounts, eligibility status and meal transactions, record each meal, debit accounts and produce reimbursable-meal claims.
inputs: patron rosters, free and reduced eligibility, meal transactions, account deposits
outputs: account balances, meal counts by eligibility, reimbursement claims
benchmark_note: rule-driven bookkeeping
state_of_art: PowerSchool (Nutrikids); LINQ Nutrition; Heartland School Solutions

name: Lodging, reservations and events
definition: Given rooms, tables, tours or function space and guest demand, take reservations, price inventory and run the stay or event.

name: Hotel front office operations
definition: Given reservations, room inventory and guests, assign rooms, check guests in and out, post charges to folios, track housekeeping and close the day.
inputs: reservations, room types and status, rates, guest profiles, charges from outlets
outputs: room assignments, guest folios, housekeeping status, night-audit reports
benchmark_note: room assignment under preferences is an optimization with checkable objectives; folio work is bookkeeping
state_of_art: Oracle OPERA Cloud; Mews; Cloudbeds

name: Central reservations and channel distribution
definition: Given rates, availability and restrictions, publish bookable inventory to direct and third-party channels and take reservations without overselling.
inputs: room types, rate plans, availability and stay restrictions, channel mappings
outputs: channel availability and rate updates, reservations, modification and cancellation messages
benchmark_note: OpenTravel message conformance is testable; distribution strategy is not
state_of_art: Sabre SynXis Central Reservations; Amadeus iHotelier; SiteMinder

name: Room revenue management
definition: Given booking pace, demand forecasts, cancellations and competitor rates, set prices and availability controls such as overbooking and length-of-stay limits.
inputs: on-the-books reservations, historical demand and cancellations, competitor rates, capacity
outputs: demand and cancellation forecasts, recommended rates, booking limits and overbooking levels
benchmark_note: the public hotel booking demand dataset (Antonio, Almeida and Nunes) scores cancellation and demand forecasts, and EMSR-b gives reference booking limits
state_of_art: IDeaS G3 RMS; Duetto; Oracle OPERA Cloud Revenue Management

name: Table reservations and waitlist
definition: Given party sizes, requested times and a table layout, accept reservations, assign tables and quote waits for walk-ins.
inputs: table inventory and combinations, turn times, reservation requests, walk-in queue
outputs: confirmed reservations, table assignments, wait quotes, guest notes
benchmark_note: table assignment is an online packing problem scorable on simulated nights
state_of_art: OpenTable; Resy; SevenRooms

name: Tour and activity booking
definition: Given tour departures, capacities and prices, take bookings, build itineraries and produce passenger manifests and supplier vouchers.
inputs: tour products and departures, capacity, pricing, supplier contracts, traveler details
outputs: bookings, itineraries, manifests, vouchers
benchmark_note: booking records with no reference problem
state_of_art: FareHarbor; Rezdy; Bokun; Tourplan; TourCMS

name: Event, venue and catering sales
definition: Given event inquiries, function spaces and menus, book space without conflicts and produce banquet event orders and invoices.
inputs: inquiries with dates and headcounts, function-space diary, room setups, catering menus and prices
outputs: space bookings, banquet event orders, contracts and invoices
benchmark_note: function-space assignment is a timetabling problem scorable on synthetic instances
state_of_art: Amadeus Delphi; Tripleseat; Cvent

name: Event registration and ticketing
definition: Given an event, seating map and price levels, sell registrations or seats, issue tickets and check attendees in.
inputs: event sessions, seat maps or capacities, price levels, attendee details
outputs: registrations, seat assignments, tickets, check-in records
benchmark_note: transaction processing with no reference problem
state_of_art: Ticketmaster; Cvent; Eventbrite

name: Real estate brokerage and valuation
definition: Given property data, listings and comparable sales, market properties, estimate their value and carry a sale from listing to closing.

name: Property listing exchange
definition: Given listing data and media from brokers, maintain shared listing records in a standard data dictionary and serve searches and syndication feeds.
inputs: listing attributes, photos, status changes, member and office records
outputs: standardized listings, status histories, search results, syndication feeds
benchmark_note: RESO certification tests data-dictionary and API conformance
state_of_art: CoreLogic Matrix; FBS Flexmls; Bridge Interactive

name: Comparative market analysis
definition: Given a subject property and recent nearby sales and listings, select comparables, adjust for differences and recommend a list-price range.
inputs: subject property attributes, comparable sales and active listings, market trends
outputs: selected comparables with adjustments, suggested price range, client report
benchmark_note: suggested prices can be scored against later sale prices
state_of_art: Cloud CMA; Realtors Property Resource; CoreLogic RealQuest

name: Residential appraisal report preparation
definition: Given inspection data, comparables and adjustments, produce a standard residential appraisal report with a reconciled opinion of value.
inputs: subject inspection data, sketches and photos, comparable sales, adjustment grid
outputs: completed appraisal form (such as Fannie Mae Form 1004) with reconciled value
benchmark_note: Uniform Appraisal Dataset conformance is checkable; value opinions are judged against sale prices
state_of_art: a la mode TOTAL; Bradford ClickFORMS; ACI Analytics

name: Automated property valuation
definition: Given property characteristics, location and transaction history, estimate a property's market value with a confidence measure.
inputs: property attributes, geocoded location, sales and listing history, market indices
outputs: value estimate, confidence score or range
benchmark_note: public sale datasets (Ames housing, Zillow Prize) and IAAO ratio-study statistics give standard error metrics
state_of_art: Zillow Zestimate; CoreLogic Total Home ValueX; HouseCanary

name: Showing scheduling and feedback
definition: Given listings, seller access rules and buyer-agent requests, confirm showing appointments and collect feedback.
inputs: listing access instructions, seller availability, showing requests
outputs: confirmed showings, lockbox access, buyer-agent feedback reports
benchmark_note: scheduling workflow without a reference problem
state_of_art: ShowingTime; BrokerBay

name: Brokerage transaction management
definition: Given an accepted offer, track contract deadlines, documents and signatures to closing and compute agent commissions.
inputs: purchase contracts, contingency dates, required documents, commission plans
outputs: transaction checklists and deadlines, compliance-reviewed files, commission statements
benchmark_note: document workflow
state_of_art: dotloop; SkySlope; Lone Wolf Transactions

name: Income property investment analysis
definition: Given rents, expenses, financing and a holding period, project property cash flows and compute returns.
inputs: rent roll, operating expenses, growth assumptions, loan terms, exit cap rate
outputs: pro forma cash flows, net operating income, internal rate of return, cap rate, debt coverage
benchmark_note: discounted-cash-flow results are deterministic given assumptions, so reference cases fix the answer
state_of_art: ARGUS Enterprise; RealData Real Estate Investment Analysis

name: Rental property and lease management
definition: Given properties, units, leases and tenants, lease space, bill and collect rent and administer lease obligations.

name: Tenant ledger and rent roll
definition: Given leases, recurring charges and payments, post charges, apply receipts and produce rent rolls, delinquency and owner statements.
inputs: units, leases and charge schedules, payments, late-fee rules
outputs: tenant ledgers, rent roll, delinquency reports, owner statements
benchmark_note: ledger keeping
state_of_art: Yardi Voyager; AppFolio Property Manager; RealPage OneSite; Entrata

name: Leasing and applicant screening
definition: Given vacancies, prospects and applications with credit and rental history, qualify applicants and generate leases.
inputs: vacant units and pricing, prospect inquiries, applications, screening reports
outputs: screening decisions, executed leases, move-in schedules
benchmark_note: workflow, and screening criteria are regulated rather than optimized
state_of_art: Entrata; RealPage; TransUnion SmartMove

name: Commercial lease administration
definition: Given commercial leases, abstract key terms, track critical dates and compute escalations and common-area maintenance recoveries.
inputs: lease documents, clause terms, operating expenses, tenant shares
outputs: lease abstracts, critical-date alerts, escalation and CAM reconciliation statements
benchmark_note: lease abstraction is clause extraction that can be scored on labeled leases; CAM arithmetic is deterministic
state_of_art: Visual Lease; MRI Software; CoStar Real Estate Manager

name: Community association management
definition: Given units, owners and association rules, bill assessments, track violations and architectural requests and manage reserves.
inputs: units and owners, assessment schedules, violation reports, reserve study
outputs: assessment billing, violation notices, owner ledgers, reserve fund reports
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: Vantaca; CINC Systems; AppFolio

name: Appointment and field service management
definition: Given customer service requests, staff, technicians and resources, book appointments, dispatch work and track service orders to completion.

name: Customer appointment booking
definition: Given services with durations, staff and room availability and customer requests, book conflict-free appointments, send reminders and fill cancellations.
inputs: service menu and durations, staff and resource calendars, booking rules, customer requests
outputs: confirmed appointments, reminders, waitlist fills, utilization and no-show reports
benchmark_note: multi-resource booking is constraint satisfaction with checkable feasibility and utilization
state_of_art: Calendly; Square Appointments; Acuity Scheduling; Microsoft Bookings

name: Field technician scheduling and dispatch
definition: Given service jobs with time windows, skills and locations and technician calendars, assign and sequence jobs and dispatch technicians.
inputs: jobs with windows, durations, skills and addresses; technician skills, shifts and start locations; parts
outputs: job assignments and routes, arrival windows, dispatch updates, first-time-fix rate
benchmark_note: technician routing and scheduling instances such as the ROADEF 2007 challenge have published best solutions
state_of_art: Salesforce Field Service; ServiceTitan; IFS Field Service Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service

name: Service contracts and warranty entitlements
definition: Given service contracts and covered assets, check entitlement for each request, process warranty claims and schedule renewals.
inputs: contracts and covered assets, coverage terms, service requests, warranty claims
outputs: entitlement decisions, claim submissions, renewal quotes
benchmark_note: rule-driven record-keeping
state_of_art: ServiceNow Field Service Management; Salesforce Field Service; Tavant Warranty

name: Personal and death care services
definition: Given clients and the services a personal-service business sells, keep the industry-specific records each service needs: client service histories, memberships, funeral arrangements, plots, pets and photo jobs.

name: Salon and spa client records
definition: Given clients, services performed, product sales and staff, keep client service histories and formulas and compute staff commissions and retail attachment.
inputs: client profiles, service tickets with formulas and notes, product sales, commission plans
outputs: client histories, rebooking prompts, staff commission and productivity reports
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: Boulevard; Phorest; Vagaro; Fresha

name: Fitness and club membership
definition: Given members, plans and facility access, bill recurring dues, control check-in and manage class and court rosters.
inputs: member contracts and plans, payment methods, check-ins, class schedules and capacities
outputs: recurring dues billing, access decisions, class rosters and attendance, retention reports
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: ABC Fitness (Glofox); Mindbody; Club Automation

name: Fitness assessment and program design
definition: Given a client's fitness assessment and goals, produce an individualized exercise program and track progress.
inputs: assessment measures, goals, health screening, exercise library
outputs: exercise prescriptions, progress records
benchmark_note: no agreed reference outcome
state_of_art: Trainerize; TrueCoach

name: Funeral arrangement and case records
definition: Given a death call, decedent and family information and selected goods and services, produce the arrangement contract, vital-statistics data, service schedule and obituary.
inputs: decedent and informant details, selected merchandise and services, price list, service dates
outputs: statement of goods and services, death-certificate data, service schedule, case file
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: Passare; Osiris; FrontRunner Professional

name: Cemetery plot and interment records
definition: Given cemetery sections, plots, deeds and burials, maintain plot inventory and ownership, record interments and sell preneed contracts.
inputs: plot maps, deeds and owners, interment orders, preneed contracts
outputs: plot availability and ownership, interment records, contract balances
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: PlotBox; CIMS Cemetery Software

name: Pet grooming and boarding
definition: Given pets, owners, kennel runs and services, take boarding and grooming bookings, check vaccinations and track occupancy and care notes.
inputs: pet and owner profiles, vaccination records, kennel inventory, service requests
outputs: boarding reservations, occupancy charts, groom tickets, care logs
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: Gingr; PetExec; MoeGo

name: Photography studio job management
definition: Given client inquiries, session packages and image orders, book sessions, issue contracts and invoices and fulfill print and album orders.
inputs: leads, session types and packages, contracts, image selections and print orders
outputs: booked sessions, contracts and invoices, lab orders, job status
benchmark_note: record-keeping
state_of_art: HoneyBook; Studio Ninja; Táve

name: Finance, law and public administration
definition: Money as a product, the law, and the functions specific to government: banking, lending, markets, insurance, legal practice, regulation, public safety and justice, and social programs.

name: Banking operations and payments
definition: Given customer, account and payment instructions, maintain deposit accounts and their ledgers and move money between accounts and institutions.

name: Deposit account processing
definition: Given account agreements and posted transactions, maintain balances, accrue interest and fees, and produce statements for demand and savings accounts.
inputs: account agreements, product terms, transaction postings
outputs: account balances, accrued interest and fees, statements
benchmark_note: interest and fee accrual can be checked against hand-computed cases, but there is no public test suite
state_of_art: Temenos Transact; Fiserv DNA; Jack Henry SilverLake; Finastra Fusion Essence

name: Teller and branch transactions
definition: Given an in-person deposit, withdrawal, check cashing or cash order, validate it against the account and post it while balancing the teller drawer.
inputs: transaction slip or check image, account status, cash drawer state
outputs: posted transaction, receipt, drawer balance
benchmark_note: correctness is procedural and institution-specific

name: Payment clearing and settlement
definition: Given payment instructions (wire, automated clearing house, check image, instant payment), validate, route, net and settle them between institutions and report status.
inputs: payment initiation messages, routing directories, settlement accounts
outputs: cleared and settled payments, status reports, settlement positions
benchmark_note: ISO 20022 and NACHA file conformance can be tested against published message rules
state_of_art: Volante; FIS Payments Hub; ACI Enterprise Payments Platform

name: Check issue matching (positive pay)
definition: Given an issuer's list of written checks and the checks presented for payment, flag presented items that do not match for a pay-or-return decision.
inputs: issued-check file, presented check images and MICR data
outputs: exception list, pay or return decisions
benchmark_note: matching accuracy on synthetic issue and presentment files is measurable

name: Credit scoring, lending and servicing
definition: Given a borrower's application, credit history and financial statements, decide whether and on what terms to lend, then service and collect the loan.

name: Credit scorecard development
definition: Given historical applications and repayment outcomes, fit and validate a model that ranks applicants by probability of default.
inputs: applicant attributes, bureau data, performance outcomes
outputs: scorecard or model, cut-offs, validation statistics
benchmark_note: public credit datasets (for example Home Credit, German Credit) allow scored comparisons of discrimination and calibration
state_of_art: FICO Model Builder; SAS Credit Scoring; Experian PowerCurve

name: Credit bureau report retrieval
definition: Given a borrower's identity and permissible purpose, retrieve and merge credit bureau files into a single report with scores and attributes.
inputs: borrower identity, permissible purpose, bureau credentials
outputs: merged credit report, scores, derived attributes
benchmark_note: depends on proprietary bureau data access
state_of_art: Equifax InterConnect; Experian Connect; MeridianLink

name: Application decisioning and automated underwriting
definition: Given a loan application, bureau data and policy rules, return an approve, refer or decline decision with terms and conditions.
inputs: application data, credit report, collateral data, policy rules
outputs: decision, pricing and terms, conditions list
benchmark_note: rule execution can be tested against published agency guidelines; decision quality needs outcome data
state_of_art: Fannie Mae Desktop Underwriter; Freddie Mac Loan Product Advisor; FICO Blaze Advisor; Provenir

name: Commercial credit analysis and spreading
definition: Given a business borrower's financial statements and market data, spread the statements into a standard form and estimate default probability and a risk rating.
inputs: financial statements, industry and market data
outputs: spread statements, ratios, probability of default, risk grade
benchmark_note: default prediction can be scored on public company bankruptcy datasets; statement spreading accuracy on filed statements
state_of_art: Moody's CreditLens; S&P Global Credit Analytics; nCino

name: Loan origination
definition: Given a borrower's application and supporting documents, assemble the loan file, order verifications, track conditions and produce closing documents.
inputs: application (for example the Uniform Residential Loan Application), documents, verifications
outputs: complete loan file, disclosures, closing package
benchmark_note: workflow and disclosure correctness are jurisdiction-specific and procedural
state_of_art: ICE Encompass; nCino; MeridianLink Consumer; Blend

name: Loan servicing and amortization
definition: Given booked loans and payments received, compute amortization schedules, apply payments, manage escrow and produce borrower statements.
inputs: loan terms, payment receipts, escrow items
outputs: amortization schedules, balances, escrow analyses, statements
benchmark_note: amortization, interest and escrow calculations have exact answers that can be checked
state_of_art: Black Knight MSP; Sagent; Fiserv LoanServ

name: Collections and recovery
definition: Given delinquent accounts, prioritize them, schedule contact strategies, locate debtors and record promises and recoveries.
inputs: delinquent account data, contact history, skip-trace sources
outputs: prioritized work queues, contact strategy, recovery records
benchmark_note: roll-rate and cure prediction can be scored on historical delinquency data
state_of_art: Experian PowerCurve Collections; C&R Software Debt Manager

name: Consumer debt management plans
definition: Given a consumer's debts, income and expenses, build a repayment or settlement plan and administer payments to creditors.
inputs: creditor list, balances and rates, household budget
outputs: debt management plan, disbursement schedule, progress reports
benchmark_note: payoff schedules are exactly computable; plan quality is a judgment

name: Securities analysis and pricing
definition: Given market and company data, value securities and companies, price derivatives and fixed income instruments, and forecast prices.

name: Market data and financial information retrieval
definition: Given instruments, companies or indicators of interest, retrieve current and historical prices, fundamentals, filings and news.
inputs: instrument and entity identifiers, query
outputs: price histories, fundamentals, filings, news
benchmark_note: value is coverage and timeliness of licensed data
state_of_art: Bloomberg Terminal; LSEG Workspace; FactSet; S&P Capital IQ Pro

name: Company valuation and deal modeling
definition: Given a company's financials, comparable companies and transactions, estimate enterprise and equity value and the accretion or dilution of a proposed deal.
inputs: financial statements, projections, comparable company and transaction data
outputs: valuation range, discounted cash flow model, accretion or dilution analysis
benchmark_note: model mechanics are checkable, but valuation has no ground truth beyond later transaction prices
state_of_art: Capital IQ; PitchBook; ValuAdder

name: Technical analysis and charting
definition: Given price and volume histories, compute indicators and chart patterns and generate rule-based trading signals.
inputs: price and volume time series, indicator definitions
outputs: indicator series, charts, signals
benchmark_note: indicator values are deterministic and can be checked against reference implementations
state_of_art: MetaStock; TradingView; TradeStation

name: Market price and return forecasting
definition: Given price histories and explanatory variables, fit a model that forecasts returns, prices or volatility and evaluate it out of sample.
inputs: price series, economic and fundamental variables
outputs: forecasts with error statistics
benchmark_note: out-of-sample forecast error on public price histories is measurable, as Numerai and the M6 competition do
state_of_art: Bloomberg BQuant

name: Fund research and screening
definition: Given a universe of mutual funds, exchange-traded funds or annuities, screen and compare them on returns, risk, fees and holdings.
inputs: fund returns, holdings, fees, ratings
outputs: screens, comparison reports, risk-adjusted return measures
benchmark_note: risk-adjusted return measures are exactly computable from public return series
state_of_art: Morningstar Direct; YCharts

name: Option and derivative pricing
definition: Given an option, swap or exotic contract and market inputs, compute its fair value and sensitivities with an analytic, lattice or Monte Carlo model.
inputs: contract terms, underlying prices, volatility surface, rate curves
outputs: fair value, sensitivities (Greeks)
benchmark_note: closed-form cases and published reference prices (for example in Hull's text and QuantLib's test suite) give exact targets
state_of_art: Numerix; FINCAD; Bloomberg DLIB

name: Fixed income and structured product analytics
definition: Given a bond, mortgage-backed security or convertible and market curves, compute price, yield, duration, convexity and projected cash flows.
inputs: security terms, yield curves, prepayment and default assumptions
outputs: price and yield, duration and convexity, cash-flow projections
benchmark_note: yield and accrued-interest conventions have exact answers (SIFMA standard formulas)
state_of_art: Yield Book; Intex; Bloomberg YAS

name: Investment, trading and wealth management
definition: Given investors' goals and holdings, construct and account for portfolios, execute trades, and plan individuals' long-term finances.

name: Portfolio construction and asset allocation
definition: Given expected returns, risks, correlations and constraints, choose portfolio weights that optimize a risk-return objective.
inputs: capital market assumptions, covariance estimates, constraints
outputs: target weights, efficient frontier, rebalancing trades
benchmark_note: optimization problems with known optima and out-of-sample portfolio performance are both measurable
state_of_art: MSCI Barra Optimizer; Axioma Portfolio Optimizer; Morningstar Direct

name: Performance measurement and attribution
definition: Given holdings, transactions and benchmark data, compute time-weighted returns and attribute them to allocation, selection and factor effects.
inputs: holdings, transactions, prices, benchmarks
outputs: returns by period, attribution reports, risk-adjusted measures
benchmark_note: GIPS return calculations and Brinson attribution have exact answers
state_of_art: FactSet Portfolio Analysis; Bloomberg PORT; SS&C Sylvan

name: Portfolio accounting and investment book of record
definition: Given trades, corporate actions and prices, maintain positions, cost basis, accruals and valuations for each portfolio.
inputs: trades, corporate actions, prices, cash movements
outputs: positions, cost basis, realized and unrealized gains, statements
benchmark_note: positions and cost basis after a scripted series of trades and corporate actions are exactly checkable
state_of_art: SS&C Advent Geneva; SS&C APX; Clearwater Analytics

name: Order management and electronic trade execution
definition: Given investment decisions, create, route and execute orders on trading venues and record fills and allocations.
inputs: orders, venue connectivity, market data
outputs: executions, fills, allocations
benchmark_note: execution cost against arrival price can be measured in simulation; venue connectivity cannot
state_of_art: Charles River IMS; Bloomberg AIM; FlexTrade; Tradeweb

name: Trading strategy backtesting
definition: Given a trading rule and historical market data, simulate its trades with costs and report returns, drawdowns and risk.
inputs: strategy rules, historical prices, cost model
outputs: simulated trades, equity curve, performance statistics
benchmark_note: deterministic replays on public price data give checkable results
state_of_art: QuantConnect; TradeStation

name: Personal financial and retirement planning
definition: Given a household's assets, income, spending and goals, project its finances to and through retirement and test the plan's probability of success.
inputs: assets and liabilities, income and spending, goals, assumptions
outputs: cash-flow projection, probability of success, recommendations
benchmark_note: projections are reproducible given assumptions, but there is no outcome ground truth
state_of_art: MoneyGuidePro; eMoney Advisor; RightCapital

name: Estate, education and insurance needs analysis
definition: Given a household's situation and a goal or contingency, compute the amount needed to fund it and the effect of estate transfers and taxes.
inputs: family data, assets, goal or contingency, tax rules
outputs: funding need, estate tax and transfer projections
benchmark_note: estate tax computations are exact under stated law; needs are judgments
state_of_art: NumberCruncher; Brentmark Estate Planning Quickview

name: Household money management
definition: Given a household's account transactions, categorize spending, track budgets and net worth over time.
inputs: account transactions, categories, budgets
outputs: categorized spending, budget variance, net worth
benchmark_note: transaction categorization accuracy is measurable on labeled data
state_of_art: Quicken; Monarch Money; YNAB

name: Financial risk and actuarial modeling
definition: Given portfolios, balance sheets or insurance and pension liabilities, quantify the distribution of losses and the reserves and capital needed to cover them.

name: Market risk measurement
definition: Given positions and market factor histories or scenarios, compute value at risk, expected shortfall and stress losses.
inputs: positions, pricing models, factor histories or scenarios
outputs: value at risk, expected shortfall, stress test results
benchmark_note: value at risk on a fixed portfolio and scenario set is exactly computable; backtests against realized losses are standard
state_of_art: MSCI RiskMetrics; Murex MX.3; Bloomberg MARS

name: Credit portfolio risk
definition: Given exposures, default probabilities and correlations, estimate the portfolio loss distribution and economic or regulatory capital.
inputs: exposures, default probabilities, recovery rates, correlation model
outputs: expected and unexpected loss, capital, concentration reports
benchmark_note: capital formulas under the Basel internal-ratings approach are exact; model choice is not
state_of_art: Moody's RiskFrontier; S&P Credit Analytics

name: Asset-liability and interest rate risk
definition: Given a bank's balance sheet and rate scenarios, project net interest income and economic value of equity and measure repricing gaps.
inputs: balance sheet by repricing bucket, behavioral assumptions, rate scenarios
outputs: net interest income and economic value projections, gap reports
benchmark_note: standardized rate-shock calculations are exact; behavioral assumptions are not
state_of_art: QRM; FIS BancWare

name: Life, annuity and health liability projection
definition: Given policies in force, mortality, lapse and economic assumptions, project liability cash flows and compute reserves and embedded value.
inputs: policy data, assumption tables, economic scenarios
outputs: projected cash flows, reserves, embedded value
benchmark_note: reserve calculations on published model points and tables (for example Society of Actuaries mortality tables) have exact answers
state_of_art: Moody's AXIS; WTW RiskAgility FM; FIS Prophet; Milliman MG-ALFA

name: Property and casualty loss reserving
definition: Given paid and incurred claim triangles, estimate ultimate losses and unpaid claim reserves with their uncertainty.
inputs: loss development triangles, exposures
outputs: ultimate loss estimates, reserves, reserve ranges
benchmark_note: Casualty Actuarial Society loss reserving data sets allow scoring of reserve estimates against later developed values
state_of_art: WTW ResQ; Milliman Arius

name: Pension and benefit plan valuation
definition: Given plan provisions, participant data and assumptions, compute plan liabilities, funding requirements and nondiscrimination test results.
inputs: plan provisions, census data, actuarial assumptions
outputs: liabilities, required contributions, test results
benchmark_note: funding and liability calculations under published rules have exact answers for given data
state_of_art: ProAdmin; FIS Relius

name: Insurance underwriting and claims
definition: Given risks to be insured and losses reported, rate and underwrite policies, administer them, and adjust, value and pay claims.

name: Insurance rating and quoting
definition: Given a risk's characteristics and a filed rating plan, compute the premium and produce a quote.
inputs: risk characteristics, rating tables and rules
outputs: premium, quote
benchmark_note: premium for a given risk under a published filed rating plan is exact
state_of_art: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Rating; Majesco

name: Underwriting risk assessment
definition: Given an application and evidence (medical, motor, property, loss history), classify the risk and decide acceptance, class and exclusions.
inputs: application, evidence, underwriting guidelines
outputs: risk class, decision, exclusions and loadings
benchmark_note: rule execution is checkable; risk selection quality needs claims outcomes
state_of_art: Swiss Re Magnum; Munich Re ALLFINANZ; RGA AURA

name: Policy administration and issuance
definition: Given bound coverage, issue the policy, produce documents, and process endorsements, renewals and cancellations.
inputs: bound coverage, forms library, policy changes
outputs: issued policy, documents, billing records
benchmark_note: procedural, product-specific
state_of_art: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; Sapiens

name: Claims intake and adjudication
definition: Given a first notice of loss and supporting evidence, verify coverage, set reserves, manage the investigation and decide payment.
inputs: loss notice, policy, evidence, adjuster notes
outputs: coverage decision, reserve, payment, claim file
benchmark_note: coverage decisions on synthetic claims against policy wording can be scored
state_of_art: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Duck Creek Claims; Snapsheet

name: Bodily injury and liability evaluation
definition: Given injury, treatment and accident facts, estimate the value of a bodily injury claim and the apportionment of fault.
inputs: injury and treatment records, accident facts, jurisdiction
outputs: claim value range, fault apportionment
benchmark_note: medical bill review against fee schedules is exact; injury valuation is judgment
state_of_art: DXC Colossus; Mitchell Decision Point

name: Property and vehicle damage estimating
definition: Given photos, measurements or a damage inspection, itemize repair operations, parts and labor and price the repair.
inputs: damage photos or inspection, structure or vehicle data, regional price databases
outputs: itemized repair estimate, total loss decision
benchmark_note: image-based damage detection can be scored on labeled vehicle-damage datasets; full estimates need price data
state_of_art: Xactimate; CCC ONE; Audatex; Tractable

name: Insurance claims fraud detection
definition: Given claims and related parties, score claims for fraud likelihood and surface linked networks for investigation.
inputs: claim data, party and provider networks, industry claim databases
outputs: fraud scores, referral lists, link charts
benchmark_note: detection accuracy can be scored on public synthetic and anonymized claim datasets
state_of_art: Verisk ClaimSearch; Shift Technology; FRISS

name: Regulatory compliance and financial crime
definition: Given regulations, an organization's activities and its transactions, keep controls mapped to obligations, file required reports, and detect fraud and money laundering.

name: Compliance obligations and controls management
definition: Given applicable obligations and the organization's processes, map controls to obligations, schedule tests, and track issues and remediation.
inputs: obligation library, process and control inventory, test results
outputs: control matrix, test schedule, issue log, attestation reports
benchmark_note: procedural workflow with no reference answer
state_of_art: Archer; MetricStream; ServiceNow GRC; AuditBoard

name: Regulatory change monitoring
definition: Given jurisdictions and business lines, track new and amended rules and map each change to affected obligations and controls.
inputs: regulatory publications, obligation library
outputs: change alerts, impact assessments, updated obligations
benchmark_note: mapping rule text to obligations can be scored on labeled corpora
state_of_art: Wolters Kluwer OneSumX; Thomson Reuters Regulatory Intelligence; CUBE

name: Regulatory reporting and filing
definition: Given an institution's books and a regulator's taxonomy and rules, compute required returns, validate them and file them in the prescribed format.
inputs: general ledger and risk data, report templates and validation rules
outputs: validated regulatory returns, filed submissions
benchmark_note: XBRL conformance suites and regulator validation rules give exact pass or fail
state_of_art: Wolters Kluwer OneSumX; Workiva; AxiomSL ControllerView

name: Regulated product submissions
definition: Given a product's dossier of studies and documents, assemble, validate and publish a submission in the regulator's structure (for example electronic Common Technical Document).
inputs: documents, metadata, regulator specification
outputs: validated submission package, submission tracking
benchmark_note: regulator technical validation criteria for eCTD give exact pass or fail
state_of_art: Veeva Vault RIM; Extedo eCTDmanager; Lorenz docuBridge

name: Supervisory examination
definition: Given a supervised institution's records and an examination program, analyze transactions and records and document findings and ratings.
inputs: institution data extracts, examination procedures
outputs: workpapers, findings, supervisory ratings
benchmark_note: findings are judgments without reference answers

name: Trading and conduct surveillance
definition: Given orders, trades and communications, detect market abuse, rule breaches and personal trading conflicts and manage the resulting alerts.
inputs: order and trade records, employee holdings, communications
outputs: alerts, case files, attestations
benchmark_note: detection on synthetic order books with injected manipulation patterns is scorable
state_of_art: NICE Actimize SURVEIL-X; Nasdaq Trade Surveillance; Eventus

name: Anti-money-laundering monitoring and sanctions screening
definition: Given customers, counterparties and transactions, screen names against sanctions and watch lists and flag transaction patterns indicative of laundering.
inputs: customer and counterparty data, transactions, sanctions and watch lists
outputs: screening hits, alerts, suspicious activity reports
benchmark_note: name-matching accuracy on labeled watch-list pairs and detection on synthetic transaction sets (for example IBM's AML synthetic data) are measurable
state_of_art: NICE Actimize; Oracle Financial Crime and Compliance Management; LSEG World-Check; Feedzai

name: Card and payment fraud detection
definition: Given authorization and payment events with account history, score each event for fraud in real time and decide to approve, decline or challenge.
inputs: transaction stream, account and device history
outputs: fraud scores, decisions, case queue
benchmark_note: public labeled datasets (for example the IEEE-CIS fraud data) support scored comparison
state_of_art: FICO Falcon Fraud Manager; Featurespace ARIC; Feedzai; Stripe Radar; Signifyd; Riskified

name: Legal research and analytics
definition: Given a legal question, find, verify and analyze the authorities, court records and public records that bear on it.

name: Case law and statute search
definition: Given a legal question or citation, retrieve the relevant cases, statutes and regulations ranked by relevance.
inputs: natural-language question, citation or Boolean query, jurisdiction
outputs: ranked authorities with excerpts
benchmark_note: legal retrieval benchmarks (COLIEE, LegalBench retrieval tasks) give scored comparisons
state_of_art: Westlaw; Lexis+; vLex Vincent

name: Citation validation
definition: Given an authority or a brief, determine whether each cited authority is still good law and how later decisions treated it.
inputs: case citation or document with citations
outputs: treatment flags, citing references
benchmark_note: citation extraction is scorable on labeled briefs; negative-treatment labels are proprietary
state_of_art: Shepard's; KeyCite

name: Court docket and filing retrieval
definition: Given a party, case number or court, retrieve docket entries and filed documents.
inputs: party name, case number, court
outputs: docket sheets, filed documents
benchmark_note: an access problem rather than a computation
state_of_art: PACER; Bloomberg Law Dockets; Docket Navigator

name: Litigation analytics
definition: Given courts, judges, parties or counsel, summarize historical case outcomes, timings and motion results.
inputs: docket and outcome data, entity of interest
outputs: outcome rates, time-to-ruling statistics, profiles
benchmark_note: outcome prediction can be scored on public docket data such as CourtListener's
state_of_art: Lex Machina; Westlaw Litigation Analytics; Trellis

name: Trademark clearance search
definition: Given a proposed mark and classes, find registered and common-law marks likely to conflict.
inputs: proposed mark, goods and services classes
outputs: ranked conflicting marks, clearance report
benchmark_note: retrieval of known conflicting marks from public registers can be scored
state_of_art: Clarivate CompuMark; Corsearch

name: Court and legal forms retrieval
definition: Given a jurisdiction and filing type, retrieve the current official form and its filing rules.
inputs: jurisdiction, filing type
outputs: current official forms, filing instructions
benchmark_note: currency of a forms library, not a computation
state_of_art: American LegalNet Forms Workflow

name: Public records and party search
definition: Given identifying details about a person or business, retrieve and link public records such as addresses, assets, filings and relatives.
inputs: name and identifiers
outputs: linked person or business report
benchmark_note: record linkage accuracy is measurable on labeled public datasets
state_of_art: LexisNexis Accurint; Thomson Reuters CLEAR; TLOxp

name: Legal matter management and litigation support
definition: Given a firm's or legal department's matters, manage their records, deadlines, documents, time and bills, and process and present evidence in litigation.

name: Matter and case management
definition: Given a legal matter, keep its parties, contacts, events, documents, notes and conflicts in one record and check new matters for conflicts of interest.
inputs: matter intake, parties, documents, events
outputs: matter record, conflict check results, task lists
benchmark_note: procedural records management
state_of_art: Clio; Aderant; Intapp; Filevine

name: Court-rule docketing and deadline calculation
definition: Given a triggering event in a case and the governing court rules, compute every resulting deadline and calendar it.
inputs: trigger event and date, court and case type, rule sets, court holidays
outputs: calculated deadlines with rule citations
benchmark_note: deadlines under published court rules have exact answers for a given trigger
state_of_art: Aderant CompuLaw; LawToolBox; CalendarRules

name: Contract review and clause analysis
definition: Given contracts, extract key terms and obligations, flag deviations from standard positions and track renewals and obligations.
inputs: contract documents, playbook positions
outputs: extracted clauses and terms, deviation flags, obligation calendar
benchmark_note: clause extraction is scored on public datasets such as CUAD and ContractNLI
state_of_art: Ironclad; Icertis; Kira; Luminance

name: Electronic discovery collection and processing
definition: Given custodians' data sources, collect, de-duplicate, extract text and metadata, and index documents for review.
inputs: mailboxes, file shares, device images, custodian list
outputs: processed, de-duplicated and indexed document set; chain of custody
benchmark_note: de-duplication and extraction accuracy on public corpora (for example the Enron email set) is measurable

inputs: service codes, modifiers, locality, fee schedule
outputs: expected allowed amount per line
benchmark_note: the Medicare physician fee schedule (RVUs, geographic indices, conversion factor) gives exact answers.
state_of_art: Optum EncoderPro fee data

name: Medical imaging management and analysis
definition: Given imaging orders and the images acquired for them, schedule and track exams, reconstruct, store, display, analyse and report on medical images across modalities.

name: Imaging exam scheduling and worklists
definition: Given imaging orders, protocol and schedule exams, publish modality worklists and track exam status from arrival to report.
inputs: imaging orders, protocols, modality schedules
outputs: scheduled exams, protocol assignments, modality worklist entries, performed procedure steps
benchmark_note: DICOM worklist conformance is testable and protocol selection from order text can be scored on labeled sets.
state_of_art: Epic Radiant; Sectra RIS

name: Image archiving and exchange
definition: Given images from modalities, store, index, retrieve and share them across sites and readers, including teleradiology.
inputs: DICOM objects, study metadata, routing rules
outputs: archived studies, query/retrieve results, shared studies
benchmark_note: DICOM and IHE conformance is testable; throughput and availability have no shared benchmark.
state_of_art: Sectra PACS; Fujifilm Synapse; GE Centricity PACS

name: Diagnostic image viewing and 3D visualization
definition: Given a study, display it with hanging protocols, measurement tools, multiplanar reformats, volume rendering and fused overlays for reading.
inputs: image series, prior studies, hanging protocols
outputs: rendered views, measurements, key images
benchmark_note: display quality and reading ergonomics are judged by readers.
state_of_art: Sectra IDS7; Visage 7; Philips IntelliSpace Portal

name: Imaging report creation
definition: Given an imaging study and reader findings, produce a structured or narrative report with measurements and recommendations.
inputs: study, reader findings or dictation, report templates, prior reports
outputs: signed report, structured findings, follow-up recommendations
benchmark_note: report generation benchmarks (MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert labels) score clinical findings, though the metrics are contested.
state_of_art: Nuance PowerScribe One; Rad AI Reporting

name: Tomographic image reconstruction
definition: Given raw scanner data (MR k-space, CT sinograms, PET/SPECT counts), reconstruct images and correct motion and artifacts.
inputs: raw acquisition data, scanner geometry, coil sensitivities
outputs: reconstructed image volumes
benchmark_note: fastMRI and the AAPM low-dose CT challenge provide raw data with reference images.
state_of_art: GE AIR Recon DL; Siemens Deep Resolve; Philips SmartSpeed

name: Anatomy and lesion segmentation
definition: Given an image volume, delineate organs, structures and lesions and compute volumes and quantitative measures.
inputs: image volume, target structures
outputs: label masks, volumes, quantitative measures
benchmark_note: Medical Segmentation Decathlon, BraTS and KiTS score masks against expert labels.
state_of_art: Siemens AI-Rad Companion; Brainlab Elements; Circle cvi42
open_tools: nnU-Net; TotalSegmentator; MONAI; 3D Slicer; ITK-SNAP; FreeSurfer

name: Imaging finding detection and classification
definition: Given an image or study, detect and classify findings such as nodules, masses, fractures, hemorrhage or retinopathy.
inputs: images, optional priors and clinical context
outputs: finding locations, classes and probabilities, triage flags
benchmark_note: LUNA16, CBIS-DDSM, the RSNA challenges and CheXpert give labeled test sets.
state_of_art: Lunit INSIGHT; Aidoc; iCAD ProFound AI; IDx-DR

name: Multimodal image registration
definition: Given two or more image volumes (different modalities or times), compute the spatial transform that aligns them for fusion or comparison.
inputs: fixed and moving volumes, optional landmarks or masks
outputs: transform, resampled fused volume
benchmark_note: Learn2Reg challenge datasets score registration with landmarks and overlap.
state_of_art: MIM Maestro; Varian Velocity

name: Physiological signal monitoring and diagnostics
definition: Given recordings of a patient's electrical and physiological signals, monitor them in real time or analyse them to detect events and support a diagnostic interpretation.

name: Resting electrocardiogram interpretation
definition: Given a 12-lead ECG, measure intervals and axes and produce a diagnostic statement.
inputs: 12-lead ECG waveforms, age, sex
outputs: measurements, rhythm and morphology statements
benchmark_note: PTB-XL and the PhysioNet/CinC 2020-2021 challenges give labeled 12-lead ECGs.
state_of_art: GE MUSE with 12SL; Philips DXL algorithm

name: Ambulatory ECG arrhythmia analysis
definition: Given a multi-day ambulatory or telemetry ECG, detect and classify beats and arrhythmia episodes and summarize burden.
inputs: long-term ECG recording
outputs: beat labels, arrhythmia episodes, burden summary
benchmark_note: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database with ANSI/AAMI EC57 evaluation.
state_of_art: iRhythm Zio; Philips Holter Analysis

name: Electroencephalogram review and seizure detection
definition: Given an EEG recording, detect spikes, seizures and other patterns and support the neurophysiologist's report.
inputs: multichannel EEG, video, montage
outputs: event annotations, trends, report
benchmark_note: the TUH EEG Seizure Corpus and CHB-MIT have expert annotations.
state_of_art: Persyst; Natus NeuroWorks

name: Polysomnography sleep staging and event scoring
definition: Given an overnight polysomnogram, stage sleep in epochs and score apneas, hypopneas, arousals and limb movements.
inputs: EEG, EOG, EMG, airflow, effort, oximetry signals
outputs: hypnogram, event list, indices such as apnea-hypopnea index
benchmark_note: Sleep-EDF and SHHS provide AASM-scored recordings.
state_of_art: Compumedics Profusion; Natus SleepWorks; EnsoData EnsoSleep

name: Electromyography and nerve conduction analysis
definition: Given needle EMG and nerve conduction recordings, measure latencies, amplitudes and velocities and characterize motor unit potentials.
inputs: evoked responses, EMG signals, stimulation sites and distances
outputs: conduction measurements, motor unit analysis, interpretation
benchmark_note: measurements can be checked against normative tables; few public annotated recordings.
state_of_art: Natus Synergy; Cadwell Sierra Summit
