name: Evoked potential averaging and peak marking
definition: Given repeated stimulus-locked recordings (auditory brainstem, visual, somatosensory), average them and mark component latencies.
inputs: stimulus-locked EEG epochs, stimulus parameters
outputs: averaged waveform, peak latencies and amplitudes
benchmark_note: peak marking can be compared with expert marks; few public sets.
state_of_art: Natus Bio-logic Navigator Pro; Interacoustics Eclipse

name: Bedside monitoring and alarm management
definition: Given continuous multiparameter vital signs from bedside monitors, display them centrally, raise and route alarms and suppress false ones.
inputs: ECG, SpO2, blood pressure, respiration streams, alarm limits
outputs: central station views, prioritized alarms, alarm notifications
benchmark_note: the PhysioNet/CinC 2015 challenge scores false-alarm reduction on labeled ICU alarms.
state_of_art: Philips IntelliVue; GE CARESCAPE

name: Clinical laboratory and pathology
definition: Given orders for tests on patient specimens, track specimens, capture and verify analyzer results, run quality control and blood-bank logic, and report anatomic, microbiology and genetic findings.

name: Specimen collection and tracking
definition: Given lab orders, generate collection lists and labels, then track each specimen through transport, accessioning and storage.
inputs: orders, patient location, container rules
outputs: collection lists, labels, specimen chain-of-custody events
benchmark_note: logistics workflow.
state_of_art: Epic Beaker; Sunquest Collection Manager

name: Result capture and autoverification
definition: Given analyzer results, capture them through instrument interfaces and apply delta, range and consistency rules to release or hold each result.
inputs: analyzer outputs, reference ranges, prior results, rules
outputs: verified results, held results with reasons
benchmark_note: rules can be scored on historical results with technologist decisions; no public set.
state_of_art: Epic Beaker; Sunquest Laboratory; Data Innovations Instrument Manager

name: Analytical quality control
definition: Given control-material results over time, apply multirule quality control and flag runs to reject.
inputs: control results, target means and standard deviations, rule set
outputs: accept/reject decisions, Levey-Jennings charts, sigma metrics
benchmark_note: Westgard multirule decisions are deterministic for a given control series.
state_of_art: Bio-Rad Unity Real Time

name: Blood bank, transfusion and donor management
definition: Given donors, blood products and recipients, determine donor eligibility, label and track units, and select compatible products for transfusion.
inputs: donor history and tests, unit labels, recipient type and antibody screen
outputs: eligibility decisions, ISBT 128 labels, crossmatch-compatible unit selection, traceability
benchmark_note: ABO/Rh and antigen compatibility logic and ISBT 128 labeling are deterministic; inventory policy is local.
state_of_art: Haemonetics SafeTrace Tx; Haemonetics ElDorado Donor

name: Anatomic pathology case reporting
definition: Given surgical, cytology or autopsy specimens, accession the case, record gross and microscopic findings and issue a synoptic report.
inputs: specimens, clinical history, gross description, microscopic findings
outputs: signed pathology report with synoptic cancer elements
benchmark_note: completeness against CAP cancer protocols is checkable and synoptic extraction from free text can be scored.
state_of_art: Epic Beaker AP; Sunquest CoPathPlus

name: Microscopy and whole-slide image analysis
definition: Given digitized slides or microscope images, detect, count and classify cells and tissue regions, or arrange chromosomes into a karyotype.
inputs: whole-slide or microscope images, stain, task
outputs: region and cell annotations, scores, karyotype
benchmark_note: CAMELYON16/17 and PANDA give labeled slides and leaderboards.
state_of_art: Paige; PathAI; Leica Aperio; Leica CytoVision

name: Microbiology and susceptibility reporting
definition: Given culture workups and antimicrobial susceptibility measurements, identify organisms, interpret susceptibilities against breakpoints and produce reports and antibiograms.
inputs: organism identifications, MIC or zone diameters, breakpoint tables
outputs: susceptible/intermediate/resistant interpretations, cumulative antibiogram
benchmark_note: CLSI and EUCAST breakpoint interpretation is deterministic given MIC values.
state_of_art: Epic Beaker microbiology; bioMérieux VITEK 2 Advanced Expert System

name: Clinical variant interpretation
definition: Given variants found in a patient's genetic test, classify each for pathogenicity under ACMG/AMP criteria and draft the clinical report.
inputs: annotated variant calls, phenotype, family data
outputs: variant classifications with evidence codes, clinical report
benchmark_note: ClinVar expert-panel classifications serve as reference, with known circularity.
state_of_art: Franklin; Varsome; Illumina Emedgene

name: Radiation and procedure planning
definition: Given a patient's images and a treatment goal, plan and verify a radiation, surgical, dental or orthotic intervention specific to that patient.

name: Radiotherapy plan optimization
definition: Given CT images, contoured targets and organs at risk, a prescription and dose constraints, compute beam arrangements and fluences or machine parameters.
inputs: planning CT, structure set, prescription, constraints, machine model
outputs: treatment plan (beams, fluence or MLC sequence), predicted dose
benchmark_note: the OpenKBP challenge and AAPM TG-119 test cases score plans and dose predictions.
state_of_art: Varian Eclipse; RaySearch RayStation; Elekta Monaco

name: Radiotherapy dose calculation
definition: Given a treatment plan and patient density map, compute the absorbed dose distribution for external beams or brachytherapy sources.
inputs: plan, CT densities, beam or source model
outputs: 3D dose grid, monitor units, dose-volume histograms
benchmark_note: Monte Carlo references and AAPM TG-43 consensus brachytherapy data give ground truth.
state_of_art: Varian Acuros XB; RayStation Monte Carlo

name: Patient-specific plan quality assurance
definition: Given a plan and measured or independently calculated dose, compare them and pass or fail the plan before treatment.
inputs: planned dose, measured dose or secondary calculation, tolerance criteria
outputs: gamma pass rates, monitor-unit agreement, pass/fail
benchmark_note: gamma analysis under AAPM TG-218 is deterministic for given dose grids.
state_of_art: Sun Nuclear SNC Patient; PTW VeriSoft

name: Radiotherapy treatment delivery management
definition: Given approved plans, schedule fractions, verify machine parameters at delivery and record delivered dose and imaging.
inputs: approved plans, treatment schedule, machine parameters, setup images
outputs: delivery records, verified parameters, cumulative dose
benchmark_note: record-and-verify is interlock and workflow.
state_of_art: Varian ARIA; Elekta MOSAIQ

name: Virtual surgical planning
definition: Given patient images, build a 3D anatomical model and plan resections, osteotomies, implant positions or stereotactic trajectories.
inputs: CT or MR images, segmented anatomy, implant library
outputs: surgical plan, trajectories, guide specifications
benchmark_note: planned versus achieved positions can be measured post-operatively; few public sets.
state_of_art: Materialise Mimics; Brainlab Elements

name: Image-guided surgical navigation
definition: Given preoperative images and intraoperative tracking, register the patient to the images and show or control instrument position in real time.
inputs: preoperative images, tracker data, fiducials or surface scans
outputs: patient-image registration, live instrument position, robot commands
benchmark_note: target registration error is measurable on phantoms; no shared leaderboard.
state_of_art: Medtronic StealthStation; Brainlab Curve; Stryker Mako

name: Orthodontic and cephalometric planning
definition: Given cephalometric radiographs and dental scans, locate landmarks, compute cephalometric analyses and simulate tooth movement.
inputs: cephalograms, intraoral scans, photographs
outputs: landmarks, cephalometric measures, staged treatment simulation
benchmark_note: the ISBI 2015 cephalometric landmark challenge scores landmark error.
state_of_art: Dolphin Imaging; 3Shape Ortho System; Align ClinCheck

name: Orthotic and prosthetic fitting
definition: Given limb or foot shape and pressure measurements, specify and modify an orthosis or prosthetic socket for the patient.
inputs: 3D limb or foot scans, plantar pressure, clinical measurements
outputs: modified shape and device specification
benchmark_note: fit can be measured with pressure mapping; no public benchmark.
state_of_art: Ohio Willow Wood OMEGA; Rodin4D

name: Psychological and cognitive assessment
definition: Given a person's responses to standardized questionnaires, interviews or computerized tasks, score them against norms and produce a clinical interpretation.

name: Symptom rating scale scoring
definition: Given responses to a brief symptom or screening scale, compute the total and subscale scores and severity band.
inputs: item responses
outputs: scores, severity band, flagged items
benchmark_note: scoring rules are published and deterministic.
state_of_art: Pearson Q-global; NovoPsych

name: Personality and psychopathology inventory interpretation
definition: Given responses to a long normed inventory, compute validity and clinical scale scores against norms and generate an interpretive report.
inputs: item responses, demographics for norm selection
outputs: validity indices, T-scores, profile, interpretive report
benchmark_note: scale scoring is deterministic but norms are proprietary; interpretive text is judged by clinicians.
state_of_art: Pearson Q-global; PAR iConnect

name: Computerized neurocognitive testing
definition: Given a person's performance on timed computerized tasks (attention, memory, executive function, effort), compute normed scores and impairment indices.
inputs: task responses and reaction times, demographics
outputs: normed scores, impairment and validity indices
benchmark_note: scoring against normative tables is deterministic; validity of new batteries requires clinical cohorts.
state_of_art: Cambridge Cognition CANTAB; ImPACT; Cogstate

name: Structured psychiatric diagnostic interview
definition: Given a person's answers in a structured or computer-administered interview, apply diagnostic criteria and return provisional diagnoses.
inputs: interview responses
outputs: criteria met, provisional diagnoses, severity
benchmark_note: agreement with clinician-rated structured interviews can be scored on cohorts; no public leaderboard.
state_of_art: MINI (Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview); SCID-5 clinician version

name: Rehabilitation, hearing, speech and vision
definition: Given measurements of a person's hearing, speech, vision or movement, assess function, fit assistive devices and prescribe and deliver therapy.

name: Hearing and balance assessment
definition: Given responses to calibrated acoustic stimuli and vestibular tests, determine hearing thresholds, speech-in-noise performance and balance function.
inputs: audiometer and test responses, otoacoustic emissions, eye movements during vestibular tests
outputs: audiogram, speech scores, vestibular findings
benchmark_note: automated audiometry can be scored against manual thresholds; no shared public set.
state_of_art: Natus Otometrics OTOsuite; Interacoustics Affinity

name: Hearing aid fitting and verification
definition: Given an audiogram and real-ear measurements, compute prescriptive gain targets and adjust a hearing aid to meet them.
inputs: audiogram, ear acoustics, device model
outputs: gain targets, device settings, verification curves
benchmark_note: NAL-NL2 and DSL v5 give reference targets; the Clarity challenge scores hearing-aid speech processing.
state_of_art: HIMSA Noah with manufacturer modules; Audioscan Verifit

name: Speech, voice and language analysis
definition: Given recordings or transcripts of a person's speech, measure acoustic voice, resonance and articulation features and language-sample metrics.
inputs: audio recordings, transcripts
outputs: acoustic measures (pitch, perturbation, nasalance), language metrics, severity estimates
benchmark_note: dysarthria and voice-disorder corpora (TORGO, Saarbruecken Voice Database) carry labels.
state_of_art: PENTAX Medical Multi-Speech; SALT (Systematic Analysis of Language Transcripts)

name: Speech, language and cognitive therapy and augmentative communication
definition: Given a person's communication or cognitive impairment, deliver graded therapy exercises with feedback, or generate speech from symbols and text for augmentative communication.
inputs: impairment profile, therapy goals, user selections
outputs: exercise sessions with performance logs, synthesized speech output
benchmark_note: word-prediction keystroke savings are measurable; therapy efficacy requires trials.
state_of_art: Tactus Therapy; Tobii Dynavox TD Snap; Proloquo2Go

name: Vision testing and binocular vision therapy
definition: Given a patient's visual responses, measure acuity and binocular function and deliver orthoptic and eye-tracking exercises.
inputs: displayed optotypes and targets, patient responses
outputs: acuity and binocular measures, exercise logs and progress
benchmark_note: computerized acuity can be validated against chart acuity; therapy efficacy requires trials.
state_of_art: HTS Vision; Vivid Vision

name: Gait and movement analysis
definition: Given motion capture, force plate or video recordings of a patient walking or moving, compute kinematics, kinetics and gait parameters.
inputs: marker trajectories or video, force plate data, anthropometrics
outputs: joint angles and moments, spatiotemporal gait parameters, report
benchmark_note: video-based kinematics can be compared with marker-based references on public datasets.
state_of_art: Vicon Nexus; Qualisys Track Manager

name: Therapeutic exercise program prescription
definition: Given a patient's diagnosis and goals, assemble an illustrated home exercise program with dosage and track adherence.
inputs: diagnosis, functional goals, exercise library
outputs: exercise program handout or app plan, adherence log
benchmark_note: program quality is a clinical judgment without reference answers.
state_of_art: Medbridge; Physitrack

name: Functional impairment rating
definition: Given range-of-motion, strength and functional measurements, compute impairment ratings and functional capacity under a rating guide.
inputs: goniometry, dynamometry, functional test results
outputs: impairment percentages, functional capacity report
benchmark_note: the AMA Guides tables make ratings deterministic from measurements.
state_of_art: Cedaron Dexter

name: Nutrition and dietetics
definition: Given what a person eats and their clinical state, analyse nutrient intake, plan therapeutic diets and menus, and document nutrition care.

name: Dietary intake nutrient analysis
definition: Given foods and amounts eaten or in a recipe, compute energy and nutrient totals against reference intakes.
inputs: food records or recipes, food composition database
outputs: nutrient totals, percent of reference intakes
benchmark_note: USDA FoodData Central values give reference totals for defined recipes; Nutrition5k scores image-based estimates.
state_of_art: ESHA Food Processor; Nutrition Data System for Research (NDSR); Nutritics

name: Diet order and menu management
definition: Given patients' diet orders, allergies and preferences, select compliant menu items and produce tray tickets and production counts.
inputs: diet orders, allergies, menu cycle, recipes
outputs: compliant patient menus, tray tickets, production counts
benchmark_note: compliance of menus with diet-order constraints is checkable; acceptability is not.
state_of_art: CBORD; Computrition

name: Therapeutic diet planning
definition: Given a medical indication (ketogenic therapy, food allergy, low-FODMAP, renal), plan meals that meet the diet's quantitative and exclusion constraints.
inputs: indication, nutrient targets and ratios, excluded foods
outputs: meal plans meeting constraints, nutrient breakdown
benchmark_note: ratio and exclusion constraints are checkable; palatability is not.
state_of_art: KetoDietCalculator; Monash FODMAP app

name: Nutrition assessment and care documentation
definition: Given anthropometrics, labs and intake, compute requirements and growth or malnutrition indicators and document the nutrition care process.
inputs: weight, height, age, labs, intake, clinical condition
outputs: energy and protein requirements, z-scores, malnutrition diagnosis, care note
benchmark_note: energy-requirement equations and WHO/CDC growth z-scores are deterministic.
state_of_art: Epic nutrition documentation; Computrition

name: Telehealth and patient engagement
definition: Given patients outside the clinic, deliver care at a distance and let them reach their records, report their own data and receive targeted communication.

name: Synchronous virtual visit
definition: Given a scheduled remote encounter, connect patient and clinician by video or phone with the record, consent and documentation in context.
inputs: appointment, patient device, clinician record context
outputs: completed virtual encounter, documentation, billing trigger
benchmark_note: a communication service; quality is experiential.
state_of_art: Teladoc; Amwell; Epic telehealth

name: Remote patient monitoring
definition: Given readings from home devices (glucose, blood pressure, weight, oximetry), track trends against thresholds and alert the care team.
inputs: device readings, thresholds, care plan
outputs: trend dashboards, alerts, monitoring time logs
benchmark_note: glucose forecasting on the OhioT1DM dataset is benchmarked; alert thresholds are configuration.
state_of_art: Dexcom Clarity; Medtronic CareLink; Biofourmis

name: Store-and-forward specialist consultation
definition: Given images, recordings and a question from a referring clinician, deliver an asynchronous specialist opinion.
inputs: clinical question, images or recordings, patient summary
outputs: specialist recommendation, consult note
benchmark_note: consultation service; quality is clinical judgment.
state_of_art: RubiconMD; AristaMD

name: Patient record access and messaging
definition: Given a patient's record, let the patient view, download and share it, and exchange secure messages with the care team.
inputs: patient record, access credentials, messages
outputs: patient views, downloads, third-party API access, message threads
benchmark_note: access services; only API conformance is testable.
state_of_art: Epic MyChart; athenaPatient

name: Targeted patient reminders and education
definition: Given patients' due care and appointments, send personalized reminders and health education by SMS, voice or app and record responses.
inputs: patient lists, due events, message templates, channel preferences
outputs: sent messages, confirmations, response logs
benchmark_note: effects on no-shows and adherence are measured in trials; message quality is not.
state_of_art: Luma Health; Relatient

name: Patient-reported outcome collection
definition: Given an outcome instrument, administer it to patients (adaptively where calibrated) and score it for clinical use.
inputs: instrument and item bank, patient responses
outputs: scored outcomes, trends over time
benchmark_note: PROMIS item banks with published item parameters give reference adaptive-test scores.
state_of_art: PROMIS computer adaptive tests; Epic MyChart questionnaires

name: Public health and population health
definition: Given data about many people, detect and report disease, analyse and forecast its spread, keep registries, and measure the quality of care populations receive.

name: Notifiable disease case reporting
definition: Given clinical and laboratory data, decide which events are reportable to which jurisdiction and transmit and manage case reports and investigations.
inputs: diagnoses, lab results, jurisdiction rules
outputs: electronic case reports, investigation records, contact lists
benchmark_note: reportability rules give deterministic triggers; completeness on real feeds is local.
state_of_art: APHL AIMS with eCR Now; CDC NBS

name: Outbreak and cluster detection
definition: Given time series or space-time counts of cases or syndromes, detect unusual increases and clusters.
inputs: case or syndrome counts by time and place, population at risk
outputs: alerts, cluster locations, significance
benchmark_note: simulated outbreaks injected into baseline data give known ground truth.
state_of_art: CDC ESSENCE; SaTScan

name: Descriptive and analytic epidemiology
definition: Given surveillance or study data, compute rates, standardized ratios, measures of association and life tables for a population.
inputs: case and population counts, exposures, follow-up
outputs: rates, standardized ratios, odds and risk ratios, life tables
benchmark_note: rate and ratio calculations have exact answers; study design choices do not.
state_of_art: CDC Epi Info; CDC WONDER

name: Epidemic transmission modeling and forecasting
definition: Given case, hospitalization and mobility data, estimate transmission parameters and forecast cases or burden.
inputs: incidence time series, serial interval, covariates
outputs: reproduction number estimates, probabilistic forecasts, scenarios
benchmark_note: CDC FluSight and the COVID-19 Forecast Hub score probabilistic forecasts against observed data.
state_of_art: CDC FluSight ensemble; IHME models

name: Immunization registry and forecasting
definition: Given a person's immunization history, consolidate it across providers and compute which vaccines are due or overdue.
inputs: immunization records, birth date, risk conditions, schedule rules
outputs: consolidated history, vaccine forecast, registry submissions
benchmark_note: CDC Clinical Decision Support for Immunization test cases give expected forecasts.
state_of_art: STC IIS; Envision WebIZ

name: Disease and cancer registry abstraction
definition: Given patient records, identify reportable cases and abstract standardized registry items for a disease, trauma or cancer registry.
inputs: pathology reports, clinical records, registry data standards
outputs: abstracted registry records, edit results, submissions
benchmark_note: NAACCR edits give deterministic validity checks; abstraction accuracy needs re-abstraction audits.
state_of_art: Elekta METRIQ; ERS C/NET

name: Clinical quality and safety measurement
definition: Given patient-level data, compute quality measures and track patient-safety events and experience for a population of patients.
inputs: patient data, measure specifications, incident and survey reports
outputs: measure numerators, denominators and rates, safety event analyses
benchmark_note: Cypress test decks give expected results for each electronic clinical quality measure.
state_of_art: Epic Healthy Planet; Medisolv; Press Ganey

name: Cause-of-death coding
definition: Given the causes written on a death certificate, code them to ICD-10 and select the underlying cause of death.
inputs: death certificate cause-of-death text
outputs: multiple-cause codes, underlying cause
benchmark_note: ICD-10 selection rules applied by NCHS give reference underlying causes.
state_of_art: Iris; NCHS MedCoder and ACME

name: Clinical trials and research data
definition: Given a study protocol and participants, capture and standardize study data, run trial operations, code and monitor safety, and analyse real-world clinical data.

name: Electronic case report form data capture
definition: Given a protocol's data collection plan, build electronic case report forms, capture site data with edit checks and manage queries.
inputs: protocol, form definitions, site entries
outputs: validated study database, query log, audit trail
benchmark_note: data capture service; only CDISC ODM conformance is testable.
state_of_art: Medidata Rave; Veeva Vault EDC; Oracle Clinical One

name: Clinical trial operations management
definition: Given a portfolio of studies, track sites, enrollment, monitoring visits, budgets and payments.
inputs: studies, sites, enrollment events, budgets
outputs: enrollment and milestone tracking, monitoring reports, site payments
benchmark_note: operational workflow.
state_of_art: Veeva Vault CTMS; Advarra OnCore

name: Randomization and trial supply
definition: Given a randomization design, allocate participants to arms with stratification and blinding and manage study drug supply to sites.
inputs: design (blocks, strata), participant strata, site inventories
outputs: allocations, blinded kit assignments, resupply orders
benchmark_note: balance and predictability of an allocation scheme are computable.
state_of_art: Medidata Rave RTSM; Suvoda

name: Study data standardization
definition: Given collected study data, map it to submission standards and produce analysis datasets and metadata.
inputs: raw study data, protocol, controlled terminology
outputs: SDTM and ADaM datasets, Define-XML, conformance report
benchmark_note: CDISC conformance rules are deterministic; mapping correctness needs reviewed examples.
state_of_art: SAS Clinical Data Integration; Pinnacle 21 Enterprise

name: Adverse event and drug term coding
definition: Given verbatim adverse event and medication terms, code them to MedDRA and WHODrug.
inputs: verbatim terms, dictionary versions
outputs: coded terms at each hierarchy level
benchmark_note: shared tasks (SMM4H, CADEC) give gold normalizations, but MedDRA licensing limits open sets.
state_of_art: Medidata Rave Coder; Oracle Central Coding

name: Pharmacovigilance signal detection
definition: Given spontaneous adverse event reports or observational data, detect disproportionate drug-event associations.
inputs: adverse event report database, drug and event codes
outputs: disproportionality statistics, ranked signals
benchmark_note: OMOP and EU-ADR reference sets of known positive and negative drug-event pairs.
state_of_art: Oracle Empirica Signal; Oracle Argus Safety

name: Observational real-world evidence analysis
definition: Given EHR or claims data in a common data model, define cohorts and estimate incidence, characterization and comparative effects.
inputs: patient-level data in a common data model, cohort definitions
outputs: cohort characteristics, incidence rates, effect estimates with diagnostics
benchmark_note: OHDSI method-evaluation benchmarks with negative and synthetic positive controls.
state_of_art: Aetion; TriNetX

name: Patient-trial eligibility matching
definition: Given patient records and trial eligibility criteria, find eligible patients for a trial or trials for a patient.
inputs: patient records, eligibility criteria text
outputs: ranked matches with criterion-level evidence
benchmark_note: TREC Clinical Trials tracks and n2c2 2018 cohort selection give judged test sets.
state_of_art: TriNetX; Tempus TIME

name: Health data exchange and terminology
definition: Given clinical data in one system's form, translate, code, de-identify and exchange it so that another system or organization can use it.

name: Clinical message translation and routing
definition: Given clinical messages and resources (HL7 v2, FHIR, proprietary), validate, transform and route them between systems.
inputs: inbound messages, mapping specifications, routing rules
outputs: transformed and routed messages, error queues
benchmark_note: HL7 and FHIR validators give pass/fail conformance; mapping semantics need reviewed examples.
state_of_art: InterSystems Health Connect; Rhapsody; Infor Cloverleaf

name: Care summary document exchange
definition: Given a patient record, generate a standard care summary (C-CDA, International Patient Summary) and exchange or query it across organizations.
inputs: patient record, recipient, exchange network
outputs: conformant summary document, exchange transactions
benchmark_note: ONC C-CDA and FHIR validators give conformance pass/fail.
state_of_art: Epic Care Everywhere; CommonWell; Carequality

name: Clinical terminology mapping
definition: Given local codes or terms, map them to standard terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD) and across them.
inputs: local code lists with descriptions, target terminology
outputs: mappings with equivalence and confidence
benchmark_note: published crossmaps (SNOMED CT to ICD-10-CM) and the UMLS serve as gold standards.
state_of_art: Intelligent Medical Objects; Wolters Kluwer Health Language

name: Clinical record de-identification
definition: Given clinical notes, structured data or images, detect and remove or replace protected health information.
inputs: notes, structured records, DICOM headers and pixel data
outputs: de-identified data, PHI annotations
benchmark_note: the i2b2 2006 and 2014 de-identification shared tasks provide annotated PHI.
state_of_art: John Snow Labs de-identification; Amazon Comprehend Medical

name: Teach, learn and keep knowledge
definition: Education and the stewardship of knowledge: delivering and managing instruction, assessing learners, administering schools, authoring training, and running libraries and reference services.

name: Learning management and course delivery
definition: Given courses, enrolled learners and learning content, deliver the content, track participation and progress, and record results.

name: Packaged course content playback
definition: Given a content package and an enrolled learner, launch and sequence the package and record completion, time and score.
inputs: content package (SCORM, Common Cartridge, cmi5), learner enrollment
outputs: rendered lessons, completion status, scores, time on task
benchmark_note: conformance test suites exist for SCORM and Common Cartridge, but nothing scores delivery quality
state_of_art: Instructure Canvas; D2L Brightspace; Blackboard Learn; Cornerstone Learning
open_tools: Moodle; Sakai; Open edX; ILIAS; Chamilo

name: External learning tool launch
definition: Given a course context and an external learning tool, launch the tool with the user's identity and role and return its grades to the course.
inputs: course and user context, tool registration, signed launch request
outputs: authenticated tool session, grade and roster passback
benchmark_note: 1EdTech certification tests check protocol conformance only
state_of_art: Instructure Canvas; D2L Brightspace; Blackboard Learn

name: Course gradebook calculation
definition: Given assignment scores, category weights, drop rules and a grading scheme, compute running and final course grades.
inputs: scores, weights, late and drop policies, grading scale
outputs: per-student course grades and grade reports
benchmark_note: deterministic arithmetic under local rules; only correctness against the rules can be tested
state_of_art: Instructure Canvas; PowerSchool Schoology Learning

name: Course discussion and question answering
definition: Given course members and course materials, host threaded discussion and questions, with answers endorsed by instructors.
inputs: course roster, posts, course materials
outputs: threaded discussions, endorsed answers, participation records
benchmark_note: automatic answering of course questions could be scored against instructor answers; no public benchmark is standard
state_of_art: Piazza; Ed Discussion

name: Lecture capture and video lessons
definition: Given recorded lectures, publish them with synchronized slides, captions, in-video search and viewing analytics.
inputs: lecture audio, video and slides
outputs: searchable captioned video, viewing statistics
benchmark_note: caption word error rate and slide-text search are measurable; teaching value is not
state_of_art: Panopto; Kaltura; YuJa

name: Required training assignment and tracking
definition: Given job roles, regulatory training requirements and completion records, assign required courses, track due dates and expiring certifications, and report compliance.
inputs: employee roles, training requirements, course catalog, completion records
outputs: assignments, overdue and expiry alerts, compliance reports
benchmark_note: rule-driven record keeping; correctness is conformance to the organization's rules
state_of_art: Cornerstone Learning; SAP SuccessFactors Learning; Workday Learning

name: Learning activity records and analytics
definition: Given streams of learner activity statements, store them and compute engagement measures and predictions such as course completion.
inputs: activity statements (actor, verb, object, result), course structure
outputs: learning record store, engagement dashboards, completion predictions
benchmark_note: completion and outcome prediction on public data such as the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset and KDD Cup 2015 MOOC dropout data
state_of_art: Watershed; Instructure Canvas Data

name: Live classroom interaction
definition: Given a teacher-led session and learners' devices, present activities, collect responses and student work in real time, and show results.

name: Live polling and quiz games
definition: Given a set of questions, collect answers from learners' devices during a session and display aggregated results or a leaderboard.
inputs: questions, live participants
outputs: per-question response distributions, scores, leaderboard
benchmark_note: response collection; there is no computed answer to score
state_of_art: Kahoot!; Mentimeter; Poll Everywhere; iClicker; Slido

name: Teacher-paced interactive lessons
definition: Given slides with embedded questions and activities, push each slide to students' devices in step with the teacher and collect responses per slide.
inputs: slide deck with embedded activities, student roster
outputs: synchronized lesson, per-slide student responses
benchmark_note: delivery and collection only
state_of_art: Nearpod; Pear Deck

name: Interactive video lessons
definition: Given a video and questions placed at timestamps, play it to learners, pause for the questions, and record answers and viewing completion.
inputs: video, timed questions
outputs: learner answers, viewing completion
benchmark_note: delivery task; generating the questions belongs to test item authoring
state_of_art: Edpuzzle; PlayPosit

name: Student work portfolios
definition: Given student work captured as photos, video, audio or text, organize it into per-student portfolios with teacher feedback and share it with families.
inputs: student artifacts, rubrics or comments
outputs: per-student portfolios, feedback, family-visible journal
benchmark_note: record keeping and sharing
state_of_art: Seesaw; Flip

name: Instructional design and courseware authoring
definition: Given learning goals, standards and source content, design a course and produce reusable, packaged learning content.

name: Curriculum mapping and standards alignment
definition: Given learning standards and a course's units, lessons and assessments, align each to the standards it addresses and report coverage and gaps.
inputs: standards frameworks, course units, lessons, assessments
outputs: curriculum map, alignment links, coverage report
benchmark_note: automatic alignment of items or lessons to standards can be scored against expert-labelled alignments; whole-course design cannot
state_of_art: Atlas Curriculum Mapping; Common Curriculum

name: Interactive e-learning module authoring
definition: Given content, interactions and quiz items, produce a self-paced module with navigation, branching and tracking, published as a standard package.
inputs: text, media, interaction templates, quiz items
outputs: SCORM, xAPI or HTML5 package
benchmark_note: output quality is a pedagogical judgment; only package conformance is testable
state_of_art: Articulate Storyline; Adobe Captivate; Lectora; Elucidat

name: Software demonstration and simulation capture
definition: Given recorded screen actions in an application, produce step-by-step demonstrations and practice simulations that check the learner's clicks and entries.
inputs: screen recording, captured actions
outputs: watch, try and test simulations
benchmark_note: authoring task without a reference output
state_of_art: Adobe Captivate; TechSmith Camtasia; Articulate Storyline

name: Learning content management and reuse
definition: Given learning objects with metadata, store, version and search them and assemble them into courses and multiple output formats.
inputs: learning objects, metadata, templates
outputs: content repository, assembled courses, multi-format outputs
benchmark_note: metadata generation and search over learning objects can be scored on labelled repositories; no standard leaderboard
state_of_art: Xyleme; dominKnow ONE

name: Assessment, testing and academic integrity
definition: Given test content and learner responses, build and deliver assessments, score them, estimate ability and check the integrity of the work.

name: Test item authoring and banking
definition: Given content standards and source material, write, review, tag and store test items with their statistics, exchanged in a standard item format.
inputs: standards, source passages, item templates
outputs: reviewed, tagged items with statistics; QTI exports
benchmark_note: automatic question and distractor generation is scored on datasets such as SQuAD-derived question generation and RACE, with weak metrics
state_of_art: Questionmark; Learnosity; ExamSoft

name: Secure test delivery and proctoring
definition: Given a test form and candidates, deliver a timed test in a locked-down environment, monitor for misconduct and record responses.
inputs: test form, candidate list, timing and accommodation rules
outputs: response records, misconduct flags, session logs
benchmark_note: misconduct detection from video and keystrokes could be scored on labelled sessions; few public datasets exist
state_of_art: Pearson VUE; Respondus LockDown Browser; ProctorU

name: Computerized adaptive testing
definition: Given a calibrated item bank and a test blueprint, select items one at a time to estimate the examinee's ability to a target precision.
inputs: calibrated item bank, blueprint constraints, responses
outputs: ability estimate with standard error, administered item sequence
benchmark_note: simulation against known true abilities gives exact accuracy, efficiency and item-exposure measures
state_of_art: NWEA MAP Growth; Renaissance Star Assessments

name: Item analysis and test calibration
definition: Given scored response matrices, estimate item parameters, reliability, score equating and differential item functioning.
inputs: scored response matrix, examinee groups
outputs: item parameters, reliability, equating tables, bias flags
benchmark_note: parameter recovery on simulated data with known parameters
state_of_art: Winsteps; flexMIRT; IRTPRO

name: Answer sheet scanning and scoring
definition: Given scanned answer sheets and a key, read the filled marks and score each sheet.
inputs: scanned bubble sheets, answer key
outputs: read responses, scores, item statistics
benchmark_note: mark-reading accuracy against sheets with known marks
state_of_art: Scantron; Remark Office OMR; ZipGrade

name: Automated essay and short-answer scoring
definition: Given written responses and a rubric or reference answers, predict the scores human raters would assign and give feedback.
inputs: student responses, rubric, scored training responses
outputs: predicted scores, trait feedback
benchmark_note: the Hewlett ASAP essay and short-answer datasets (quadratic weighted kappa) and SemEval-2013 Task 7
state_of_art: ETS e-rater; Pearson Intelligent Essay Assessor; Gradescope

name: Text similarity and plagiarism detection
definition: Given a submitted document and a corpus of sources and prior submissions, find copied or paraphrased passages and report their sources.
inputs: submitted text or code, reference corpus
outputs: matched passages with sources, similarity score
benchmark_note: PAN shared tasks on text reuse and plagiarism detection provide corpora and scores
state_of_art: Turnitin; iThenticate; Copyleaks

name: Screening and progress monitoring
definition: Given short timed probes repeated over time, score them and track each student's growth against norms and goals.
inputs: probe responses or recordings, norms, goals
outputs: scores, growth charts, risk flags
benchmark_note: automatic scoring of oral reading fluency from audio can be checked against human words-correct-per-minute counts
state_of_art: Amplify mCLASS DIBELS 8; FastBridge; aimswebPlus

name: Student information and school administration
definition: Given students, staff, courses and institutional rules, keep official student records and run enrollment, scheduling, grading, aid and reporting.

name: Enrollment, attendance and student records
definition: Given applications, registrations and daily attendance, maintain each student's demographic, enrollment, program and attendance record and roster students to classes.
inputs: applications, registration data, attendance marks
outputs: student records, class rosters, attendance rates and absence flags
benchmark_note: record keeping whose correctness is conformance to data standards
state_of_art: PowerSchool SIS; Infinite Campus; Ellucian Banner; Workday Student

name: Course timetabling
definition: Given course requests, teachers, rooms and periods, build a master schedule and student timetables that minimize conflicts.
inputs: course requests, staff and room availability, constraints
outputs: master schedule, student and teacher timetables, conflict report
benchmark_note: International Timetabling Competition instances (2007, 2019) with scored solutions
state_of_art: PowerScheduler; aSc Timetables; Infosilem

name: Grade reporting and transcripts
definition: Given final course grades and credit rules, compute grade point averages and class rank and produce report cards and official transcripts.
inputs: course grades, credit values, grading scales
outputs: report cards, transcripts, electronic transcript exchange
benchmark_note: deterministic computation under local rules
state_of_art: PowerSchool SIS; Parchment

name: Degree audit and transfer credit evaluation
definition: Given program requirements, a student's completed courses and incoming transfer work, determine which requirements are met and which course equivalencies apply.
inputs: program rules, academic history, transfer transcripts, equivalency tables
outputs: audit report, remaining requirements, equivalency decisions
benchmark_note: rule evaluation can be checked against registrar decisions; matching course descriptions for equivalency can be scored on labelled pairs
state_of_art: Ellucian Degree Works; uAchieve

name: Student financial aid packaging
definition: Given cost of attendance, need analysis results and fund rules, compute each student's aid package and track disbursement.
inputs: need analysis records, cost of attendance, fund rules and budgets
outputs: award packages, award letters, disbursement schedules
benchmark_note: rule computation under regulation
state_of_art: Ellucian Banner Financial Aid; College Board PowerFAIDS

name: Early warning of dropout
definition: Given attendance, behavior and course-performance histories, predict which students are at risk of failing or leaving and flag them for support.
inputs: attendance, discipline and grade histories
outputs: risk scores and flags
benchmark_note: dropout and failure prediction on public data such as the UCI Student Performance dataset, scored by AUC
state_of_art: EAB Navigate; PowerSchool Unified Insights

name: Advising and tutoring visit tracking
definition: Given student appointments and walk-in visits to advising, tutoring and counseling services, schedule them, record notes and report usage.
inputs: appointment requests, staff availability, visit notes
outputs: schedules, visit records, usage reports
benchmark_note: scheduling and record keeping
state_of_art: EAB Navigate; TutorTrac

name: Education data reporting and exchange
definition: Given local student, staff and assessment records, validate them and submit them to state and federal systems in standard formats.
inputs: local records, reporting specifications
outputs: validated submissions, error reports
benchmark_note: conformance to Ed-Fi or Common Education Data Standards schemas is testable
state_of_art: PowerSchool SIS; Infinite Campus

name: Special education planning
definition: Given evaluations of a student with a disability, plan, document and monitor individualized instruction and services under special education law.

name: Individualized education program management
definition: Given evaluation results, eligibility and present levels of performance, draft goals, services and accommodations and track meeting and compliance deadlines.
inputs: evaluations, eligibility determination, present levels, service options
outputs: individualized education program document, service schedule, compliance alerts
benchmark_note: goal measurability and compliance checks could be scored against expert review; no public dataset
state_of_art: PowerSchool Special Programs; Frontline IEP

name: Tiered intervention tracking
definition: Given screening results, assign tiered interventions, log intervention sessions and graph progress against goals.
inputs: screening scores, intervention catalog, session logs
outputs: intervention plans, progress graphs, decision flags
benchmark_note: plan and record keeping
state_of_art: Branching Minds; Panorama Education

name: Classroom behavior observation recording
definition: Given an observation protocol, record time-sampled or event behaviors and compute behavior rates and inter-observer agreement.
inputs: observation codes, sampling scheme
outputs: behavior rates, agreement statistics, graphs
benchmark_note: automated behavior coding from video can be scored against human coders
state_of_art: Catalyst; Rethink Ed

name: Assistive reading and writing technology
definition: Given text or an interface that a person with a disability cannot use in its usual form, convert it to an accessible form or reduce the effort of producing text.

name: Text-to-speech reading support
definition: Given digital or scanned text, read it aloud with synchronized highlighting and study aids.
inputs: documents, web pages or scanned pages
outputs: synthesized speech with word highlighting, annotations
benchmark_note: speech quality is rated by listeners (mean opinion score) and recognition of scanned pages by character error rate
state_of_art: Kurzweil 3000; Texthelp Read&Write; NaturalReader

name: Screen reading
definition: Given a running user interface, convert on-screen content and focus changes into speech or braille with keyboard navigation.
inputs: accessibility tree of the running interface
outputs: speech and braille output, navigation commands
benchmark_note: conformance to accessibility interfaces is testable; navigation efficiency needs user studies
state_of_art: JAWS; Apple VoiceOver; ZoomText

name: Screen magnification
definition: Given the screen image and focus, magnify and re-color the region of interest and track the pointer and caret.
inputs: screen image, focus events
outputs: magnified, contrast-adjusted view
benchmark_note: display transformation without a reference output
state_of_art: ZoomText; Dolphin SuperNova

name: Braille translation
definition: Given print text and a braille code, produce contracted braille formatted for embossing or a refreshable display.
inputs: print text or documents, braille code and formatting rules
outputs: formatted braille files
benchmark_note: output can be compared with reference transcriptions; liblouis maintains expected-output test suites
state_of_art: Duxbury Braille Translator

name: Word prediction for writing
definition: Given partially typed text, propose the next words or corrections to reduce keystrokes and spelling errors.
inputs: typed context, user vocabulary
outputs: ranked word suggestions
benchmark_note: keystroke savings on held-out text
state_of_art: Co:Writer; WordQ

name: Symbol-supported communication boards
definition: Given vocabulary and a symbol set, produce picture-symbol communication boards and visual schedules.
inputs: vocabulary, symbol library, layout
outputs: printable or on-screen symbol boards
benchmark_note: design of materials without a reference output
state_of_art: Boardmaker

name: Tutoring and adaptive practice
definition: Given a learner's responses over time, model what they know and choose, check and explain the next practice so they learn.

name: Learner knowledge tracing
definition: Given a learner's sequence of attempts on skill-tagged items, estimate mastery of each skill and predict correctness on the next attempt.
inputs: attempt logs with item-skill mapping
outputs: per-skill mastery estimates, next-response predictions
benchmark_note: ASSISTments, EdNet and KDD Cup 2010 datasets with AUC leaderboards
state_of_art: ALEKS; Carnegie Learning MATHia

name: Drill-and-practice exercises
definition: Given a skill area and the learner's level, present practice items, score answers and adjust difficulty.
inputs: item pool, learner level
outputs: practice sequence, scores, mastery report
benchmark_note: difficulty calibration can be scored by prediction of learner accuracy; learning gains need trials
state_of_art: IXL; Khan Academy; Prodigy

name: Step-based intelligent tutoring
definition: Given a multi-step problem and the learner's steps, check each step and give hints and error-specific feedback.
inputs: problem, solution model, learner steps
outputs: step correctness, hints, feedback
benchmark_note: step checking and hint quality can be scored on tutoring datasets such as MathDial; learning gains need trials
state_of_art: Carnegie Learning MATHia; ASSISTments

name: Conversational tutoring
definition: Given a learner's question and course context, conduct a dialogue that guides the learner to the answer without giving it away.
inputs: learner utterances, course materials, problem
outputs: tutor turns
benchmark_note: the BEA 2025 shared task and MathDial score tutor responses on pedagogical criteria
state_of_art: Khanmigo

name: Spaced-repetition review scheduling
definition: Given flashcards and each learner's review history, schedule the next review of each card to maximize long-term retention.
inputs: cards, review log with outcomes
outputs: review schedule, recall-probability estimates
benchmark_note: recall prediction on public review logs, such as the open spaced-repetition benchmark and Duolingo's half-life regression data
state_of_art: Quizlet; Anki; SuperMemo

name: Computer-assisted language learning
definition: Given a learner's spoken or written production in a target language, score it, correct errors and select the next exercise.
inputs: learner speech or text, target-language curriculum
outputs: corrections, pronunciation scores, exercise sequence
benchmark_note: grammatical error correction (BEA-2019 shared task) and pronunciation scoring (speechocean762) have public leaderboards
state_of_art: Duolingo; Rosetta Stone; Babbel

name: Reading and foundational skills practice
definition: Given a learner reading aloud or completing phonics and comprehension exercises, detect errors and adapt the practice.
inputs: learner audio or responses, leveled texts
outputs: error reports, fluency measures, next texts
benchmark_note: oral reading miscue detection can be scored against annotated recordings
state_of_art: Amira Learning; Lexia Core5

name: Simulation-based training
definition: Given a model of a task environment and a training scenario, let learners practice in the simulation and score their performance.

name: Vehicle operator simulator training
definition: Given a vehicle model, an environment and a training scenario, run the simulator and score the operator's control and decisions.
inputs: vehicle dynamics model, scenario, trainee inputs
outputs: performance scores, event logs, replay
benchmark_note: scenario scoring is defined per curriculum; no cross-simulator benchmark exists
state_of_art: CAE flight simulators; Doron driving simulators

name: Virtual laboratories
definition: Given a modeled experiment, let learners set variables, run trials and observe simulated results as they would in a real laboratory.
inputs: experiment model, learner choices
outputs: simulated observations, lab records
benchmark_note: fidelity is judged per experiment and learning effect needs trials
state_of_art: Labster; PhET Interactive Simulations; ExploreLearning Gizmos

name: Classroom market and economics games
definition: Given a market or game design, run it with students as traders or players and report outcomes against theory.
inputs: game or market rules, participants
outputs: trades, payoffs, outcome charts
benchmark_note: classroom activity; there is no reference answer
state_of_art: MobLab; Veconlab

name: Threat image projection training
definition: Given screening images and a library of threat images, inject fictional threats into live screening and score whether operators detect them.
inputs: baggage images, threat image library, operator responses
outputs: detection and false-alarm rates per operator
benchmark_note: operator detection rates are scored; automated detection has public X-ray datasets such as SIXray and GDXray
state_of_art: Smiths Detection TIP; X-Ray Tutor

name: Branching scenario role-play
definition: Given a decision tree of situations, present choices and consequences to the learner and score and debrief the path taken.
inputs: scenario graph, scoring rules
outputs: learner path, score, debrief
benchmark_note: authored content without a reference output
state_of_art: BranchTrack; Articulate Storyline

name: Immersive procedural skills training
definition: Given three-dimensional models of equipment and a procedure, train the procedure's steps in virtual or augmented reality and track errors.
inputs: equipment models, procedure steps, trainee actions
outputs: step errors, completion time, proficiency record
benchmark_note: metrics are specific to each procedure
state_of_art: Strivr; Osso VR

name: Library management and cataloging
definition: Given a library's holdings, patrons and suppliers, describe the holdings, make them findable, and run acquisitions, circulation and resource sharing.

name: Bibliographic cataloging
definition: Given an item, create or copy a bibliographic record with description and access points that conforms to the cataloging rules.
inputs: item or its metadata, cataloging rules, shared catalog records
outputs: bibliographic record in MARC 21 or BIBFRAME
benchmark_note: automatic metadata extraction from title pages or e-books can be scored against existing records
state_of_art: OCLC Record Manager; Ex Libris Alma

name: Subject indexing and classification
definition: Given a document, assign subject headings and a classification number from a controlled vocabulary.
inputs: document text or metadata, vocabulary or classification scheme
outputs: subject headings, class numbers
benchmark_note: SemEval-2025 Task 5 (subject tagging with library vocabularies) and BioASQ semantic indexing with MeSH have leaderboards
state_of_art: Finto AI; Library of Congress Classification Web

name: Authority control and name reconciliation
definition: Given name and subject headings in records, match them to authority records and normalize the headings.
inputs: headings in bibliographic records, authority files
outputs: linked and corrected headings, new authority records
benchmark_note: entity matching can be scored against gold links between authority files; no standing leaderboard
state_of_art: OCLC; Backstage Library Works

name: Circulation and patron management
definition: Given patrons, items and loan rules, process checkouts, returns, holds, renewals, fines and notices, including self-service machines.
inputs: patron records, item records, loan policies
outputs: loan transactions, holds queues, notices, fines
benchmark_note: rule-driven transaction processing
state_of_art: Ex Libris Alma; Innovative Sierra; SirsiDynix Symphony; Polaris

name: Acquisitions and serials control
definition: Given selection decisions, budgets and vendor data, order and receive materials, predict and check in serial issues, claim missing issues and prepare binding.
inputs: orders, fund budgets, vendor catalogs, publication patterns
outputs: purchase orders, receipts, serial check-in records, claims, invoices
benchmark_note: serial issue prediction from publication patterns is checkable; the rest is transaction processing
state_of_art: Ex Libris Alma; Innovative Sierra

name: Interlibrary loan and resource sharing
definition: Given a patron request for an item the library lacks, find libraries that hold it, route the request and track lending and delivery.
inputs: patron request, union catalog holdings, lending policies
outputs: routed requests, delivery and return tracking
benchmark_note: workflow and messaging between libraries
state_of_art: OCLC Tipasa; OCLC ILLiad; Ex Libris Rapido

name: Electronic resource management and link resolution
definition: Given licenses, a knowledge base of electronic holdings and a citation, track entitlements, resolve the citation to full text and report usage.
inputs: licenses, holdings knowledge base, citation or OpenURL, usage reports
outputs: full-text links, entitlement records, usage statistics
benchmark_note: link-resolution accuracy can be scored against known holdings
state_of_art: Ex Libris SFX; EBSCO Full Text Finder

name: Library catalog discovery
definition: Given a patron's query, search the catalog and article indexes and return ranked holdings with facets and availability.
inputs: query, catalog and article index, availability data
outputs: ranked results with facets and availability
benchmark_note: relevance can be scored with judged queries, but no public library-catalog test collection is standard
state_of_art: Ex Libris Primo; EBSCO Discovery Service; BiblioCommons

name: Archives and museum collections
definition: Given archival records, museum objects and digital materials, describe, preserve and publish them and help people find them.

name: Archival arrangement and description
definition: Given an accession of records, arrange it in a hierarchy and write a finding aid that conforms to descriptive standards.
inputs: accession records, folder lists, creator information
outputs: finding aids in EAD, collection-level records
benchmark_note: generated descriptions could be scored against archivist-written ones; no public benchmark
state_of_art: ArchivesSpace; Axiell Collections

name: Museum collections management
definition: Given the objects in a collection, record their descriptions, locations, condition, rights, loans and exhibitions.
inputs: object records, location moves, condition reports, loan agreements
outputs: catalog of objects, movement history, loan and exhibition records
benchmark_note: record keeping
state_of_art: Gallery Systems TMS; Axiell EMu; PastPerfect

name: Digital preservation
definition: Given digital objects, ingest them into an archival store, identify and validate formats, check fixity, migrate at-risk formats and record preservation metadata.
inputs: digital files, submission agreements
outputs: archival information packages, preservation metadata, fixity reports
benchmark_note: format identification and validation can be scored on corpora such as Govdocs1
state_of_art: Preservica; Ex Libris Rosetta

name: Digital collection publishing
definition: Given digitized items and their metadata, host searchable online collections with image delivery and metadata harvesting.
inputs: digitized images and files, descriptive metadata
outputs: online collection site, image service, harvestable metadata
benchmark_note: hosting and publishing
state_of_art: OCLC CONTENTdm; Quartex

name: Web archiving
definition: Given seed addresses and scope rules, crawl and capture websites into archive files and replay them as they were.
inputs: seed URLs, scope and frequency rules
outputs: WARC files, replayable captures
benchmark_note: capture completeness can be measured by comparing replay with the live page
state_of_art: Archive-It; Webrecorder

name: Historical document transcription
definition: Given scanned manuscripts or historical printed pages, segment the layout and transcribe the text.
inputs: page images
outputs: transcribed text with layout
benchmark_note: ICDAR handwritten text recognition competitions give character error rates on public historical collections
state_of_art: Transkribus

name: Archival and union catalog discovery
definition: Given a research topic, search finding aids and collection records across many repositories and return the collections likely to hold relevant material.
inputs: query, aggregated finding aids and collection records
outputs: ranked collections and repositories
benchmark_note: retrieval over finding aids could be scored with judged queries; no standard test collection
state_of_art: ArchiveGrid; Archives Portal Europe

name: Scholarly search, reference works and dictionaries
definition: Given a research question, find, screen, cite and measure the scholarly and reference literature.

name: Bibliographic database search
definition: Given a research question, search abstracting and indexing databases with controlled vocabulary and return relevant citations.
inputs: query, database selection, vocabulary terms
outputs: ranked citations with abstracts and links
benchmark_note: TREC test collections such as TREC-COVID and TREC Genomics score scholarly retrieval
state_of_art: Web of Science; Scopus; PubMed; Google Scholar

name: Literature screening for systematic reviews
definition: Given search results and inclusion criteria, rank or classify citations for inclusion so reviewers screen fewer records.
inputs: citations with abstracts, inclusion criteria, reviewer decisions
outputs: ranked or labelled citations, recall estimates
benchmark_note: CLEF eHealth technology-assisted review tasks and the SYNERGY dataset
state_of_art: Covidence; DistillerSR; Rayyan

name: Citation analysis and bibliometrics
definition: Given a set of publications and their citation links, compute citation counts, impact indicators and maps of research fields.
inputs: publication records, citation links
outputs: indicators, rankings, co-citation and co-authorship maps
benchmark_note: author-name disambiguation and citation classification have public benchmarks; the indicators themselves are definitional
state_of_art: Clarivate InCites; Elsevier SciVal; Dimensions

name: Reference management and citation formatting
definition: Given citations gathered from databases and documents, store and deduplicate them and format citations and bibliographies in a chosen style.
inputs: citation records, PDFs, citation style
outputs: reference library, formatted in-text citations and bibliographies
benchmark_note: metadata extraction from PDFs and citation-string parsing are scored against gold metadata (GROBID evaluations, the CORA citation set)
state_of_art: EndNote; Zotero; Mendeley

name: Reference work lookup
definition: Given a topic or term, retrieve authoritative entries from encyclopedias, handbooks and directories.
inputs: query
outputs: reference entries
benchmark_note: open-domain question answering over reference works (Natural Questions over Wikipedia) is scored
state_of_art: Oxford Reference; Britannica

name: Full-text corpora for humanities research
definition: Given a curated corpus of texts, support concordance, word-frequency and n-gram queries and passage retrieval.
inputs: corpus, query terms or patterns
outputs: concordances, frequency series, passages
benchmark_note: corpus services whose value is the curation
state_of_art: Thesaurus Linguae Graecae; HathiTrust Research Center

name: Electronic dictionary lookup
definition: Given a word or phrase, return its senses, definitions, pronunciations and equivalents in other languages.
inputs: headword or phrase, dictionary selection
outputs: entries with senses, examples and translations
benchmark_note: word-sense disambiguation and definition modelling benchmarks test sense selection
state_of_art: Oxford English Dictionary Online; Merriam-Webster

name: Sign language dictionary lookup
definition: Given an English word or a recorded sign, return the matching signs with video and their meanings.
inputs: word or sign video
outputs: sign videos and glosses
benchmark_note: isolated sign recognition benchmarks such as WLASL score video-to-gloss lookup
state_of_art: Handspeak; SignBank

name: Career guidance and education planning
definition: Given a person's interests, abilities, history and goals, assess them, match them to occupations and programs, and track a plan to get there.

name: Career interest and aptitude assessment
definition: Given responses to interest, values and aptitude inventories, score them and suggest matching occupations and fields of study.
inputs: inventory responses
outputs: profile scores, ranked occupations and programs
benchmark_note: occupation recommendations could be scored against later career outcomes; instrument validity needs studies
state_of_art: Kuder Navigator; YouScience; Xello

name: Occupational information lookup
definition: Given a job title or occupation, return its tasks, requirements, wages and outlook and related occupations.
inputs: job title or occupation code
outputs: occupation profiles, related occupations
benchmark_note: coding free-text job titles to occupation codes is scored against hand-coded samples
state_of_art: O*NET OnLine; SkillTRAN Job Browser Pro

name: Transferable skills analysis
definition: Given a worker's past jobs and functional limitations, identify occupations they can still perform.
inputs: work history, residual functional capacity
outputs: ranked feasible occupations with rationale
benchmark_note: results can be compared with vocational expert decisions; no public dataset
state_of_art: SkillTRAN OASYS; MVQS

name: College and career plan management
definition: Given a student's goals, coursework and test scores, build multi-year course plans and college lists and track applications.
inputs: goals, academic record, test scores, program requirements
outputs: course plans, college lists, application status
benchmark_note: admission-likelihood estimates can be scored on historical outcomes; the plans themselves cannot
state_of_art: Naviance; SCOIR; Xello

name: Create media and communicate with the public
definition: Making and publishing content: images, layout, video, sound, animation and games, web pages, and the tools of broadcast, translation and public communication.

name: Raster image editing and photography
definition: Given captured or scanned pixel images, produce corrected, retouched, merged, generated or catalogued raster images.

name: Raw photo development
definition: Given camera raw sensor data, produce a rendered image by demosaicing and adjusting exposure, white balance, tone and color.
inputs: camera raw files, camera and lens profiles, adjustment parameters
outputs: rendered RGB images, non-destructive edit settings
benchmark_note: demosaicing and denoising have reference datasets (Kodak, McMaster, SIDD) with PSNR and perceptual metrics
state_of_art: Adobe Lightroom Classic; Capture One; DxO PhotoLab

name: Photo retouching and layer compositing
definition: Given one or more raster images and an editing intent, produce an edited image by selection, masking, cloning, layer blending and local adjustment.
inputs: raster images, selections and masks, edit instructions
outputs: edited and layered raster images
benchmark_note: instruction-guided editing benchmarks (MagicBrush, EditBench) exist, but most retouching quality is judged by people
state_of_art: Adobe Photoshop; Affinity Photo; Pixelmator Pro

name: Digital painting and drawing
definition: Given pen or brush strokes from an input device, simulate natural media to produce a painted raster image.
inputs: stylus strokes with pressure and tilt, brush definitions, canvas
outputs: painted raster images, layered painting files
benchmark_note: output is artwork judged by taste; stroke-simulation fidelity has no shared reference
state_of_art: Procreate; Clip Studio Paint; Corel Painter

name: Image restoration and enhancement
definition: Given a degraded image, produce an estimate of the clean image by denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, inpainting or colorization.
inputs: noisy, blurred, low-resolution, damaged or grayscale images
outputs: restored or upscaled images
benchmark_note: NTIRE challenges, DIV2K and SIDD give paired references scored by PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS
state_of_art: Topaz Photo AI; Adobe Photoshop Neural Filters; DxO PureRAW

name: Panorama, HDR and focus stacking
definition: Given several overlapping or bracketed exposures, register and blend them into one panorama, high-dynamic-range or extended-depth-of-field image.
inputs: overlapping or bracketed photographs, lens data
outputs: stitched panoramas, HDR radiance maps or tone-mapped images, focus-stacked images
benchmark_note: registration error and HDR reconstruction have datasets (Kalantari HDR set), but stitching quality is mostly visual
state_of_art: PTGui; Helicon Focus; Adobe Lightroom photo merge
open_tools: Hugin; enblend and enfuse; Luminance HDR

name: Photo ingest, metadata and cataloguing
definition: Given a set of image files, ingest, cull, tag with descriptive and rights metadata, and organize them for search and reuse.
inputs: image files with embedded camera metadata, keywords, captions, rights information
outputs: searchable catalogue, IPTC and XMP metadata written to files
benchmark_note: automatic tagging and near-duplicate detection can be scored on labelled sets; cataloguing workflow cannot
state_of_art: Photo Mechanic; Adobe Lightroom Classic; Adobe Bridge

name: Image and film scanning
definition: Given a flatbed or film scanner and physical originals, drive the scan and produce color-correct digital images with dust and grain correction.
inputs: prints, film or documents; scanner device; scan settings
outputs: digitized raster images
benchmark_note: color accuracy against IT8 targets is measurable; the rest is device control
state_of_art: SilverFast; VueScan; Epson Scan

name: Image generation from text
definition: Given a text description and optional reference images, synthesize a new raster image that matches the description.
inputs: text prompt, optional reference or control images
outputs: generated raster images
benchmark_note: GenEval, T2I-CompBench and FID on COCO captions score prompt adherence and image quality
state_of_art: Midjourney; OpenAI GPT Image; Google Imagen; Adobe Firefly

name: Vector illustration and graphic design
definition: Given design intent, shapes and type, produce resolution-independent graphics, layouts for single pieces, diagrams and typefaces.

name: Vector illustration
definition: Given a design idea or sketch, construct Bezier paths, fills, strokes and gradients to produce a scalable illustration or logo.
inputs: sketches, reference images, color palettes, type
outputs: vector artwork (SVG, AI, EPS, PDF)
benchmark_note: text-to-SVG and SVG-editing benchmarks exist, but illustration quality is judged by people
state_of_art: Adobe Illustrator; Affinity Designer; CorelDRAW

name: Raster-to-vector tracing
definition: Given a raster image, fit curves and regions to produce an equivalent vector drawing.
inputs: raster image, tracing tolerance and color count
outputs: vector paths and filled regions
benchmark_note: reconstruction error against the source image versus path count is computable on any image set
state_of_art: Adobe Illustrator Image Trace; Vector Magic

name: Template-based graphic design
definition: Given brand assets, copy and a format such as a poster or social post, arrange text, images and shapes into a finished single-page design.
inputs: copy, images, logos, brand colors and fonts, target format
outputs: finished graphic in image or PDF form
benchmark_note: layout generation is scored on Crello and PubLayNet with alignment and overlap metrics, but aesthetic quality needs human rating
state_of_art: Canva; Adobe Express; Microsoft Designer

name: Typeface design
definition: Given glyph designs, draw outlines, set spacing and kerning, and hint and compile them into an installable font.
inputs: glyph sketches or outlines, character set, metrics
outputs: OpenType or variable font files
benchmark_note: font validity and spacing checks are automatic (Fontbakery); glyph design quality is not
state_of_art: Glyphs; FontLab; RoboFont

name: Page layout and typesetting
definition: Given text, images and a design, compose multi-page documents and deliver them as print-ready or digital publications.

name: Interactive page layout
definition: Given copy, images and a grid, place and style frames on master pages to produce a laid-out publication.
inputs: text, images, styles, master pages, page size
outputs: laid-out document, print or digital export
benchmark_note: document layout generation is scored on PubLayNet and DocLayNet, but finished design quality needs human rating
state_of_art: Adobe InDesign; QuarkXPress; Affinity Publisher

name: Markup-driven typesetting
definition: Given text marked up in a typesetting or formatting language, compute line and page breaks, mathematics and hyphenation to produce typeset pages.
inputs: TeX, troff or XSL-FO source, fonts, style files
outputs: typeset PDF or PostScript pages
benchmark_note: rendering against reference outputs and line-breaking cost are measurable; typographic quality is judged
state_of_art: TeX Live; Antenna House Formatter; Typst
open_tools: TeX Live; LuaTeX; groff; Apache FOP; Typst

name: Structured single-source publishing
definition: Given topic-based structured content, resolve reuse and conditions and publish to multiple formats such as print manuals, help systems and web.
inputs: DITA, DocBook or proprietary structured XML topics, maps, conditions
outputs: PDF manuals, HTML help, web output
benchmark_note: schema validity and link integrity are checkable; content quality is not
state_of_art: MadCap Flare; Adobe FrameMaker; Oxygen XML Editor
open_tools: DITA Open Toolkit; DocBook XSL; Sphinx; Asciidoctor

name: Variable-data document composition
definition: Given a template and a data stream of records, compose one personalized document per record for print or electronic delivery.
inputs: document template, record data, business rules
outputs: composed print streams or PDFs per recipient
benchmark_note: output can be checked record by record against expected documents; throughput is measurable
state_of_art: OpenText Exstream; Quadient Inspire; XMPie

name: PDF output and preflight
definition: Given a laid-out document, produce a standard-conforming PDF and check or fix it against print or archive requirements.
inputs: layout files or PostScript, output profile such as PDF/X or PDF/A
outputs: conforming PDF, preflight report, automatic fixes
benchmark_note: conformance test suites (Isartor, veraPDF corpus) give pass or fail ground truth
state_of_art: Enfocus PitStop Pro; callas pdfToolbox; Adobe Acrobat Pro Preflight

name: Color management and proofing
definition: Given device measurements and documents, build ICC profiles and convert or soft-proof color between devices.
inputs: colorimeter or spectrophotometer readings, target charts, source documents
outputs: ICC device profiles, color-converted files, soft proofs
benchmark_note: profile accuracy is measured as color difference (Delta E 2000) against measured test charts
state_of_art: X-Rite i1Profiler; Calibrite PROFILER; GMG ColorProof

name: Editorial copy flow
definition: Given stories and page layouts, let writers and editors edit copy in place, fit it to the layout and track its status through to publication.
inputs: story text, page layouts, assignments and status
outputs: edited, fitted copy and a publication status record
benchmark_note: workflow coordination with no defined correct output
state_of_art: WoodWing Studio; Adobe InCopy; Naviga

name: E-book and digital edition production
definition: Given manuscript or laid-out content, produce reflowable or fixed-layout digital editions that validate and meet accessibility rules.
inputs: manuscript or layout files, metadata, cover, navigation
outputs: EPUB or app-based digital editions
benchmark_note: EPUBCheck and Ace by DAISY give objective conformance and accessibility results
state_of_art: Adobe InDesign EPUB export; Vellum; Kindle Create
open_tools: Sigil; Calibre; Pandoc; EPUBCheck; Ace by DAISY

name: Video editing, compositing and motion graphics
definition: Given recorded footage, graphics and audio, assemble, correct, composite and animate them into finished moving pictures.

name: Nonlinear video editing
definition: Given source clips and audio, cut, trim and arrange them on a timeline with transitions to produce an edited program.
inputs: video and audio clips, timecode, edit decisions
outputs: edited sequence, edit decision list, rendered program
benchmark_note: automatic editing and highlight selection are scored on TVSum and SumMe; craft editing is judged
state_of_art: Avid Media Composer; Adobe Premiere Pro; DaVinci Resolve; Final Cut Pro

name: Color correction and grading
definition: Given footage in camera color spaces, balance shots and apply a creative look to produce graded output in a delivery color space.
inputs: camera footage and color-space metadata, reference images, look-up tables
outputs: graded footage, LUTs, grading decision lists
benchmark_note: color transfer can be scored against reference grades, but grading intent is creative
state_of_art: DaVinci Resolve; FilmLight Baselight; Autodesk Flame

name: Compositing, keying and rotoscoping
definition: Given plates, mattes and computer-generated elements, extract foregrounds and combine layers into a seamless composite shot.
inputs: image sequences, green-screen plates, rendered passes, masks
outputs: composited image sequences, mattes
benchmark_note: matting (alphamatting.com, Composition-1k) and video object segmentation (DAVIS) have ground-truth mattes
state_of_art: Foundry Nuke; Adobe After Effects; Blackmagic Fusion

name: Camera tracking and matchmoving
definition: Given a filmed image sequence, track features and solve for camera motion and lens so that computer graphics can be placed in the shot.
inputs: image sequence, lens data, survey points
outputs: camera path, point cloud, lens distortion model
benchmark_note: camera pose accuracy is scored on structure-from-motion benchmarks such as ETH3D and Tanks and Temples
state_of_art: 3DEqualizer; SynthEyes; PFTrack; Boris FX Mocha Pro

name: Motion graphics and titling
definition: Given text, logos and design elements, animate them over time with particles and effects to produce titles and animated graphics.
inputs: type, vector and raster artwork, animation keyframes, effect parameters
outputs: rendered animated graphics with alpha, title sequences
benchmark_note: creative output with no reference answer
state_of_art: Adobe After Effects; Maxon Cinema 4D; Apple Motion

name: 2D animation
definition: Given drawings, cut-out rigs or vector assets, create frame-by-frame or interpolated two-dimensional animation.
inputs: drawn frames or vector characters, timing, audio
outputs: animated sequences
